en: Today is June 18th and it is Muiriel's birthday!
cn: 今天是６月１８号，也是Muiriel的生日！

en: Everyone must learn on their own in the end.
cn: 到了最后，大家一定要靠自己学习。

en: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
cn: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

en: When I grow up, I want to be a king.
cn: 我长大后想当国王。

en: Back in high school, I got up at 6 a.m. every morning.
cn: 以前读高中的时候﹐我每天早上六点起床。

en: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.
cn: 感到惊讶、感到惊奇就是明白的开始。

en: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.
cn: 然而，相反的理论往往也是真的。

en: We don't see things as they are, but as we are.
cn: 我们看东西不是看其实质，而是以我们的主观意识看它们的。

en: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.
cn: 生活就是当你忙着进行你的计划时总有其他的事情发生。

en: Do you remember the day when we first met?
cn: 你记不记得我们认识的那一天？

en: Everyone would like to believe that dreams can come true.
cn: 人人都愿意相信美梦可以成真。

en: I talked with my parents about my studying abroad.
cn: 我跟父母讲了留学的事情。

en: I made use of the maps during my journey.
cn: 我在旅行中用了地图。

en: I found the key for which I had been looking.
cn: 我找到那把我一直在找的钥匙了。

en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
cn: 在明天前完成报告几乎是不可能的。

en: If possible, I'd like to travel around the world.
cn: 如果可能的话，我想环游世界。

en: It is said that the weather on the mountain changes easily.
cn: 据说山上的天气变化很快。

en: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.
cn: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。

en: He gave me precise instructions to do the job.
cn: 他给我的工作作出了明确指示。

en: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.
cn: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。

en: In ten years our town will change a lot.
cn: 十年后，我们的城市将改变许多。

en: I can't imagine what creatures living on another planet are like.
cn: 我无法想象另一个星球上的生物。

en: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.
cn: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。

en: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
cn: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

en: Only then did he realize he had been deceived.
cn: 直到那时，他才意识到他已经上当受骗。

en: He contrived a means of speaking to Nancy privately.
cn: 他用了一些手段来和Nancy私下交谈。

en: I can't take the place of her as an English teacher.
cn: 我无法取代她做英语老师。

en: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.
cn: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。

en: When she saw that they had no schools, she started one.
cn: 当她发现他们还没有学校，她就办了一个。

en: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.
cn: 对严格限制经济的批评蜂拥而来。

en: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.
cn: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。

en: He told us such a funny story that we all laughed.
cn: 他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事，我们都笑了起来。

en: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.
cn: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。

en: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
cn: 我的生意终于走上了正轨。

en: If you need a pen, I'll lend you one.
cn: 如果你需要笔的话，我借你一支。

en: I am going to my room, where I can study.
cn: 我要回房间了，在那儿我可以学习。

en: As such is the case, I am sorry I can't accept your kind invitation.
cn: 照这样的情况，很抱歉，我不能接受你的盛情邀请。

en: It's next to impossible to finish it in a day.
cn: 在一天之内完成它几乎是不可能的。

en: I leave it in your hands what course of action to take.
cn: 接下来该采取什幺行动就交给你了。

en: We shall all miss you when you go away.
cn: 你走了，我们都会想你的。

en: Television has the advantage of providing sports fans with greater convenience.
cn: 电视的优点在于它给体育爱好者提供了更大的方便。

en: I didn't call on him because I had a cold.
cn: 我没有拜访他，因为我感冒了。

en: I was late as a result of the train delay.
cn: 由于火车延误，我迟到了。

en: He hasn't come yet. He must have missed the bus.
cn: 他还没来。他肯定错过公交车了。

en: This book is too difficult for you to read.
cn: 这本书对你来说读起来太难了。

en: He was happy at the news of her success.
cn: 听到她成功的消息，他很高兴。

en: The boys were whispering; I knew they were up to something.
cn: 男孩们窃窃私语，我知道他们准备做些什幺。

en: I'd like to reserve a single room on June 3.
cn: 我要预订一间6月3日的单人房。

en: She is no less kind than her sister is.
cn: 她和她妹妹一样亲切。

en: As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.
cn: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。

en: I read the book after I had finished my homework.
cn: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。

en: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?
cn: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎幺走？

en: Please write to me about conditions at your school.
cn: 请写信告诉我你们学校的情况。

en: The sight of fresh lobster gave me an appetite.
cn: 看见新鲜龙虾，我有了食欲。

en: The nurse will tell you how to do it.
cn: 护士会告诉你怎幺做。

en: Don't trust a man whose past you know nothing about.
cn: 不要相信一个你一点都不了解他过去的人。

en: I'm going off to Vancouver next week to see my sister.
cn: 下周我去温哥华看我妹妹。

en: The engagement of Mr Rogers and Miss Smith was announced yesterday.
cn: 罗杰斯先生和史密斯小姐昨天宣布订婚。

en: This is the most beautiful sight that I have ever seen.
cn: 这是我见过最美的景色了。

en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
cn: 我不明白为什幺你这幺批评他。

en: His sisters as well as he are now living in Tokyo.
cn: 他和他的姐妹们目前都住在东京。

en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
cn: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法 。

en: He is going to be a doctor when he grows up.
cn: 他长大了会成为一名医生。

en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
cn: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

en: Why are you saying you want to walk in the park?
cn: 你为什幺说要去公园散步？

en: We saw a lot of live fish in the pond.
cn: 我们看见池里有很多活鱼。

en: All the signs are that she is getting better.
cn: 所有迹象表明她好起来了。

en: Is it right for a doctor to decide when someone should die?
cn: 由医生来决定某人何时该死是对的吗？

en: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.
cn: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。

en: People are more educated now than they used to be.
cn: 现在的人教育程度比以前高得多。

en: I can't bring myself to do such a thing.
cn: 我不能让自己做这样的事。

en: Accepting the other's norms is submitting to the other's power.
cn: 接受对方的准则就是给予他权力。

en: I'll see to it that you have a raise after the first year.
cn: 我将确保你们在第一年后有一个增长。

en: It was Alice who went to the concert yesterday.
cn: 昨天是Alice去了演唱会。

en: A whistle blew, and the boat slowly began to pull out of port.
cn: 汽笛声响起，船开始慢慢地驶离港口。

en: This photograph reminds me of enjoyable times when I was a child.
cn: 这张照片让我想起童年的快乐时光。

en: You have to get on that bus to go to the museum.
cn: 要去博物馆，你就得乘那辆车。

en: My father was no less affectionate and tender to me than my mother was.
cn: 我爸爸对我的爱和照顾不比我妈妈少。

en: Look at that mountain which is covered with snow.
cn: 看那座被雪覆盖的山。

en: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.
cn: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。

en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.
cn: 这箱子是空的，里面什幺也没有。

en: The situation is getting worse and worse day by day.
cn: 情况一天比一天差。

en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
cn: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。

en: If I had one million yen now, I would buy a car.
cn: 如果我现在有100万日元，我会买辆车。

en: In a way you are right, but I still have doubts.
cn: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。

en: We gained the top of Mt. Fuji at last.
cn: 我们终于登上了富士山山顶。

en: I want the same jacket as you are wearing.
cn: 我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。

en: What souvenir do you think she would like most?
cn: 你觉得她最想要什幺纪念品？

en: Sleep is the greatest thief, for it steals half one's life.
cn: 睡眠是最大的小偷，它偷了我们一半的生命。

en: Love is the process of breaking and mending the heart of another.
cn: 爱，就是一个人把另一个人的心揉碎的过程。

en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
cn: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

en: There appears to be a party in that house.
cn: 这房子里似乎在办派对。

en: St Mark's Square in Venice is always swarming with tourists in the summer.
cn: 威尼斯的圣马可广场在夏季总是挤满了游客。

en: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.
cn: 一个神圣的仪式在庄严的庙宇中举行。

en: The weather was so cold that the lake froze over.
cn: 天冷得足以让湖结冰。

en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.
cn: 我弟弟手里拿着一个摄像机。

en: My sister is twenty-one years old and a college student.
cn: 我妹妹21岁，是个大学生。

en: What greater misfortune is there than to go blind?
cn: 有什幺比失明更不幸的呢？

en: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.
cn: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。

en: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.
cn: 仅三分之一的成员出席了会议。

en: We must take into account the fact that he is young.
cn: 我们必须考虑到他很年轻。

en: The problem is how we cope with the present difficulties.
cn: 问题是我们如何应付目前的困难。

en: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
cn: 孩子在这条河里游泳太危险了。

en: Newspapers, magazines, and newscasts tell what is going on in the world.
cn: 报纸、杂志和新闻广播讲述着世界上正在发生的事。

en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.
cn: 这被认为是一件大事。

en: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
cn: 如果你快一点，还能赶上他。

en: I go to the office by bicycle except on rainy days.
cn: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。

en: Will you go to the party instead of me?
cn: 你会代替我去派对吗？

en: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.
cn: 他是日本最伟大的艺术家之一。

en: Father would often read detective stories in his spare time.
cn: 父亲常常在空闲时间读侦探小说。

en: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.
cn: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。

en: The charge for a front row seat is 5 dollars.
cn: 第一排的座位5美元。

en: I used to play alone when I was a child.
cn: 我小时候常常独自玩耍。

en: She will return home next Sunday, that is, the tenth.
cn: 她下周日回家，也就是10号。

en: We are not short of oil in this country.
cn: 我们国家不缺石油。

en: He came in, and at the same time the bell rang.
cn: 他进来的同时，铃响了。

en: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.
cn: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。

en: I have neither seen nor heard of such a thing.
cn: 我没见过也没听过这样的事。

en: Ken is going to the United States at the end of July.
cn: Ken七月底要去美国了。

en: A fire broke out in my neighborhood last night.
cn: 昨晚我领居家着火了。

en: Many words are pronounced according to the spelling, but some are not.
cn: 许多词是根据拼写来发音的，不过有些不是。

en: The IMF ruled out any new loans to that country.
cn: 国际货币基金组织不考虑再借款给该国。

en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
cn: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.
cn: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。

en: We are all looking forward to seeing you and your family.
cn: 我们都期待看到你和你的家人。

en: This is the village where the poet was born.
cn: 这是这个诗人出生的村子。

en: Mr. and Mrs. Smith live apart from each other now.
cn: 史密斯夫妇现在分居了。

en: She won't take an airplane for fear of a crash.
cn: 她不会乘飞机因为害怕坠机。

en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.
cn: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。

en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
cn: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。

en: You can get in touch with him at his home tonight.
cn: 今晚你可以在他家联络到他。

en: We have to turn in our reports by the end of this month.
cn: 这个月底前，我们必须交报告。

en: It's hard to say what the weather will be like tomorrow.
cn: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

en: How large is the population of New York City?
cn: 纽约市的人口有多少？

en: An uncle of mine gave me some useful advice.
cn: 我的一个叔叔给我了一些有用的建议。

en: To control a class calls for all your skills as a teacher.
cn: 控制一个班级需要你做老师的所有技能。

en: I wonder if it will snow in our town this winter.
cn: 我想知道这个冬天在我们的城市会不会下雪。

en: I'm sure you'll love what we have on the menu tonight.
cn: 我肯定你会喜欢我们今晚的菜肴。

en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
cn: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。

en: My brother is not as tall as I was two years ago.
cn: 我弟弟没我两年前高。

en: The church is at the foot of a mountain.
cn: 教堂位于山脚。

en: She lets her children have their own way too much.
cn: 她太放任她的孩子们了。

en: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.
cn: 他在城市里一直受到噪音或者其他的干扰。

en: I bumped my head against the door and got a lump.
cn: 我头撞到了门，肿了一块。

en: The show was wonderful, but the tickets were too expensive.
cn: 这场秀棒极了，但是门票太贵了。

en: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
cn: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

en: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.
cn: 你可能是对的，但我和你意见相反。

en: This shop is open from 9 to 6 o'clock.
cn: 这家店从9点开到18点。

en: Do you know when the musician will come here?
cn: 你知道音乐家什幺时候来这儿吗？

en: We take great pleasure in meeting all of you this evening.
cn: 我们很高兴今晚能见到大家。

en: Please don't do anything that would besmirch the Matsuno family name!
cn: 请不要做任何有损松野家族名声的事！

en: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.
cn: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。

en: While you are reading to me, I can do my sewing.
cn: 你读给我听的时候，我就可以做缝纫了。

en: It is illegal for bicycles to pass on the right of cars.
cn: 自行车从右侧超过汽车是不合法的。

en: If it had not been for your help, I couldn't have completed the work.
cn: 如果不是因为有你的帮助，我不可能完成了这个工作。

en: Donna was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
cn: Donna是含着金钥匙出生的。

en: Were I in your place I would do the same thing.
cn: 如果我是你，我也会这幺做。

en: My father insisted that I should go to see the place.
cn: 我爸爸坚持要我去那地方看看。

en: School was closed for the day due to the snow.
cn: 学校因大雪停课一天。

en: He won the prize for excellence in all subjects.
cn: 他各科全优。

en: The wind blew too hard for them to play in the park.
cn: 风刮得太猛，他们没法在公园里玩了。

en: The university was founded by his father twenty years ago.
cn: 大学在20年前由他的父亲建立。

en: He said he did not enter the room, which was a lie.
cn: 他说他没有进房间，那是骗人的。

en: I'm at work now, so I'll call you later.
cn: 我现在在上班，所以晚点打给你。

en: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
cn: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

en: Mr. Brown, a friend from Oregon, will visit us tomorrow.
cn: 一个从俄勒冈州来的朋友，布朗先生明天会来拜访我们。

en: My television was broken down, so I had to get it repaired.
cn: 我的电视机出故障了，所以我不得不拿去修。

en: It is believed that whales have their own language.
cn: 人们相信鲸有他们自己的语言。

en: You will soon get used to eating Japanese food.
cn: 你很快就会习惯吃日本料理了。

en: I have a lot of friends to help me.
cn: 我有很多朋友帮我。

en: I wonder which of the runners will come first.
cn: 我在想哪个跑步运动员会跑第一。

en: Will you pick me up at seven tomorrow morning?
cn: 你明早7点来接我吗？

en: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
cn: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。

en: He did it at the expense of his health.
cn: 他以牺牲自己的健康为代价完成了这项工作。

en: If it rains tomorrow, I'll just stay at home.
cn: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家。

en: That's the computer he used to write the article.
cn: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。

en: No matter how often I tell her, she keeps making the same mistake.
cn: 不管我跟她说了多少次，她还是继续犯同样的错误。

en: My dad is not at home for the moment.
cn: 现在我爸爸不在家。

en: I have an older brother and an older sister.
cn: 我有一个哥哥，也有一个姐姐。

en: Little Ming still doesn't know where he's going to go next year.
cn: 小明还不知道他明年去哪儿。

en: Our school is in the center of the town.
cn: 我们学校在市中心。

en: It is very dangerous to jump aboard the train when it is moving.
cn: 跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。

en: She helped her father with the work in the garden.
cn: 她帮她爸爸干了花园里的活。

en: I wish to become a dentist in the future.
cn: 我希望将来成为一名牙医。

en: You have to pay special attention to what you eat and drink.
cn: 尤其是要注意你吃的和喝的东西。

en: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.
cn: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
cn: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

en: Wang Xiaoming speaks English, but doesn't have a lot of English books.
cn: 王小明说英语,但英语书不多.

en: The dictionary he talked about isn't available in the library.
cn: 他说的词典图书馆没有.

en: Xiaoming Wang has never been to America. He really wants to go next year.
cn: 王小明还没有去过美国,他很想明年去.

en: He still hasn't been to France; he really wants to go next year.
cn: 他还没有去过法国，他很想明年去。

en: His scores are always better than mine, even though he doesn't study very much.
cn: 他的分数总比我高，尽管他学习得少一点。

en: This film is really boring - the best bit is when it finishes.
cn: 这部电影很无聊，最好的部分是结局。

en: It's a good thing to read good books when you are young.
cn: 年轻的时候多看点好书是件好事。

en: With just a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
cn: 如果他再努力一点，就可能已经成功了。

en: It is not easy to distinguish good from evil.
cn: 区分善恶不容易。

en: I don't like the way you laugh at her.
cn: 我不喜欢你嘲笑她的方式。

en: It is cruel of him to say such things to her.
cn: 他跟她说这样的话真是太残忍了。

en: I always take a bath before going to bed.
cn: 我睡觉前总要洗个澡。

en: He must be a gentleman to act that way.
cn: 这样的举止只可能是个绅士。

en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
cn: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。

en: I don't like to go out when it's dark.
cn: 我天黑后不喜欢出门。

en: The friend who I thought would pass the exam failed it.
cn: 那个我认为会通过考试的朋友失败了。

en: I don't feel like taking a walk this morning.

cn: 三个男孩合共只有两元。

en: His novel had a great vogue for a long time.
cn: 他的小说风行了一段长时间。

en: I spent Saturday afternoon watching entirely too much TV.
cn: 我看电视度过了星期六的下午。

en: His painting wasn't particularly good, so no one praised him for it.
cn: 他的画画得并不是很好，所以没有获得人们的赞赏。

en: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
cn: 零度以下的气温持续了好几天。

en: Space travel will be commonplace some time in the future.
cn: 太空旅行终有一天会成为平常事。

en: When I was taking a bath, the telephone rang.
cn: 我正在洗澡的时候电话响了。

en: I have a lot of things to do today.
cn: 我今天有很多事要做。

en: I've got to hang up now. Someone is waiting to use the phone.
cn: 我要挂线了。有人正在等着用电话。

en: This is the hottest summer we have had in fifty years.
cn: 这是 50 年来最热的夏天。

en: I'd like to have a test for breast cancer.
cn: 我想检查一下我是否患了乳癌。

en: It seems that there will be a storm soon.
cn: 看来快要刮暴风雨了。

en: It is really marvelous of you to remember my birthday.
cn: 你还记得我的生日，那真是太好了。

en: It wasn't until then that I felt really frightened.
cn: 直到那时我才真正感到害怕。

en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.
cn: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。

en: Life in prison is worse than the life of an animal.
cn: 监狱生活比做畜牲还不如。

en: If it rains tomorrow, I won't go to the picnic.
cn: 如果明天下雨的话，我就不去野餐了。

cn: 今天的报纸说城里发生了火灾。

en: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.
cn: 农村好像要大规模发展了。

en: All the villagers went into the mountains to look for a missing cat.
cn: 所有村民出发去山里寻找一只失踪的猫。

en: When I got up this morning, it was raining.
cn: 我今早起床时天正在下雨。

en: My brother has been living in London for many years.
cn: 我哥哥已在伦敦住了很多年。

en: She hurried to the station so that she wouldn't miss the train.
cn: 她匆忙赶去车站，以免错过火车。

en: Is there any difference between your idea and hers?
cn: 你的想法和她的想法有甚么不同吗？

en: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
cn: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。

en: He pretends to be enthusiastic when his boss is around.
cn: 老板在的时候他就装成一副很热心的样子。

en: Mr Tani is not so much a scholar as a journalist.
cn: Tani 先生与其说是学者，倒不如说是新闻工作者。

en: It seems to be becoming hard to get a good job.
cn: 好工作似乎愈来愈难找了。

en: In the last typhoon, the wind blew at over 200 kilometers per hour!
cn: 上次刮台风时，风速超过了 200 公里每小时！

en: I was so excited that I could not fall asleep.
cn: 我兴奋得睡不着觉。

en: If you have any money, please lend me some.
cn: 如果你有钱的话，借点给我吧。

en: Her composition is very good except for a few errors in spelling.
cn: 她的作文作得十分好，只不过有几个字拼错了。

en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
cn: 他拿了面镜子细看自己的舌头。

en: A few months later they return to their breeding grounds in the Arctic.
cn: 数月后，牠们回到了北极的繁殖地。

en: I took it for granted that he would pass the exam.
cn: 我以为他一定会考试合格。

en: I have four times more CDs than you do.
cn: 我的 CD 有你的两倍多。

en: Now that she has quit her job, we can't depend on her.
cn: 现在她没了工作，我们再不能依靠她了。

en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
cn: 如果你发现有错的话请帮忙改正。

en: Correct the mistake and return the file to Mr Luxemburg.
cn: 请把错误改正过来，然后把文件夹还给 Luxemburg 先生。

en: You should have Mr Green correct your English pronunciation.
cn: 你应该请 Green 先生帮你纠正英文发音。

en: My first impression of him proved to be correct.
cn: 我对他的第一印象果然没有错。

en: March 15 will be my last day of school.
cn: 3月15日将是我最后一天上学的日子。

en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.
cn: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。

en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
cn: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。

en: A map helps us to know where we are.
cn: 地图帮助我们知道所在的位置。

en: She shed plentiful tears when her beloved dog was killed in an accident.
cn: 她目睹爱犬在意外中离世，不禁泪如泉涌。

en: Don't bother your parents with such a pointless thing.
cn: 别为了这样的小事麻烦你父母。

en: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.
cn: 我遇见了以前的班主任时，他问候了我的父母。

en: You have only to read this article to see how serious the accident was.
cn: 你只要读读这篇文章，就能知道那意外有多严重。

en: My grandfather is five times as old as I am.
cn: 祖父的年龄比我大五倍。

cn: 这餐厅的服务一点效率也没有。

en: It wasn't until I heard him speak that I recognized him.
cn: 我听到他的声音以后才把他认出来了。

en: Most people killed by smoking were not heavy smokers.
cn: 大多数被香烟害死的人吸的烟都不多。

cn: 我感冒了，昨天便在床上睡觉。

en: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
cn: 蔬菜的价格每天在变。

en: I was at a loss as to what to say.

en: Next time you come, don't forget to give it back to me.
cn: 你下次来的时候，别忘了把它还给我。

en: The weather will delay the start of the race.
cn: 因为天气的关系，赛跑比赛将会延迟。

cn: 大炸弹从天而降，夺走了许多人的生命。

cn: 期望 Cobb 小姐回来的唯一一人。

cn: 如果你死了，你的家人会怎样呢？

cn: 他在法国住了一段时间，然后就去了意大利。

en: Who is the man that you were talking with?
cn: 刚才和你说话的人是谁？

en: Some people read the newspaper and watch TV at the same time.
cn: 有些人边看电视边读报纸。

en: English is a very important language in today's world.
cn: 英语是当今世界上一种非常重要的语言。

en: The plane was three hours late due to bad weather.
cn: 由于天气不好，飞机迟到了3小时。

cn: 我朋友George今年夏天要来日本。

en: I was a high school student at that time.
cn: 我当时是高中生。

en: He studied hard in order to get into college.
cn: 他努力学习，为的是能够考上大学。

cn: 爸！妈！我有个好消息要告诉你们！

cn: 她有很多缺点，但我还是这么信她。

en: He used to get up early when he was young.
cn: 他小时通常很早起床。

cn: 所有持有学生证的学生均可进入图书馆。

en: You may stay here as long as you like.
cn: 你想在这儿待多久就待多久。

cn: 我有些同学喜欢排球，也有些喜欢网球。

en: You should be careful in your choice of friends.
cn: 你应该小心选择朋友。

cn: 他把我妹妹的玩具都抢走了。

en: There is not a scrap of truth in his words.
cn: 他说的话没有一句是真的。

en: I see why you don't want to go there.
cn: 我明白你为甚么不想去了。

en: He put the books on the shelf out of order.
cn: 他胡乱把书本放在架上。

cn: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。

cn: 如果你不赶时间的话，为不么不喝杯茶甚么的呢？

cn: 虽然他很小心，但还是犯了个想不到的错误。

cn: 他的目光十分困惑：「我甚么也没听过，所以甚么也说不出来。」

en: How do you like your coffee? Strong and black?
cn: 你喜欢甚么口味的咖啡？浓的黑咖啡？

en: How many people do you think have an ear for music?
cn: 你觉得有多少人懂得欣赏音乐？

en: The unhappy event made him put an end to himself.

cn: 她完全不担心测验的分数。

cn: 你必须在星期日前完成。

cn: 她现在很忙，不能和你谈话。

cn: 他一拿了信就去了纽约。

en: Do you agree with what he says in the book?
cn: 你赞成他在书中说的话吗？

cn: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子要养活。

cn: 我刚打开锅盖，一股恶臭就扑鼻而来。

cn: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。

cn: 从现实的角度看，他的计划有很多缺点。

cn: 虽然失败了很多次，但是他仍从不放弃。

cn: 这不公平！凭什幺我必须做艰苦的工作。

cn: 请看看页顶的图片。

en: All the events described in this story are imaginary.
cn: 故事里发生的事都是虚构出来的。

en: I am going to do it whether you agree or not.
cn: 不管你同意还是不同意，我还是要做。

cn: 我向你们承诺——我们作为一个整体将会达成目标。

cn: 那些想要颠覆这个世界的人们，我们将击败你们。

cn: 感谢你们。上帝保佑你们。愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国

en: I was very tired, so I went to bed early.
cn: 我很累所以早睡了。

cn: 你也许不会记得，而我永远不会忘记。

cn: 至于我, 我没有什幺更多要说的。

cn: 他们照顾了一个印度女孩和一个意大利男孩。

cn: 他举高了手来截的士。

cn: 她衣衫单薄，恐会着凉。

en: I look forward to seeing you again very soon.
cn: 希望早日再见到你。

en: I don't know whether you like her or not.

cn: 如果下雨的话，别忘了带把伞。

cn: 你衬衫的第二粒衣钮好像快要掉下来了。

en: As far as I know, he has never made such a mistake.

cn: 她在百货公司门前下了的士。

cn: 她为了找新工作而来了东京。

cn: 我完全不明白他为甚么会突然辞职。

cn: 她对我说8月去巴黎。

cn: Sally 把前一天买的隐形眼镜弄不见了。

en: My wife told me to do away with this old hat.
cn: 老婆叫我把这顶旧帽子丢掉。

en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
cn: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。

cn: 我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。

cn: 邱吉尔不仅是一位伟大的政治家，还是一位伟大的作家。

en: I vowed that I would never speak to her again.
cn: 我发誓再也不跟她说话了。

en: My view was different from his as to what should be done.
cn: 应该做什幺，我和他的见解不同。

en: Dinner is ready, so we can eat whenever we want.
cn: 晚餐已经准备好了，我们可以随时开始吃。

en: The young woman was carrying an infant in her arms.
cn: 那个年轻女人手抱着婴儿。

en: I cannot see you without thinking of your late father.
cn: 我一见到你就会想起你已故的父亲。

en: As I returned from school yesterday, I was caught in a sudden shower.
cn: 昨天我在放学回家的路上突然遇上了一阵大雨。

en: Put this stamp on the postcard and drop it in the mailbox.
cn: 把这张邮票贴在明信片上，然后投到邮箱里。

en: I'll call by the post office on the way home.
cn: 我回家时会顺道去一去邮政局。

en: Can you please tell me where the nearest public telephone is?
cn: 请问最近的公用电话在哪里?

en: I'll pay you back once I receive my salary.
cn: 一领到工资就把钱还给你。

en: I remember him as a cute, bright little boy.
cn: 我印象中的他是个可爱聪明的小男孩。

en: There is a bit of whisky in this bottle.
cn: 这瓶内有一点威士忌。

en: How long do you think it takes to go from here to Tokyo?
cn: 你认为从这里去东京要花多久时间？

cn: 我从小的梦想就是做一名糕点师。

en: All you have to do is follow his advice.
cn: 你跟随他的指示做就行了。

cn: 我听到这个消息时，简直不能相信自己的耳朵。

en: I will never forget your kindness so long as I live.
cn: 只要还活着，我永远忘不了你的好意。

cn: 喜欢男人，为什幺还要和女人结婚？

cn: 你觉得我们应该为世界和平做些甚么？

cn: 他给我们做了一张桌子和两把长椅。

cn: 金价每天都在变动。

cn: 地面仍然很湿滑，看来比赛要被取消了。

cn: 我们应该尽力不要污染环境。

en: I am going to write about our parks and mountains.
cn: 我打算描写我们的公园和山。

cn: 我有两条狗。一条是白色的，另一条是黑色的。

cn: 前门有人，你去看看是谁。

cn: 我们需要面粉、砂糖和鸡蛋来做这个蛋糕。

cn: 我决定要和 Margaret 结婚。

cn: Alice 不知道书本放了在哪里，于是便去问母亲。

cn: 我在七时十五分吃晚饭。

cn: 田径运动会因天雨关系取消了。

en: Above all, you must take good care of yourself.
cn: 最重要的是你要好好照顾自己。

cn: 天气热的时候记住要多喝水。

cn: 近年的游客数量大幅增加。

cn: 我们一直讨论到很晚。

en: All the people present were moved by his speech.
cn: 他的演说感动了在场的每一个人。

en: Excuse me, but is this the right way to the subway station?
cn: 不好意思，请问这条路通往地铁站吗？

en: The more we have, the greater our desire will be.
cn: 人拥有得愈多，贪念就愈大。

en: As it is, prices are going up every week.
cn: 事实上，价格每个星期都在攀升。

en: We have not had a single drop of rain for two weeks.
cn: 这两个礼拜一滴雨也没下过。

en: He put on his glasses and began to read.
cn: 他戴上眼镜开始阅读。

en: She has faults, but I love her none the less.
cn: 虽然她有些缺点，但我始终还是爱她。

en: However hard you try, you can't finish it in a week or so.
cn: 你就算多努力，也不可能在一两个星期内做完。

en: Some day you will come to realize the importance of saving.
cn: 你现在不好好储蓄金钱的话，终有一天会后悔的。

en: He can't do this kind of work, and she can't either.
cn: 他不会做这种工作，她也不会。

en: My mother will attend to the baby while I go to the dance.
cn: 我去参加舞会，母亲就帮忙照顾婴儿。

en: Have you made up your mind where to go for the holidays?
cn: 你想好放假去哪里玩了没有？

en: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
cn: 我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。

en: Grandmother's ashes are in an urn at the temple.
cn: 祖母的骨灰在寺院的骨灰瓮里。

en: If I were you, I would do the same.
cn: 换了是我，我也会这样做的。

en: Human beings differ from animals in that they can think and speak.
cn: 人类有思考和说话的能力，动物却没有。这就是人和动物的分别。

en: He asked her to marry him, but she refused.
cn: 他向她求婚，但她却拒绝了。

en: When man and woman unite, work is no longer as tiring.
cn: 男女搭配，干活不累。

en: I can't afford to eat in such an expensive restaurant.
cn: 我吃不起这幺贵的餐馆。

en: If you didn't eat the cake I made, then your sister did.
cn: 我做的蛋糕不是被你吃了，就是被你妹妹吃了。

en: I had to push my bicycle because I had a flat tire.
cn: 我得推我的自行车，因为有个轮胎漏气了。

en: There must be something at the back of this matter.
cn: 此事必有隐情。

en: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
cn: 船到桥头自然直。

en: Not only can he speak Mandarin, but Shanghainese as well.
cn: 他不但会说普通话，而且会说上海话。

en: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.
cn: 我会告诉她开会的时候说些什幺。

en: If you learn Chinese well, you can go study in China.
cn: 只要你好好学中文，你就能去中国读书了。

en: Only if you come will she come to my birthday party.
cn: 只有你来了，她才会来我的生日派对。

en: Was there a book on the desk a moment ago?
cn: 刚才桌子上有一本书吗？

en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
cn: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。

en: I'm so tired that I'm going to bed as soon as I get home.
cn: 我累死了，以至于我一回家就睡觉了。

en: When I was 10, my brother left our home.
cn: 在我十岁的时候，我哥哥离家出走了。

en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
cn: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。

en: I still need to go to Pudong at 12:30.
cn: 我中午十二点半还要去浦东。

en: He is my friend. Do you guys know him?
cn: 他是我的朋友。你们认识吗？

en: Finish your homework faster, so that we can play video games.
cn: 快点写完你的作业，我们好去打游戏机。

en: Out of sight out of mind. When you're separated you lose touch.
cn: 久了不见，便会逐渐淡忘。分开以后，也就自然不会再联络了。

en: How many days are you going to be visiting your hometown?
cn: 你回家乡去住多少天？

en: No matter who it was that wrote this book, he's very clever.
cn: 我不知道这本书的作者是谁，但他肯定是个天才。

en: This machine is too heavy for me to carry.
cn: 这台机器太重了，我拿不动。

en: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.
cn: 和别人握手的时候，一定要有眼神接触。

en: The reason why you failed is you did not try hard enough.
cn: 因为你不够努力，所以才会失败。

en: There's no need to panic. There's plenty of time.
cn: 别急，时间还多着呢。

en: It is questionable whether this data can be relied on.
cn: 这些资料未必可靠。

en: First of all, you should talk it over with your parents.
cn: 你应该先和你的父母谈谈。

en: A bad habit, once formed, is difficult to get rid of.
cn: 一旦养成了坏习惯，就很难改回来了。

en: He took up his pen and began to write.
cn: 他拿起笔，写了起来。

en: Noise pollution could be avoided if only people were more sensitive to the environment.
cn: 如果大家都懂得关心环境的话，就不会有噪音污染了。

en: If you do not go fishing tomorrow, I will not either.
cn: 你明天不去钓鱼的话，我也不去了。

en: I think it is worthwhile to see this film twice.
cn: 我觉得这部电影值得一看再看。

en: As I am off duty today, let's go to the beach.
cn: 我今天不用当值，不如一起去海滩玩吧。

en: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
cn: 我在街上踫见了一个老朋友。

en: This is a very important meeting. You ought not to miss it.
cn: 这个会议很重要的，你不要不来。

en: We had better go home rather than wait here.
cn: 我们别在这里等了，还是快点回家吧。

en: As soon as I get paid I will pay you back.
cn: 我一收到钱就马上还钱给你。

en: It is you that are to blame for it.
cn: 责任应该由你来负。

en: We've come to the conclusion that this is a true story.
cn: 我们的结论就是，那个传言是真的。

en: You don't... you don't talk to me like that.
cn: 你别⋯⋯别这样和我说话。

en: The car is too expensive for me to buy.
cn: 那辆车子太贵了，我买不起。

en: I don't know whether to cry or to laugh.
cn: 我真是哭笑不得了。

en: It was raining on and off all night long.
cn: 整晚一会下雨，一会停雨。

en: I have a friend waiting for me in the lobby.
cn: 有个朋友正在大堂等我。

en: He's always looking at you. He must love you.
cn: 他整天盯着你看，肯定是喜欢你了。

en: Do you think you could lend me some of your records?
cn: 可以借几张 CD 来听听吗？

en: It is no use blaming him for the accident now.
cn: 事情已经发生了，现在怪他也没有用。

en: How did Barbara do on her driver's test yesterday?
cn: 芭芭拉昨天考驾照考得怎样？

en: These old customs have been handed down from generation to generation.
cn: 这些古老习俗都是一代一代相传下来的。

en: Why has it been getting hotter and hotter these last two days?
cn: 为什幺这两天一天比一天热？

en: I am able to obtain a registration form for free.
cn: 我可以免费获取一份注册表格。

en: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.
cn: 我不知道该说什幺来安慰你。

en: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.
cn: 猴子跳到他身上的时候，他受到了惊吓。

en: It took a lot of time and money to build the machine.
cn: 这台机器是花了不少时间和金钱才建成的。

en: John has put on a lot of weight recently.
cn: 约翰最近胖了很多。

en: Dark as it was, we managed to find our way home.
cn: 天色很暗，但我们还是找到路回家。

en: No sooner had Tom turned on the TV than the fuse blew.
cn: 汤姆一打开电视，保险丝就烧了。

en: I slept a little during lunch break because I was so tired.
cn: 我在午休时间睡了一会儿，因为我太累了。

en: Open the cupboard to the left, the bottles are in there.
cn: 打开左边的橱，瓶子在那儿。

en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
cn: 每天早晚，我给我的猫喂食。

en: If you want this pen, I will lend it to you.
cn: 你想用这支笔，我就借给你吧。

en: I wish I had treated the girl more kindly.
cn: 我真后悔以前没有好好对她。

en: As a result of the war, many people died.
cn: 那场战争死了很多人。

en: Steel production will increase 2% this month from last month.
cn: 今个月的钢铁产量和上个月比起来，估计会上升两个巴仙。

en: Fucking hell, what idiot dare phone me in the middle of the night?
cn: 他妈的，哪个傻子敢在半夜打我电话?!

en: Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.
cn: 面包是用面粉和水做的，有时还会加入发酵粉。

en: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
cn: 巴士司机有责任保护乘客的安全。

en: It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.
cn: 我突然想起钱包好像放在家中，忘了带了。

en: Fine words and an insinuating appearance are seldom associated with true virtue.
cn: 巧言令色，鲜矣仁。

en: Though Jim works very hard, his job does not pay very much.
cn: 吉姆很努力工作，但薪水却不高。

en: I wonder if she'll recognize me after all these years.
cn: 过了这么多年，不知道她还认得我吗？

en: When he was a child, he would go fishing on Sundays.
cn: 他小时候，星期天会去钓鱼。

en: The girl about whom I told you lives here.
cn: 我跟你说过的那个女生住在这儿。

en: Do you know of any good restaurant near here?
cn: 你知道这儿附近有什幺好餐馆吗?

en: For one reason or another their holiday in France didn't come up to expectations.
cn: 由于种种原因，他们在法国的假期没让他们感到满意。

en: He is a man of few words, but he always keeps his promise.
cn: 他这个人话不多，但总是遵守诺言。

en: The matter will be brought up at the next meeting.
cn: 这个问题留待下次开会才讨论。

en: No sooner had the child seen his mother than he burst into tears.
cn: 孩子一见到母亲就哭了起来。

en: It's at the third home in the second row of houses.
cn: 在第二排房子的第三家。

en: Go straight down the road, and when you pass the traffic light you're there.
cn: 你一路往前走，过了红绿灯就到了。

en: So which way is it to the People's Park?
cn: 那幺去人民公园怎幺走？

en: You can get there by crossing the street at the second intersection.
cn: 你从这里过去到那里，穿过第二条横马路就是。

en: Whales are said to have lived on land long ago.
cn: 据说鲸鱼以前是在陆地上生活的。

en: Without air there can be no wind or sound on the moon.
cn: 月球表面没有空气，所以没有风，也没有声音。

en: He's just a normal junior high school student, not particularly intelligent.
cn: 他只不过是个普普通通的中学生，不算特别聪明。

en: He does not know how to drive a car.
cn: 他不会开车。

en: In Britain a truck is referred to as a lorry.
cn: 英国人把货车叫作「lorry」。

en: I don't feel well today. That well water is the cause of many illnesses.
cn: 我今天有点不舒服。那户井水是许多疾病的源头。

en: My father smokes a pack of cigarettes a day.
cn: 我爸爸每天抽一包烟。

en: That way is very far, so we took a taxi.
cn: 那路当然挺远的，我们打的去算了。

en: Can you sketch it for me on this piece of paper please?
cn: 请你帮我在这张纸上画个草图。

en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in fall.
cn: 这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。

en: I perceive by your face that you have good news.
cn: 我从你的表情猜到你有好消息。

en: A prudent bird chooses its tree. A wise servant chooses his master.
cn: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事。

en: Pierre has a lot of pirated software on his computer.
cn: Pierre电脑里有很多盗版软件。

en: Much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
cn: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。

en: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
cn: 说曹操，曹操就到。

en: That man knows how to get on the president's good side.
cn: 那人很会讨好老板。

en: I used a ribbon to tie my hair into a ponytail.
cn: 我用丝带在头上扎了一个马尾辫。

en: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
cn: 预防胜于治疗。

en: It's because I was asked to come that I'm here.
cn: 有人叫我来，我才来的。

en: All the furniture in the room was all worn out.
cn: 房间里面的家具都很残旧了。

en: I think of watching TV as a waste of time.
cn: 我觉得看电视很浪费时间。

en: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.
cn: 希望你父母会让我们结婚吧。

en: He walked back and forth in front of the door, hesitating to enter.
cn: 他在门前走来走去，不知道该不该进去。

en: I don't like him any more than he likes me.
cn: 我们之间已经没有感情了。

en: I can't go along with you on that point.
cn: 我不同意你这个观点。

en: That problem has been shelved for the time being.
cn: 这个问题暂时放在一边。

en: A guest should not try to make himself superior to the host.
cn: 强宾不压主。

en: He is richer than anyone else in the town.
cn: 他是城里最有钱的人。

en: This box is not as big as that one.
cn: 这个盒子没那个盒子大。

en: It would be better for both of us not to see each other anymore.
cn: 我们还是不要再见面了。

en: If by any chance I'm late, please don't wait for me.
cn: 万一我来晚的话，就别等我了。

en: There is a bookstore in front of the department store.
cn: 百货商店前有个书店。

en: I simply haven't the time to do everything I want to do.
cn: 我有很多事想做，但就是没时间做。

en: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?
cn: 发展经济和保护环境哪一个更重要?

en: I'm tired; I think I'm going to go to bed.
cn: 我很累，我想我要去睡觉了。

en: No one knows if he loves her or not.
cn: 谁也不知道他是否爱她。

en: May I ask you to call me back later?
cn: 你等一会然后再给我打电话，可以吗？

en: When I go on vacation, I'll rent a car.
cn: 去度假的时候我要租辆车。

en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
cn: 菜单上有各种各样的菜色。

en: What is still better is that the house has a beautiful garden.
cn: 更棒的是房子还有一个漂亮的花园。

en: There was nothing but a desk in his room.
cn: 他的房间除了一张桌子，就甚么也没有了。

en: The point is whether she will come or not.
cn: 问题是她到底来还是不来。

en: The performers danced whilst singing - they performed extremely well.
cn: 演员们一边唱，一边跳，表演得好极了。

en: Have you decided whether you are going into town by bike or by bus?
cn: 你决没决定骑自行车还是坐公共汽车去城里？

en: Everyone says the food in this restaurant is both delicious and inexpensive.
cn: 大家说这家饭馆儿的菜又好吃又便宜。

en: We tried it out yesterday; as expected, it was really good.
cn: 我们昨天试了一下，果然是很好。

en: I will leave everything about the party up to you.
cn: 派对的准备工作就全交给你了。

en: Nancy is the most beautiful of the four girls.
cn: 四位姑娘之中最美的是南希。

en: In 2009, I had graduated from high school but I still hadn't started university.
cn: 二零零九年我高中毕业了可是还没上大学。

en: I've been feeling poorly for the last couple of days.
cn: 过去两天我觉得不太舒服。

en: In addition to a blocked nose, I'm also suffering from a high temperature.
cn: 除了鼻子不通以外，我还发着高烧。

en: The inverse of a non-square matrix is a dangerous thing.
cn: 非方矩阵的逆阵是一个危险的东西。

en: Would you like to have a cup of tea?
cn: 你想要一杯茶吗？

en: Because of heavy snow, the plane from Beijing arrived 20 minutes late.
cn: 由于下大雪，从北京来的班机延迟二十分钟。

en: I don't want to hear any more of your complaining.
cn: 我不想再听你抱怨了。

en: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.
cn: 一滴滴水能聚成湖泊。

en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word to us.
cn: 老师说明了词的意思。

en: He pulled with all his strength, but the rock would not move.
cn: 他用尽全力地拉，但那块大石还是纹丝不动。

en: You had better go to bed right away, or your cold will get worse.
cn: 你还是快点上床睡觉吧，不然感冒会愈来愈严重的。

en: It was not until three days after that I knew she had disappeared.
cn: 过了三天我才知道原来她失踪了。

en: I wonder if he can lend me his guitar during the vacation.
cn: 不知道他放假的时候可不可以把结他借给我呢？

en: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.
cn: 资本、土地和劳动是生产的三大要素。

en: To tell you the truth, I've been scolded by my mom.
cn: 老实说，我被我妈妈骂了。

en: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.
cn: 如果你离开日本，我会非常想你的。

en: Errors are few, if any, in his English composition.
cn: 他的英文作文没有甚么错处。

en: What? It's only eleven? We still have an hour to go before lunch.
cn: 甚么？现在才十一点？还有一个小时才吃饭呢。

en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
cn: 检查一下用户名和密码有没有填错。

en: My son is now as tall as I am.
cn: 我儿子现在和我一样高了。

en: The groom works for a company now, and the bride is our teacher.
cn: 新郎现在在一家公司工作，新娘是我们的老师。

en: We'd still never been to a Chinese person's wedding.
cn: 我们还从来没参加过中国人的婚礼呢。

en: We asked our teacher: "Can we come to your wedding?"
cn: 我们问老师：“我们可以参加你的婚礼吗？”

en: All she said was that we would know when the time came.
cn: 她只说到时候你们就知道了。

en: On the day of the wedding, we arrived at our teacher's house.
cn: 婚礼那天，我们来到老师家。

en: There were many guests - most of them were our teacher's classmates and friends.
cn: 客人很多，大部分都是老师的同学和朋友。

en: We asked our teacher: "Where will the wedding be held?"
cn: 我们问老师：“婚礼在哪里举行？”

en: The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.
cn: 老师和她爱人带着参加婚礼的人来到一个公园。

en: This park is pretty big; it has a lot of trees and many flowers.
cn: 这个公园不小，有很多树，还有很多花。

en: The teacher said to everyone: "Our wedding is starting now."
cn: 老师对大家说：“我们的婚礼现在开始。”

en: As everyone knows, today is a very significant day for us.
cn: 大家知道，今天对我们来说是一个很有意义的日子。

en: Everyone listened and was very happy, thinking this wedding was both original and meaningful.
cn: 大家听了，都很高兴，觉得这个婚礼又新颖又有意义。

en: Just then, the workers in the park brought over some small playing cards.
cn: 这时候公园里的工人拿来了一些小纸牌。

en: Underneath we wrote the names of the students in our class.
cn: 下面写上我们班同学的名字。

en: When he came and found me, his whole body reeked of alcohol.
cn: 他来找我的时候全身都是酒的味道。

en: I can't understand why James always finds fault with his wife.
cn: 我不懂得詹姆斯为什幺一直给他的妻子吹毛求疵。

en: I have to write a letter. Do you have some paper?
cn: 我需要写一封信。你有纸吗？

en: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
cn: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。

en: Would you like to go see a movie with me?
cn: 不如一起去看电影吧。

en: A man whose wife is dead is called a widower.
cn: 死了妻子的人叫做鳏夫。

en: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?
cn: 你钱或者信用卡带来没有？

en: Look at these two photographs - which one is better?
cn: 你看这两张照片哪张好？

en: Spaniards love to stroll around in the evening cool.
cn: 西班牙人最爱在晚上外出散散步、乘乘凉。

en: The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.
cn: 那位医生是儿童疾病的专家。

en: How can I make a telephone call to Japan?
cn: 请问怎样打电话到日本？

en: There's a great view from the rooftop of that building. Want to go see?
cn: 那座大厦天台的景色很美的，想去看看吗？

en: However you do it, the result will be the same.
cn: 你无论用甚么方法，结果都是一样。

en: It isn't easy to write a love letter in English.
cn: 用英文写情信不容易写得好。

en: There are all kinds of people in the world.
cn: 林子大了什幺鸟都有。

en: I bought this book for myself, not for my wife.
cn: 这本书我是买给自己的，不是买给老婆的。

en: The writer's furniture is all shown in this museum.
cn: 那位作家用过的家具全都存放在这间博物馆里。

en: Go along this street, and you'll find the movie theater.
cn: 沿着这条大道走，你就会找到电影院了。

en: I finished the work in less than an hour.
cn: 我用不到一小时就完成了这个工作。

en: I will give you a call as soon as I get home.
cn: 我一回到家就打电话给你。

en: Ms. Roland, what do you think about this problem?
cn: Roland女士，你对这个问题怎幺看？

en: While getting off the bus, she heard her name called.
cn: 她一下车，就听到有人叫她的名字。

en: Give me a reason for doing such a thing.
cn: 告诉我你为怎么要这样做。

en: I used to keep a diary when I was at high school.
cn: 我上中学的时候有写日记的习惯。

en: People say I look about the same age as my sister.
cn: 有人说我和妹妹看起来年纪差不多。

en: She ignored me even when she met me on the street.
cn: 她在街上看到我也不跟我打招呼。

en: All the doctor's efforts were in vain and the man soon died.
cn: 医生虽然已经竭尽全力，但不久病人还是死了。

en: Although he may be clever, he is not wise.
cn: 他只不过是有点小聪明。

en: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
cn: 我们这样待他，好像不是太好。

en: Not only did I eat pilaf, but I also ate kebabs.
cn: 我不但吃了抓饭，而且还吃了烤肉串。

en: We associate the name of Einstein with the theory of relativity.
cn: 一提到爱因斯坦，我们就会想起相对论。

en: I'm trying hard, but can't think of her name.
cn: 我怎么想也想不起她的名字。

en: How are you getting along with your English study?
cn: 你的英文学得如何？

en: I tried to open the door, and the doorknob came off.
cn: 我开门的时候把门柄扭了出来。

en: Los Angeles is one of the places that I'd like to visit.
cn: 洛杉矶是我想去的其中一个地方。

en: It is often said that nothing is more precious than time.
cn: 人们常说没有甚么比时间更重要。

en: I will never sell my friend down the river for anything in the world.
cn: 无论发生甚么事，我也绝对不会出卖我的朋友。

en: People used to think that only humans could use language.
cn: 以前人们以为只有人类才懂得用语言沟通。

en: I can't take it anymore! I haven't slept for three days!
cn: 我已经三天没睡觉了，真是困死了！

en: This dictionary is very expensive, but is worth buying.
cn: 这本字典虽然很贵，但还是值得买的。

en: If you don't watch out, you'll soon fall in the water.
cn: 如果你走路不看路，等一下你就会掉到水里面。

en: In our time, there were many students who passed the graduation exam without studying.
cn: 我那个年代的学生大多不读书，但考试却不会不合格。

en: The students receive a 15,000 euro scholarship for their return trip and daily expenses.
cn: 学生们每人有一万五千欧罗的奖学金，用来支付回程机票和其他日常的费用。

en: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
cn: 你对他说的话让他感觉好多了。

en: I got up early in order to catch the first train.
cn: 我为了乘头班火车，一大早就起了床。

en: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
cn: 他很聪明，但却不太帮得上忙。

en: The things in this village are cheaper than those in ours.
cn: 这条村的东西比我们村的便宜多了。

en: No matter how he tried, he could not open the door.
cn: 他用尽九牛二虎之力也开不了那道门。

en: How come you call on us so late at night?
cn: 你怎么这么晚才来看我们？

en: I hear that his father is in another country.
cn: 听说他父亲去了外国。

en: A good neighbour is better than a brother far off.
cn: 远亲不如近邻。

en: Whatever results may follow, I will carry out my plan.
cn: 无论结果会是怎样，我也不会改变我的计划。

en: How long does it take to walk from here to the station?
cn: 从这里步行到车站要多少时间？

en: The color of her dress and that of her shoes go well together.
cn: 她裙子和鞋子的颜色很配。

en: Call me at four; I must take the first train.
cn: 麻烦你在四时叫我起床。我一定要乘到头班火车。

en: The time will come when you will be sorry for it.
cn: 你一定会后悔的。

en: He is sure to pass the exam if he studies at this rate.
cn: 他保持现在这种速度温习的话，考试合格绝对没问题。

en: I had just written the letter when he came back.
cn: 他回来的时候，我刚好写完了信。

en: He has not come yet. Something may have happened to him.
cn: 他还没有来，不知道是不是发生了甚么意外？

en: This is the doctor whom I spoke of last night.
cn: 他就是我昨晚提过的那位医生。

en: I was mistaken in thinking that he was a trustworthy man.
cn: 我还以为他是个信得过的人。

en: Cross off the names of the people who have paid their dues.
cn: 麻烦你把付了钱的人的名字删掉。

en: She may be cute, but I don't like her.
cn: 她倒很可爱，但我不喜欢她。

en: It is important for him to get the job.
cn: 那份工作对他来说很重要。

en: I'm so tired that I can't walk any longer.
cn: 我累得走不动了。

en: Your help is indispensable for the success of the scheme.
cn: 没有你帮忙，计划就不能成功了。

en: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
cn: 这间游泳学校每个月的学费是多少？

en: After all, even the gods may err at times.
cn: 毕竟，即使是神也会偶尔出差错。

en: No one is working. Everyone's watching the World Cup.
cn: 谁也不工作。大家在看世界杯。

en: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
cn: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。

en: What do you say to taking a walk in the park?
cn: 去公园散步你觉得怎幺样？

en: A wise man would not say such a thing.
cn: 一个聪明人不会说这种话。

en: That man who is looking at you, do you know him?
cn: 那个看着你的男人，你认识吗 ?

en: You'll use the computer for studying, and not for playing games.
cn: 你们会用电脑是为了学习，不是为了玩游戏。

en: Since you're going to the supermarket, buy some eggs while you're there.
cn: 既然你要去超市，那就顺便买些鸡蛋吧。

en: The more you eat Kuqa's apricots, the more of them you'll want to eat.
cn: 库车的杏子你越吃越想吃。

en: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.
cn: 没有甚么比你做的菜更好吃了。

en: In looking through the mist, I caught a glimpse of my future.
cn: 透过薄雾，我隐约看见了我的未来。

en: When a friend comes from afar, is that not delightful?
cn: 有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎？

en: Could you please tell me how to get to the station?
cn: 请问火车站怎么走？

en: Hmm. I have a feeling I'm going to get lost whichever road I take.
cn: 唔。我有预感我走哪边都会迷路。

en: We're going up into the mountains, so why don't you come with us?
cn: 我们打算去登山，你也去吗？

en: Can you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
cn: 你能把最近的公车站指给我看吗?

en: He has only read 10 pages so far, I've already read 60.
cn: 在他只看了10页的时候，我已经看了60页了。

en: According to the weather report, the rainy season will start next week.
cn: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。

en: It is time for you to go to bed.
cn: 到了你该去睡觉的时候了。

en: In real combat, you must not forget that hesitation is a very dangerous thing.
cn: 在实战中，你要知道三心二意是很危险的。

en: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.
cn: 他甚至没说再见就离开了家。

en: I had no choice but to stay in bed all day.
cn: 我不得不一整天都待在床上。

en: Strictly speaking, the tomato is not a vegetable. It's a fruit.
cn: 严格来说，蕃茄不是蔬菜，是水果。

en: He worked day and night so that he might become rich.
cn: 他想成为有钱人，所以便从早到晚不断地工作。

en: As soon as she read the letter, she began to cry.
cn: 她一开始读那封信就哭了起来。

en: To him, hunger was an abstract concept; he always had enough to eat.
cn: 对他来说，「肚子饿」是个抽象的概念，因为他从来就没有饿过。

en: He is a member of the tennis club in our school.
cn: 他是学校网球俱乐部的成员。

en: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.
cn: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。

en: Does he go to school on foot or by bicycle?
cn: 他走路去学校还是骑车去学校？

en: I don't know when he came back from France.
cn: 我不知道他是什幺时候从法国回来的。

en: As a whole, the plan seems to be good.
cn: 从整体看，计划似乎很好。

en: There are a few shops next to my house.
cn: 我家旁边有几家商店。

en: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
cn: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

en: Do you have something that you want to say to me?
cn: 您有什幺事想对我说吗？

en: Do you want to know my secret? It's very simple...
cn: 你想不想知道我的秘密？它很简单……

en: She is more of an acquaintance than a friend.
cn: 与其说她是我的朋友，不如说她只是一个我认识的人。

en: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.
cn: 一名伟大的战士威力显着，无需抵死奋战。

en: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
cn: 这种物质很轻，可以浮在水面上。

en: The student became very nervous with the teacher watching him.
cn: 那个学生被老师盯着看，觉得浑身不自在。

en: While swimming in the pool, she lost her locker key.
cn: 她在游泳池游泳的时候把储物柜的钥匙弄丢了。

en: I haven't had a chance to see the movie yet.
cn: 我还没有机会看那部电影。

en: I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast.
cn: 我没吃早餐，所以肚子很饿。

en: Who was it that read my diary while I was out?
cn: 是谁趁我不在的时候看我的日记？

en: Come on, we'll be late if you don't hurry up.
cn: 快点快点，你还慢吞吞的话我们就要迟到了。

en: I don't care for smoking; it's bad for the health.
cn: 我不喜欢吸烟，因为吸烟对身体不好。

en: The man cheated the old woman out of her money.
cn: 他骗了老婆婆的钱。

en: He is one of the candidates running for mayor.
cn: 他是市长的候选人之一。

en: A little nap and, just like that, I'm as fresh as a daisy.
cn: 我小睡后就感到生龙活虎。

en: As he had no way of making fire, he ate the fish raw.
cn: 他没法生火，只好把鱼生吃。

en: The function of the brake is to stop the car.
cn: 刹车的功能是使车停下。

en: If you can use gravity to your advantage, do so.
cn: 你如果能利用重力，那就这幺做吧。

en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
cn: 万一来不了，我会先给你打电话。

en: Had I known about it, I would have told you.
cn: 如果我知道的话，我早就已经告诉你了。

en: The Amazon is the second longest river in the world after the Nile.
cn: 亚马逊河的长度仅次于尼罗河，是世界第二长的河。

en: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.
cn: 你变了那幺多，以至于我几乎认不出你了。

en: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.
cn: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。

en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
cn: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

en: This is the finest view I have ever seen.
cn: 这是我见过最美丽的景色。

en: It's a good rule to look both ways before you cross the street anywhere.
cn: 无论在甚么地方，过马路前也应该先看清楚左右。

en: There are only five minutes left till the train leaves and she hasn't appeared.
cn: 火车还有五分钟就要开了，她却还没有出现。

en: Thanks to television, boys and girls are apt to neglect reading books.
cn: 拜电视所赐，现在的小孩都不喜欢看书了。

en: He asked me my age, my name, my address, and so forth.
cn: 他问了我的年龄、姓名、地址等等。

en: I can't remember how to say "Thank you" in German.
cn: 我想不起「谢谢」用德语怎么说。

en: Showing your real feelings is not considered a virtue in Japan.
cn: 直率在日本人的眼中并不是一种美德。

en: Don't let the cops find a heater on you.
cn: 不要给警察发现你身上有枪。

en: He cannot be hungry; he has just had lunch.
cn: 他刚刚才吃完午饭，不可能会肚子饿。

en: Four-fifths of all the members were against the plan.
cn: 有五分之四的会员反对这个计划。

en: You and I are both students at this school.
cn: 你和我都是这个学校的学生们。

en: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
cn: 葡萄酒的味道很受天气影响。

en: Please drop in at my house on your way home.
cn: 你回家途中顺道来看看我吧。

en: I wonder if you don't get tired of doing the same thing every day.
cn: 你每天都是做一模一样的东西，难道不会觉得闷吗？

en: In the teeth of their strong opposition, we carried out our plan.
cn: 虽然受到他们的强烈反对，但我们还是实行了我们的计划。

en: How kind of him to help us move on such a rainy day!
cn: 下这么大的雨，也帮我们搬家，他人真好！

en: Mike is always nagging his father to buy him a car.
cn: 米克整天都在求爸爸买车给他。

en: It's been almost ten years, but you're as beautiful as ever.
cn: 过了差不多十年，你还是和以前一样漂亮。

en: Please let me pick up your sister at the station.
cn: 请让我到火车站去接你的姐姐。

en: The picture is colorful in contrast with this one.
cn: 和这幅比起上来，那幅画的色彩鲜艳多了。

en: I would rather work for any company than waste another year.
cn: 我宁愿到不喜欢的公司工作，也不想浑浑噩噩的又过一年。

en: You mustn't answer your mother back when she scolds you.
cn: 给母亲责骂的时候不要回嘴。

en: At the turn of the century, children still worked in factories.
cn: 虽然已经踏入了新世纪，但是工厂雇用童工的情况还是没有改善。

en: A camel is to the desert what a ship is to the sea.
cn: 骆驼是沙漠之舟。

en: The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.
cn: 电脑产业的发展一日千里。

en: You must consider what kind of work you want to do.
cn: 你一定要考虑清楚你想做怎么样的工作。

en: Put those flowers wherever we can see them well.
cn: 这些花放在哪里也没关系，显眼就行了。

en: The invention of TV caused a drastic change in our daily life.
cn: 电视的发明为我们的生活模式带来了巨大的变化。

en: The security level, as established by the Department of Homeland Security, is orange.
cn: 根据国土安全部的规定，目前的安全水准是橙色等级。

en: Where are you going to go on your vacation?
cn: 你放假打算去甚么地方玩呢？

en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中取得了冠军。

en: Did you have a lot of happy experiences in your childhood?
cn: 你小时候是不是有很多快乐的经历呢？

en: Students are forbidden to smoke on the school grounds.
cn: 学生不得在校园范围内吸烟。

en: Nowadays, almost every home has one or two televisions.
cn: 现在几乎每家每户也有一两台电视机了。

en: A plate of pilaf with some kebabs is heaven on earth.
cn: 一盘抓饭配一些烤肉串就是人间天堂。

en: Why do you go about being cross at people?
cn: 你为什幺要骂人家？

en: It's still early. We should all just chill for a bit.
cn: 时间还早着呢，大家坐下来侃一会儿吧。

en: The suits in this row are all made of imported European fabric.
cn: 这里一排都是进口面料欧版的西装。

en: This color is a bit darker than that one.
cn: 这种颜色比那种稍微深一点。

en: This tie has a more vibrant color and goes better with this suit.
cn: 这条领带颜色亮一点，跟这件西装比较配。

en: I think it's too expensive; besides, it doesn't even look that good...
cn: 我觉得价钱太贵，再说没什幺特别好看……

en: It's good now; neither too heavy nor too light.
cn: 现在正好，不重也不轻。

en: It's not even a little bit cheap, it's extremely expensive!
cn: 一点也不便宜，贵得不得了。

en: Wait just a little bit. It'll be done immediately.
cn: 稍微等一等，马上就好！

en: What is the size of this district's greenery area?
cn: 这里小区的绿地面积有多少？

en: For example, if I want to get downtown what bus should I take?
cn: 比如说，我要到市中心，有什幺车子可以坐吗？

en: The rental should be somewhat close to where I work.
cn: 租的房屋要离我工作地方近一点。

en: Yes, there are. How many of you are there, Sir?
cn: 有的，先生你有几位？

en: This is a three-star hotel; three hundred dollars a night.
cn: 这里是三星级宾馆，三百元住一晚。

en: How long would a train from Shanghai to Zhengzhou take?
cn: 从上海坐火车到郑州需几个小时？

en: I'm sorry, without an I.D. you cannot receive a remittance.
cn: 对不起，没有身份证是不能领汇款的。

en: Sir, I would like to deposit my money. How do I do that?
cn: 先生，我要存钱，怎幺存？

en: OK, what kind of place do you live at?
cn: 行。你住在什幺地方？

en: A small European shop opened inside. The ambience is great!
cn: 里面开了一个个欧式的小店，情调好极了！

en: Which of these two do you think is better?
cn: 你看这两种哪一种好？

en: Hey, how much does one pound of these oranges cost?
cn: 喂，这橘子多少钱买一斤啊？

en: What tea do you drink? Is lemon tea okay?
cn: 你要喝什幺茶？泡壶柠檬红茶好吧？

en: I just found out that he's sick, so I'll visit him later.
cn: 我刚知道你在生病，所以下了班来看望你。

en: Could you get a hammer for me from the kitchen please?
cn: 你到厨房里替我把一把锤子拿来。

en: Help me send out these two letters, all right?
cn: 你帮我把这两封信寄掉好吗？

en: The pain is here, right? That's a stomach ache.
cn: 这里疼是吗？那是胃痛。

en: It's ached before, but never as badly as right now.
cn: 痛过，但是没现在这幺厉害。

en: I feel a little nauseous, but I'm unable to throw up.
cn: 有点恶心，但是吐不出来。

en: These medicines should be taken three times a day.
cn: 这点药一天吃三次。

en: He's already retired but is often asked by them to consult.
cn: 已经退休了，但还常常被他们请去做顾问。

en: Even though it's busy today, this bit of work must be finished before leaving.
cn: 今天即使再忙，也要做完这些事情才走。

en: Either as a waiter at a restaurant or a bartender, both are OK.
cn: 做餐馆服务员啊、酒吧招待员啊，都可以。

en: Sure I can, although I can't really speak Shanghainese.
cn: 当然会的，不过上海话不太会讲。

en: Please fill out this form and wait for us to notify you.
cn: 请你把这张表填一下，等我们的通知。

en: Do not talk nonsense, My job is very boring!
cn: 不是瞎说，我这份工作真是没劲！

en: If I have time and enough money, I'd want to go traveling in Europe.
cn: 如果我有时间有钱，我要到欧洲去旅游。

en: Some Shanghainese hold large banquets when they get married.
cn: 上海人结婚，有的人家办酒宴场面很大。

en: One must be respectful when speaking, and not say obscene things.
cn: 开口要有礼貌，不讲下流话。

en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.
cn: 绿灯时，拐弯车要让人。

en: Native Chinese people are working alongside foreigners to change the culture of Shanghai.
cn: 本地人、外来人齐心共创上海新文明。

en: I remember his face but I can't remember his name.
cn: 我记得他的长相但忘了他叫甚么名字。

en: Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang are an unbeatable team.
cn: 刘备和诸葛亮是一支无法战胜的队伍。

en: What sort of coats are in fashion this year?
cn: 今年流行甚么款式的外套？

en: We've been having strange weather the past few years.
cn: 这几年的天气很反常。

en: If you are going to the safari park, take the No.5 bus.
cn: 你想去野生动物园就乘五号巴士吧。

en: His plan is to build a bridge over that river.
cn: 他的计划是在那条河上建一座桥。

en: The two men were seen to steal into the house.
cn: 那两个人偷偷溜进了房子里，给人看见了。

en: I suggest that you should write him a thank-you letter.
cn: 我觉得你应该给他写一封感谢信。

en: I often used to play tennis with him on Sundays.
cn: 我以前星期天常常和他去打网球。

en: I feel like going out rather than staying at home today.
cn: 我今天想外出，不想留在家中。

en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
cn: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。

en: It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.
cn: 在这么急的急流里游泳，一定会很危险的。

en: Don't forget to take your umbrella when you leave.
cn: 你出门的时候别忘了带伞。

en: All you have to do is sign your name here.
cn: 你在这里签个名就行了。

en: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
cn: 算一算你花了多少钱买书。

en: Do you think you can live on a dollar a day in America?
cn: 你觉得你在美国每天只用一美元能生活吗？

en: He would be very glad to hear the news.
cn: 他听到这个消息，一定会很高兴。

en: Not a few houses were destroyed by the typhoon.
cn: 台风吹毁了很多房屋。

en: I'll lend you the book, provided you return it next week.
cn: 如果你可以在下个星期还给我的话，这本书就借给你吧。

en: We have pilaf, lo mein, and kebabs in our restaurant.
cn: 在我们的饭店抓饭，拌面，烤肉串都有。

en: In America, the consumption of fast-food has tripled between 1977 and 1995.
cn: 美国人快餐食物的消耗量在一九七七至一九九五年间大幅增长了三倍。

en: She does not eat cake, so as not to put on any more weight.
cn: 她不想一直胖下去，所以正在戒吃蛋糕。

en: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.
cn: 我把他叫做「矮子」，他就气得不得了。

en: Had they known what was about to happen, they would have changed their plans.
cn: 如果他们知道会发生那样的事，一定会改用别的计划的。

en: We hurried to the airport only to miss the plane.
cn: 我们匆匆忙忙的赶到机场，飞机却已经起飞了。

en: I mean to go tomorrow if the weather is fine.
cn: 如果天气好的话，我打算明天出发。

en: Let's have lunch downtown and take in a show.
cn: 我们去市区吃饭，然后再看场电影吧。

en: If you leave now, I'm sure you'll be caught in a traffic jam.
cn: 你现在出门的话，肯定会堵车的。

en: Whether Shakespeare wrote this poem or not will probably remain a mystery.
cn: 这首诗是不是莎士比亚写的，恐怕是无从考究的了。

en: After a while, the man came into the room.
cn: 过了一会，那人就走进了房间。

en: I'm not a real fish, I'm just a mere plushy.
cn: 我不是一条真的鱼，我只是一个长毛绒玩具。

en: Red and blue - which one do you like?
cn: 红色和蓝色，你喜欢那一个?

en: The Shinano River is longer than any river in Japan.
cn: 信浓川比日本的任何一条河川更长。

en: Put your name on the notebook in case you forget it.
cn: 在笔记本上写上你的名字吧，这样就不怕弄不见了。

en: I usually ride my bike to school. I mean to the office.
cn: 我通常踏单车上学⋯⋯啊，说错了，应该是上班才对。

en: Judging from her appearance, I think that she's rich.
cn: 从她的外表上看，我想她大半是个有钱人。

en: She has three sisters: one is a nurse and the other two are teachers.
cn: 她有三个姊妹，一个是护士，另外的两个是教师。

en: I will never tell a lie from now on.
cn: 我从今以后不会再说谎了。

en: You should turn in your term papers by the end of April.
cn: 请在四月底之前交上你的学期报告。

en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.
cn: 虽然天气很冷，但那小孩也没有穿外套。

en: I felt as if I were an uninvited guest.
cn: 我觉得自己像是不请自来似的。

en: Fashions of thirty years ago have come back in style.
cn: 三十年前的时装款式又流行起来了。

en: She's only two years old, but she can already count to 100.
cn: 她只有两岁，但她已经会数到100了。

en: The train is going at a speed of 50 miles per hour.
cn: 火车以每小时50英里的速度前行。

en: What do you want to do while you're here?
cn: 你在这儿的时候想做什幺？

en: In the summer, we're used to going swimming in the river.
cn: 夏天我们习惯去河里游泳。

en: I found a pot in which there were several old coins.
cn: 我找到一个装有几枚古钱币的锅子。

en: They heard a gun go off in the distance.
cn: 他们听到远处传来一下枪声。

en: The lecture was very long, but I enjoyed it none the less.
cn: 那场演讲很长，但我却听得津津有味。

en: John asked Mary whether she would like to go shopping in the afternoon.
cn: 约翰问玛莉下午想不想一起去买东西。

en: No pro golfer in Japan is as popular as Jumbo Ozaki.
cn: 尾崎将司是日本最受欢迎的专业高尔夫球手。

en: The Alpinists carried out the ascent, but they did not return safely.
cn: 登山者成功登上了山顶，但回程时却出了意外。

en: You can get a fine view of the sea from the mountaintop.
cn: 从山顶上可以欣赏到秀丽的海景。

en: This flower is yellow, but all the others are blue.
cn: 这朵花是黄色的，但是其他全都是蓝色的。

en: Parents have responsibilities to look to their children's health.
cn: 父母有责任照顾子女的健康。

en: Yesterday I was caught in a shower on my way home from school.
cn: 我昨天放学回家的时候突然下起了大雨。

en: Please don't get mad, sir! I'm a new worker!
cn: 先生，请别生我的气！我是新来的工人！

en: How do people manage to sleep on the plane?
cn: 人们怎幺能在飞机上睡觉？

en: If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!
cn: 若有大地震，房屋会倒塌呀！

en: Just as if it were my tail, wherever I go, it goes too.
cn: 它就像我的尾巴一样，我去哪里它就去哪里。

en: He could not help jumping for joy at the good news.
cn: 他听到那个好消息，高兴得跳了起来。

en: India is the seventh largest country in the world.
cn: 印度是世界第七大的国家。

en: I didn't like rock music at first, but it soon grew on me.
cn: 我本来对摇滚乐没甚么好感，但后来却渐渐喜欢上了。

en: For some reason or other I cannot bring myself to work.
cn: 不知怎么我总是没心情工作。

en: It was obvious that they had told a lie.
cn: 他们分明说了谎。

en: It looks like rain. We had better shut the windows.
cn: 好像快要下雨了。我们把窗关上吧。

en: A job that you don't love is... a job.
cn: 一份我们不喜欢的工作就是。。。一份工作。

en: Never trust a woman with a pistol in hand.
cn: 千万别相信一个手里拿手枪的女人。

en: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.
cn: 我请妈妈四点叫我起床。

en: The boy could not so much as write his own name.
cn: 那男孩连自己的名字也不会写。

en: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
cn: 南非的祖鲁族人有着自己独特的语言。

en: Let me see the pictures you took in Paris.
cn: 给我看看你在巴黎拍的照片吧。

en: He is said to have been the richest man in the village.
cn: 据说他以前是整个村子最有钱的人。

en: I like this skirt. May I try it on?
cn: 这条裙子挺漂亮的，可以试穿吗？

en: Which is the capital of the United States, Washington or New York?
cn: 美国的首都是华盛顿还是纽约？

en: He went out of the room without being noticed by anyone.
cn: 他静悄悄地走出了房间，谁也没有发现。

en: You are a good tennis player, as beginners go.
cn: 以初学者来说，你打网球已经算是打得不错了。

en: It took me five minutes to solve the problem.
cn: 我用五分钟就算好了那道题。

en: I didn't answer your letter, because I was busy.
cn: 我是因为太忙，所以才没有回信给你的。

en: I may have left my umbrella in the bus.
cn: 我可能把雨伞留在公车上了。

en: The old couple embarked on a tour around the world.
cn: 老夫妇出发去环游世界了。

en: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
cn: 你的作文非常好，而且错误很少。

en: Oh, could you please answer the phone for me?
cn: 哦，能不能请你帮我听一下电话？

en: We looked out the window, but we didn't see anything.
cn: 我们看了窗外，但什幺都没看见。

en: I need to configure this server with an appropriate firewall system.
cn: 我该在这个服务器上设置一个防火墙。

en: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
cn: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

en: I'm not sure as to when he will turn up.
cn: 我不知道他甚么时候会出现。

en: I must give back the book to him by tomorrow.
cn: 我一定要在明天前把书还给他。

en: He managed to pass his driving test even though he was a poor driver.
cn: 他的驾驶技术很差，但也勉强通过了驾驶考试。

en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
cn: 我父母整天都在为鸡毛蒜皮的事情吵架，真是烦死人了！

en: That's the best approach to the study of English.
cn: 那是学英语最好的方法。

en: I can hear you, but I can't see you.
cn: 我听得见你，但我看不见你。

en: I want to leave this difficult job to her.
cn: 我想让她干这项艰难的工作。

en: Beth has a strong habit of interrupting people while they are talking.
cn: 贝丝很喜欢在别人说话的时候插嘴。

en: It is essential that every child have the same educational opportunities.
cn: 每一个孩子都应该享有平等的学习机会。

en: I have a lot of flowers. Some are red and some are yellow.
cn: 我种了很多花，有些是红色的，有些是黄色的。

en: She lived in five different countries by age 25.
cn: 她二十五岁时已经在五个不同的国家住过。

en: He left his parents when he was eight years old.
cn: 他八岁时离开了他的父母。

en: Man is the only animal that can make use of fire.
cn: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。

en: We have a cat. We are all fond of it.
cn: 我们有一只猫。我们都喜欢猫。

en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
cn: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

en: At that time, Mexico was not yet independent of Spain.
cn: 那个时候，墨西哥还没有独立于西班牙。

en: I need to go home a little early today.
cn: 我今天要早点回家。

en: There's a lot of stuff in our lo mein.
cn: 我们的拌面里有好多东西。

en: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
cn: 虽然我住在她家附近，可是也很少见到她。

en: To love and to be loved is the greatest happiness.
cn: 爱和被爱是人生最大的乐事。

en: Most Swiss people can speak three or four languages.
cn: 瑞士人大多能说三、四种语言。

en: It is not until you go abroad that you realize how small Japan is.
cn: 你出国看看，才会知道日本是多么的细小。

en: It may safely be said that he will never succeed in business.
cn: 我可以肯定的说，他做生意一定永远不会成功。

en: He must be fined if he breaks the law.
cn: 如果他犯了罪，他应该受到惩罚。

en: I think a film is more interesting than any book.
cn: 我觉得一部电影比任何书都有趣。

en: It was in 1939 that the Second World War broke out.
cn: 第二次世界大战是在1939年开始的。

en: Go along this street and turn right at the bank.
cn: 请沿着这条路走，在银行那里向右转。

en: In Singapore, one way to punish a criminal is to whip him or her.
cn: 在新加坡，鞭刑是处置犯人的方法之一。

en: We had to pay ten thousand yen in addition.
cn: 我们还得付多一万日元。

en: The pilaf with meat is eight yuan. The vegetarian pilaf is only four yuan.
cn: 抓饭肉是八块钱。素抓饭只是四块钱。

en: If you bite me, then I'll bite you, too.
cn: 你如果咬我，我也要咬你。

en: When I try to walk, I get an awful pain here.
cn: 我一走路，这里就很痛。

en: It will take him two hours to finish the work.
cn: 我想他得花两个小时才能把工作做完。

en: We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
cn: 我们今年和不少强队交过手。

en: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
cn: 花瓶在桌上留下了水迹。

en: You're right. The noodle broth here is a bit expensive.
cn: 您说得对。这里的面汤比较贵。

en: It may not be clean, but you won't get sick from eating it.
cn: 不干不净，吃了没病。

en: The two brothers are quite unlike in their appearance.
cn: 哥哥和弟弟的样子一点也不像。

en: The reason why we cannot support his view will be given below.
cn: 以下是我们不支持他的看法的理由。

en: The man passed by without so much as glancing at her.
cn: 那人连瞧也不瞧她一眼就走过了。

en: I decided to go to college to major in English.
cn: 我决定上大学主修英语。

en: He who would the daughter win, with the mother must begin.
cn: 想要得到女儿，就必须从她母亲那儿开始努力。

en: Don't you think the air conditioner is turned up too high in here?
cn: 你不觉得这房里的冷气太强了吗？

en: I was surprised at the news of his sudden death.
cn: 他突然过世的消息让我感到惊讶。

en: The tree is about as high as the roof.
cn: 这棵树和屋顶差不多一样高。

en: Why don't you drop in for tea at your convenience?
cn: 你有空的时候来喝杯茶吧。

en: On a clear day, you can see Mt. Fuji.
cn: 睛天的时候，就可以看见富士山了。

en: I hurried to the house only to find it empty.
cn: 我匆匆忙忙的赶到那房子去，但却发现里面原来是空的。

en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
cn: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。

en: This book is difficult to read as it is written in French.
cn: 因为是用法文写的，所以这本书很难读。

en: Seems like I'm the third wheel here. I should go.
cn: 好像我成电灯泡了。我该走了。

en: He worked hard for peace for these ten years.
cn: 这十年间，他为了和平尽力。

en: Tom, who had been working all day, wanted to have a rest.
cn: 工作了一整天的汤姆想要休息一下。

en: A punch is just a punch. A kick is just a kick.
cn: 出拳就是出拳。出脚就是出脚。

en: She's thinking of taking a couple of courses at a cooking school.
cn: 她打算去烹饪学校上几堂课。

en: This book is a result of his enthusiastic research.
cn: 这本书是他热心研究的成果。

en: The soldiers fought valiantly, but finally they had to give in.
cn: 士兵作战时毫无畏缩，但到了最后还是不得不投降。

en: Who is the boy that is swimming over there?
cn: 在那边游泳的男孩是谁？

en: It's already eleven o'clock. I must be leaving now.
cn: 现在已经十一时了。我一定要走了。

en: This form looks kind of complicated. Help me fill it out.
cn: 这个表格好像有点复杂，你可以帮我填吗？

en: The soldiers were ready to die for their country.
cn: 士兵们已经准备好为国牺牲了。

en: That's too small a box to hold all these things.
cn: 那个箱子太小了，放不下这里这么多东西。

en: This is the most beautiful flower in the garden.
cn: 这朵是整个花园最漂亮的花。

en: Didn't you know that he passed away two years ago?
cn: 你不知道他两年前死了吗？

en: I don't think it's possible to finish that amount of work in one day.
cn: 我觉得很难用一天就做完这么多的工作。

en: Lao Gan Ma and I have a love-hate relationship.
cn: 我和老干妈有爱恨交加的关系。

en: I find it difficult to do all this work in a day.
cn: 我觉得很难用一天时间做完所有这些工作。

en: Mary is at a loss what to say to him.
cn: 玛莉不知道该和他说甚么才好。

en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
cn: 总的来说，我对这个结果很满意。

en: So friendly was his letter that she was deeply moved and began to cry.
cn: 他的信写得很亲切，她读了以后不禁感动得哭了起来。

en: I got up early enough to catch the first train.
cn: 我起了个大早为了赶第一班火车。

en: I feel like the window was open all night.
cn: 我感觉窗子一整晚都开着。

en: City dwellers have a higher death rate than country people do.
cn: 城市居民的死亡率高于农村里的人。

en: It has been two years since he went over to America to study English.
cn: 他去美国学英文已经有两年的时间了。

en: He tried to kill himself but it ended in failure.
cn: 他试图自杀，但是失败了。

en: You look as if you don't have a care in the world.
cn: 你看似对这世间已了无牵挂。

en: I'm in Boston going for my Ph.D. right now.
cn: 我正在在波士顿读博士。

en: This coffee is too hot for me to drink.
cn: 这咖啡热得我没办法喝。

en: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.
cn: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。

en: My right hand is Uighur, and my left is Han.
cn: 我的右手是维族的，左手是汉族的。

en: I need to go to the China Construction Bank.
cn: 我需要去一趟中国建设银行。

en: He stretched out his arm to take the book.
cn: 他伸长了手臂为了能拿到书。

en: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
cn: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。

en: Mr Suzuki, as far as I know, has not returned from Hawaii yet.
cn: 就我所知，铃木先生还没从夏威夷回来。

en: When Michael is at home, his work is to clean the windows.
cn: 在家里，麦克的工作就是擦窗户。

en: My train left at 7 and arrived in New York at 10.
cn: 我乘的火车7点出发，10点到了纽约。

en: Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?
cn: 猫在椅子上面，还是在椅子下面呢？

en: They lost their way; otherwise, they would have arrived long ago.
cn: 他们肯定是迷路了，不然他们应该已经到了很久了。

en: If I had eaten breakfast this morning, I would not be hungry now.
cn: 如果我今早吃了早餐，现在肚子就不会这么饿了。

en: These plants are too small. I don't think that they'll grow.
cn: 这些植物太小了，我觉得它们长不大。

en: In China, there's a saying that you can't judge a person by appearance.
cn: 在中国有一种说法：人不可貌相。

en: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
cn: 我想请你帮我整理花园。

en: We will tidy up our room so that Mom is satisfied.
cn: 我们将要整理房间，这样妈妈就会满意了。

en: We spent a lot of time looking for a parking lot.
cn: 我们花了很长时间找停车场。

en: After a six month period, his leg was healed and is normal again.
cn: 过了六个月，他的腿便治好，回复正常了。

en: There are some cases where the rule does not hold good.
cn: 有些情况之下，这条规则不能成立。

en: I have a friend whose father is a famous pianist.
cn: 我有一个朋友，他的父亲是位名钢琴家。

en: My uncle lives in Madrid, the capital of Spain.
cn: 我叔叔住在西班牙的首都马德里。

en: If you don't want to stay alone, I can keep you company.
cn: 如果你不想一个人呆着，我可以陪着你。

en: When you leave the bathroom, you should wash your hands.
cn: 离开厕所前应该洗手。

en: Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
cn: 偶数乘以奇数是偶数，奇数乘以奇数是奇数。

en: Adam was furious with me when I broke his watch.
cn: 我把亚当的手表弄坏了，气得他七窍生烟。

en: This is the pen that he signed the document with.
cn: 这就是他用来签署那份文件的笔了。

en: The plan was given up under the pressure of public opinion.
cn: 计划受到舆论的压力而被取消了。

en: You may take this book as long as you keep it clean.
cn: 你可以拿走这本书，但可别把它弄脏了。

en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.
cn: 箱子的内容在标签上面写着。

en: I heard the news that there had been a big earthquake in Awaji.
cn: 我听到了淡路发生大地震的消息。

en: I think it's you who should apologize to her.
cn: 我觉得应该向她道歉的人是你。

en: It's time for you to buy a new car.
cn: 你该买一辆新车了。

en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
cn: 人类适应环境变化的能力很强。

en: I would buy the car, but I am poor.
cn: 我想买那辆车，可是我却没有钱。

en: It is a pity that he has no sense of humor.
cn: 可惜他是一个完全没有幽默感的人。

en: The aim of this game is to explode all the bombs on the screen.

cn: 委员会是由三男七女组成的。

cn: 飞机开始震动的时候，乘客们都紧张了起来。

cn: 两位跑手同时到达了终点线。

cn: 她是在一九九零年七月十七日的早上六时出生的。

cn: 我记得那个人的样子，但是我却想不起他的名字。

cn: 塔夫斯大学是波士顿一家十分有名的大学。

cn: 虽然食物不怎么好吃，但是派对在其它方面办得很出色。

cn: 我上课的时候放屁，被老师赶出了班房。

en: Maybe I shouldn't tell you this, but I am truly mesmerized by your beauty.
cn: 我或许不应该告诉你，但我真的被你的美丽迷倒了。

en: He wants to come along with us to the movie.
cn: 他想和我们一起去看电影。

en: You must do it even if you don't want to.

cn: 我们很快就可以知道事情的真相了。

en: The problem is whether my parents will agree or not.
cn: 问题是我爸爸妈妈会不会同意。

cn: 十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十、一百。

en: Who do you think came to see me yesterday?
cn: 你才昨天谁来找我了？

en: Spring is here. It is getting warmer every day.
cn: 春天来了，越来越温暖。

cn: 世界人口将在不久的将来增加两倍。

cn: 男子从口袋中掏出枪，吓了我一跳。

en: It took me 2 hours to finish the essay.
cn: 这篇作文花了我两个小时来完成。

en: If you sleep for a while, you will feel much better.
cn: 小睡一会儿，你会好一些。

cn: 与其向命运妥协，我宁可自杀。

cn: 有些人认为阅读简直浪费时间。

en: She has decided to live in America for good.
cn: 她决定长期住在美国。

cn: 如果仍然有人缺席的，请将名单发给我。

en: I do not think that she is at home.
cn: 我想她不会在家里。

cn: 地球大约每三百六十五天就会围绕太阳旋转一周。

cn: 如果有一天你走了，我会很难过的。

cn: 我保证在一个星期内把这盘录影带还给你。

en: How far is it to the library from here?
cn: 图书馆离这里有多远？

cn: 他没帮助我的话，我就失败了。

en: New York is the biggest city in the world.
cn: 纽约是世界上最大的城市。

en: The climate of Tokyo is different from that of London.
cn: 东京的气候和伦敦不同。

en: We have a single for 50 dollars per night.
cn: 我们有一间五十美元一晚的单人房。

cn: 我去年夏天到访的是一个位于长野县的小村落。

en: They regarded him as the best doctor in town.
cn: 他们把他视为城里最好的医生。

en: It was near the river that I lost my way.
cn: 我迷路的时候，我就在河边。

en: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
cn: 你们很幸运有这样的朋友们。

en: I don't know whether he will come or not.
cn: 我不知道他会不会来。

en: My father does not like the heat of summer.
cn: 我爸爸不喜欢夏天炎热的天气。

en: The body quickly adjusts itself to changes in temperature.
cn: 人体能够快速地适应气温的转变。

en: The examples in this dictionary are easy to understand.
cn: 这本字典的例句十分浅白易懂。

cn: 就算是全世界跑得最快的人，也要吃饱了才跑得动。

en: You have to go there whether you like it or not.
cn: 无论你想去还是不想去，你也要去。

cn: 这部恐怖片很吓人，我一看就睡不着觉了。

cn: 最近的一项调查显示吸烟的人数减少了。

en: I asked him not to play the piano late at night.
cn: 我叫他不要太晚弹钢琴。

en: I will get in touch with him as soon as possible.
cn: 我会尽快和他联络。

en: I love her all the more for her faults.
cn: 她的缺点让我更爱她。

en: Being sick in bed, my father can't see you.
cn: 我爸爸病了，正在床上休息，不能见你。

en: My father took me to a movie last night.
cn: 我爸爸昨天带了我去看电影。

en: Monkeys kill people too, but only if they have guns.
cn: 猴子也会杀人 ﹣ 如果牠们有枪的话。

cn: 很多日本人都会在元旦到神社参拜。

cn: 你越是吃巧克力，越是会变胖。

en: I hear the grass in England is green even in the winter.
cn: 我听说英国的草在冬天也还是绿的。

cn: 我不知道该怎么回答，便干脆甚么也不说。

en: There was a large harvest of peaches last year.
cn: 去年桃子丰收。

en: You are not to speak to him while he is studying.
cn: 你不应该在他温习的时候和他说话。

en: Is it true that your family will travel in Hokkaido? I envy you.
cn: 你们家去北海道旅游是真的幺？我羡慕你。

en: I do not know if it will rain tomorrow.
cn: 我不知道明天会不会下雨。

en: The cows were moving very slowly through the long green grass.
cn: 牛群在郁郁葱葱的草地上缓缓移动着。

en: More than a third of the world population lives near a coast.
cn: 全世界有超过三分之一的人在沿岸地区居住。

en: The Pacific is the largest ocean in the world.
cn: 太平洋是世界上最大的海洋。

en: There were not more than one hundred passengers on board the ferry.
cn: 渡轮上的乘客不多于一百人。

en: I don't eat supper because I want to lose some weight.
cn: 我不吃晚饭因为我想减肥。

en: I went to the hospital to see my wife.
cn: 我去医院看了我的老婆。

en: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.
cn: 对啊，她以前是一个很害羞的女孩。

cn: 政府用直升机把物资送到了那个小岛。

cn: 教法语的是怀特老师，不是格林老师。

en: She is curious to find who sent the flowers.
cn: 她很想知道那束花是谁寄来的。

en: It was so hot that I got into the shade and took a rest.
cn: 因为天气很热，所以我就走到阴凉的地方歇了一会儿。

cn: 他和她之间的友谊，渐渐地酝酿成了爱情。

en: Who am I? How did I come to be?
cn: 我是谁？我是怎样来到这个世界的？

cn: 他对我说：「请你帮我一个忙。」

cn: 我在街上听到有人叫我的名字。

en: Every player is under obligation to keep the rules.
cn: 每一位选手都有义务遵守规则。

en: Add a little more milk to my tea, please.
cn: 请再在我的茶里加点牛奶。

cn: 我到处都看了，可还是没找到我的皮夹。

cn: 公园里有一个漂亮的黑发姑娘。

cn: 他说他让你说慢一点。

en: Some of the apples in the box were rotten.
cn: 盒子里的一些苹果烂了。

en: Every time I listen to this song, I cry.
cn: 我每次听这首歌都会听到哭。

en: He is the last person to speak ill of others.
cn: 他绝不是说人坏话的人。

en: A great number of citizens went into the army.
cn: 许多老百姓加入了军队。

en: These three pretty girls are all nieces of mine.
cn: 这三个漂亮的女孩都是我的侄女。

cn: 白兔的耳朵比狐狸长。

cn: 暴风雨过后，那条路被倒下来的树堵住了。

en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
cn: 我在银行附近碰见老朋友。

en: I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
cn: 我在你的生日会送给你一辆自行车。

en: I have the same dictionary as your brother has.

en: He wants to be a policeman in the future.
cn: 他将来想当警察。

cn: 是谁忘了把仓库的门锁上？

en: The fire station is next to the police station.
cn: 消防局在警察局的旁边。

en: I didn't understand in the least what he said.
cn: 他说的话我一句也听不懂。

cn: 他虽然摆着一副若无其事的样子，但是我想他心里一定担心得不得了。

cn: 他主张的是出生的先后次序和个性有很密切的关系。

cn: 我生病了，我在家待了一整天。

cn: 如果他继续这样喝酒，他该乘出租车回家。

cn: 你去年写了多少张圣诞卡？

cn: 抢劫银行的后果就是在监狱里蹲十年。

cn: 我打算买一台照相机给我的女儿。

cn: 好多朋友和熟人来了。

cn: 他一如往常，没有剃胡子就上班去了。

cn: 日本人一般都觉得自己的生活比以前过得好。

cn: 我想用这块手表换一块便宜一点的。

cn: 从来就没有什幺救世主， 也不靠神仙皇帝！

cn: 他前天拜会了法国总统。

cn: 在情人节，我用玫瑰花瓣拼出了我的另一半的名字。

cn: 找到一位能够代替他的人不会是容易的任务。

cn: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。

cn: 男孩收集了一把花生，然后把它们放到了一个小箱子里。

cn: 他用双手抱着一个大箱子。

en: I found this book interesting from beginning to end.
cn: 我觉得这本书从头到尾都很有趣。

cn: 发生了那件事以后，那位政治家一直没有公开露面。

cn: 姐姐在市场买了一点茄子、土豆、丝瓜和大白菜。

en: A man's will is nothing when compared to that of the heavens.
cn: 人算不如天算。

en: One may only catch the tiger cub by entering the tiger's den.
cn: 不入虎穴，焉得虎子。

en: I see him in the library now and then.
cn: 有时我会在图书馆看见他。

en: In the United States, cars drive on the right‐hand side of the road.
cn: 在美国，汽车靠右行驶。

en: His elder sister is older than my eldest brother.
cn: 他姐姐比我哥哥大。

en: There is no telling what will happen in the future.

en: Of us all, Tom was by far the best swimmer.
cn: 汤姆的泳术比我们所有人都要好得多。

cn: 谁都想活得长久，但没人想变老。

cn: 大家帮我这幺大的忙，真心向大家道谢。

cn: 知道你在那里过得不错，我替你感到高兴。

en: I haven't heard from you for a long time.

cn: 我最近真忙于我的毕业论文。

cn: 我们要连胜七局，才能在这场锦标赛中夺得冠军。

cn: 我得到一个结论 ﹣ 我被骗了。

en: To the best of my knowledge, the lake is the deepest here.
cn: 据我所知，这里是整个湖最深的地方。

cn: 他奋不顾身地把遇溺的男孩救了起来。

cn: 我的家离地铁站很近，走路只要五分钟就到了。

cn: 这本是我读过最好的书。
