cn: 如果你有一百万円，你会用它来做甚么？

en: Canada is a good place to go if it's your first experience living abroad.
cn: 如果你是第一次到外国生活的话，加拿大会很适合你。

en: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
cn: 很多公司实行8小时工作制。

en: The style of this item of clothing is good; it's just a bit expensive.
cn: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。

en: It's still not certain who's going to win this match.
cn: 谁能赢这场比赛还说不定。

en: My work at the TV station is handling letters written in by viewers.
cn: 我在电视台的工作就是处理观众们写来的信。

en: The population of China has already exceeded 1.3 billion.
cn: 中国的人口已经超过了十三亿。

en: With the T.V. on, how can you keep your mind on your studies?
cn: 你开着电视怎幺能安心学习呢？

en: No matter how hard I strive, I fail to achieve my parents' requirements.
cn: 不管我怎幺努力，也达不到父母的要求。

en: Whilst at university, Xiaowang held the post of class monitor.
cn: 上大学的时候，小王担任过班长。

en: From graduation to retirement, Laowang worked as a teacher without intermission.
cn: 从大学毕业到退休，老王一直担任教学工作。

en: I often go out with friends in the evening.
cn: 我常常在晚上跟朋友出去玩儿。

en: He had the impudence to cut across our garden.
cn: 他竟然厚着脸皮穿过我们的花园。

en: Scott first changed a watch for a book, then the book for money.
cn: Scott先用一只手表换了一本书，再把书换成钱。

en: They planned to get together here at 7 o'clock.
cn: 他们约了七点在这儿碰头。

en: Looking back at 2010, I think I wasted too much time.
cn: 回顾2010年，我认为我浪费太多时间了。

en: My hope for the new year is to study harder.
cn: 我新年的新希望是更努力地学习。

en: In my view, studying hard is the best way to achieve success.
cn: 对我来说，努力学习就是最好取得成功的办法。

en: It is rumoured that a spaceship has been seen near Shanghai.
cn: 谣传一架宇宙飞船在上海附近被见到了。

en: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.
cn: 他是个性格强、稳定且可靠的男人。

en: At first I did not like rock music, but now I do.
cn: 我起初不怎么喜欢摇滚音乐，不过现在喜欢上了。

en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
cn: 有的科学家认为温室效应是虚构的。

en: Melting polar icecaps could also contribute to an increase in sea levels.
cn: 融化中的极地冰盖也可以使海平面上涨的势态更加严重。

en: People living on coastlines might lose their homes, and cities might be completely submerged.
cn: 住在海边的人可能失去他们的家，并且城市可能会被完全淹没。

en: Parts of the world that are already hot enough might become unbearably so.
cn: 世界上已经够热的地方会变得让人无法忍受。

en: Hot weather doesn’t just mean that people feel a little unhappy.
cn: 热天气不仅仅意味着人们觉得有点不高兴。

en: It can make some people, especially the elderly and infants, very ill.
cn: 它可以使一些人，尤其是老人和婴幼儿，病得很重。

en: Use a dictionary to find the meanings of the phrases below.
cn: 用字典查出下面词组的意思。

en: The abbreviation of "Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference" is "CPPCC".
cn: “中国人民政治协商会议”的简称是“人民政协”。

en: The qipao is a classic female garment that originated in 17th century China.
cn: 旗袍是一种17世纪起源于中国的传统式样的女性服装。

en: He learnt the periodic table by heart just for fun.
cn: 他背周期表只是为了好玩。

en: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
cn: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。

en: Please bear with me until I finish the story.
cn: 请容许我把故事讲完。

en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
cn: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界纪录。

en: The term "qipao" is widely used in Northern China.
cn: “旗袍”这个词语在中国北方广为使用。

en: In Southern China, the qipao is also known as "changshan".
cn: 在中国南方，旗袍又称“长衫”。

en: I would rather live by myself than do as he tells me to do.
cn: 我宁愿自己独立生活也不要他来指使我。

en: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
cn: 我在机场被海关人员搜查。

en: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
cn: 抱着失败主义的态度你无法打一场漂亮的仗。

en: The modernized version of the qipao is noted for accentuating the female figure.
cn: 现代版旗袍因能突显女人的身材而闻名。

en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.
cn: 月食是一种罕见的现象。

en: A portion of the proceeds will go to benefit children with disabilities.
cn: 我们会把一部分筹得的款项用来帮助残疾儿童。

en: Ken bought a fine wine for his father on his birthday.
cn: Ken 在爸爸生日的那天买了一瓶上好的酒送给他。

en: I will have read Hamlet three times if I read it again.
cn: 我再看一次《王子复仇记》，加起来一共就看过三次了。

en: I wonder which country will be the first to censor Tatoeba.
cn: 我想知道哪个国家会第一个和谐Tatoeba？

en: Mike has been out of work for a year.
cn: Mike已经失业1年了。

en: The family is too poor to pay back the debts.
cn: 这个家庭非常贫穷以至于无法偿还贷款。

en: It is foolish of him to pay for it again.
cn: 这是他的愚蠢付出代价了。

en: You've acted foolishly and you will pay for it.
cn: 你愚蠢地行事，你会付出代价。

en: Could you send someone up to pick up some laundry?
cn: 你能派人拿一些衣服，好吗？

en: Would you mind picking up something on the way back?
cn: 你不介意的路上捡东西回来？

en: It'd be great if you could pick up some bread before you come home.
cn: 这将会是巨大的，如果你可以挑选一些面包，然后再回家。

en: Soon the same waiter came back to pick up the dishes.
cn: 不久，同样的服务员回来拿起菜。

en: I make it a point to shine my shoes before I go to bed.
cn: 我提出这一点之前，我的鞋和我去睡觉。

en: My pride prevented me from borrowing money from him.
cn: 骄傲使我无法向他借钱。

en: She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
cn: 她是在为其担心她会发胖的饮食。

en: The candle went out instead of having been put out.
cn: 蜡烛出去，而不必被扑灭。

en: Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
cn: 一定要熄了火，然后再离开。

en: You have to put up with all this noise.
cn: 你必须忍受这一切的噪音了。

en: If you can put up with us, put us up.
cn: 如果你能忍受我们.

en: You have to put up with all these noises.
cn: 你必须把无视这些声音。

en: Hold on a second, I'll be right back. Don't hang up!
cn: 等一下，我马上就回来。不要挂断电话！

en: The mountain used to send out clouds of smoke.
cn: 这座山过去常常发出烟雾。

en: This question must be discussed separately from that one.
cn: 这个问题必须分开讨论。

en: He devoted the last years of his life to writing his autobiography.
cn: 他晚年致力于写自传。

en: Why do women want to sleep in a man's embrace?
cn: 女人为什幺想被男人抱着睡觉？

en: I want to be a pilot in the future.
cn: 将来我想做飞行员。

en: He is the last person to give away the secret.
cn: 他这个人嘴很严。

en: Although I was tired, I did what I was able to do.
cn: 虽然我很累，但是我已经做了我能做的了。

en: Murdering elephants, tigers and other endangered species is not just cruel; it's also illegal.
cn: 杀害大象、老虎等濒危物种，不仅是残忍的，也是非法的。

en: More and more environmentalists advocate and use environmentally friendly unleaded petrol in cars.
cn: 越来越多的环保者开始宣传和使用以环保的无铅汽油为燃料的汽车。

en: You will find it stated a few pages further on.
cn: 你会发现它用几页纸进一步作了说明。

en: The remark you made at the party about Lisa's weight was totally uncalled for.
cn: 你在聚会中针对Lisa体重作出的评论是完全不适当的。

en: I have not yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
cn: 我还没有收集到足够的材料来写一本书。

en: You can't carry people on your bike, didn't you know?
cn: 骑自行车不能载人，你不知道吗？

en: We really didn't know; we won't do it next time.
cn: 我们真的不知道，下次我们再也不这样了。

en: How can there be a traffic jam now, as late as 6 o'clock?
cn: 现在才6点半，怎幺会堵车呢？

en: I'm really sorry, it's all my fault - I didn't notice you.
cn: 真对不起，刚才都怪我，没注意到您。

en: You can stay here as long as you like.
cn: 你想在这里呆多久就呆多久。

en: As well as this, the horse is also representative of human talent.
cn: 除此之外，马还是人才的代名词。

en: In China, talented people are often described as "ten thousand mile horses".
cn: 在中国，人们常把有能力的人喻为“千里马”。

en: I have to take the book back to the library today.
cn: 我今天必须把书还给图书馆。

en: My friend invited me to go out to dinner.
cn: 我的朋友邀请我去吃晚餐。

en: Nobody can prevent this plan from being carried out.
cn: 谁也不能阻止这个计划的实行。

en: She's not among the regular employees of this company.
cn: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。

en: It is not enough to study the language of a foreign country.
cn: 学习一种外国的语言不够了。

en: What one has to learn is more than the language.
cn: 人人需要学习的不仅仅是语言。

en: In India, people pass food at the dinner table with the right hand.
cn: 在印度，人们在餐桌上用右手传递食物。

en: They express disagreement by shaking their heads, which may indicate agreement in other countries.
cn: 他们以摇头表示不同意，而其他国家的人可能以摇头表示同意。

en: I'm doing some history research and would like to ask you a few questions.
cn: 我正在做一些历史研究工作，想问您几个问题。

en: The questions will not take long, and everything would be kept completely anonymous.
cn: 问题不需要占用很多时间，也完全不要留名。

en: I would like to have a cup of coffee.
cn: 我想要一杯咖啡。

en: Even if that restaurant did very tasty food, I wouldn't like to eat there.
cn: 即使那家饭馆做的菜好吃极了，我也不想在那里吃饭。

en: Even if I had enough money, I still wouldn't buy a Ferrari.
cn: 即使我的钱够了，我也不会买一辆法拉利。

en: Even though America is a developed country, it still has some very poor people.
cn: 尽管美国是个发达国家，却还有些很贫穷的人。

en: Although his exam scores weren't very high, he was still successful after graduation.
cn: 尽管他考试成绩不高，但他毕业后还是很成功。

en: Could you tell me what your specific requirements are?
cn: 可以说说您的具体要求吗？

en: The rent can be a bit expensive, but something nearby would be best.
cn: 租金贵一点儿没关系，近一些最好。

en: We'll contact you by phone as soon as we arrive.
cn: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。

en: Hutongs are a type of narrow street, most commonly associated with Beijing, China.
cn: 胡同是一种跟中国北京有关的窄街路。

en: The implication was that where there was a well, there were residents.
cn: 含义是哪里有水井，哪里就有居民。

en: In Beijing, hutongs are alleys formed by lines of siheyuans, the traditional courtyard residences.
cn: 在北京，胡同是由四合院的传统居所排形成。

en: We played. We lost. How about starting it over?
cn: 我们玩过了。我们输了。咱们从新来过吧？

en: I never thought he was capable of doing something so cruel.
cn: 我从来没想到他能做到那幺残忍的事。

en: I met an old friend of mine the other day.
cn: 我那天碰到了我其中的一个老朋友。

en: Citizens of higher social status were permitted to live closer to the center.
cn: 社会地位较高的公民被允许住在较靠近市中心的地方。

en: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
cn: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。

en: I'd be very grateful if you could help me.
cn: 你能帮助我的话，我将很感激的。

en: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?
cn: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？

en: Does the error occur regularly or sporadically? Is the error reproducible?
cn: 错误是经常出现还是偶尔出现？错误是否能够模仿？

en: It seems to me that the train is late.
cn: 好象火车晚点了。

en: The organization is not connected with any political parties.
cn: 这个组织跟任何政党没有联系。

en: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.
cn: 我不知道是否该同意或拒绝。

en: They found the track of a bear in the snow.
cn: 他们在雪地里找到了熊的脚印。

en: I took his not coming to indicate that he wasn't interested.
cn: 我将他的缺席视为没有兴趣。

en: Many people consider a high salary to be a condition for success.
cn: 不少人以高薪为成功的条件。

en: I consider relationships to be the most important thing in life.
cn: 我以感情为生活里最重要的事。

en: When I didn't have any money, I only had a rug for a bed.
cn: 我没有钱的时候，只能以地毯为床。

en: Skilled soldiers know how to use their environment as a weapon.
cn: 熟练的士兵知道怎幺以他们的环境为武器。

en: Some people consider Led Zeppelin to be the greatest band there has ever been.
cn: 有些人将齐柏林飞船视为有史以来最伟大的乐团。

en: Many Chinese people consider red to be the best colour.
cn: 很多中国人认为红色是最好的颜色。

en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
cn: 我们最近十年经历了很多变化。

en: A more experienced lawyer would have dealt with the case in a different way.
cn: 一个经验丰富的律师会以其它方法来处理这个情形的。

en: The earthquake was the biggest one that we had ever experienced.
cn: 这是我们历来经历过最大的地震。

en: Today the teacher took "Chinese culture" as a topic.
cn: 今天老师以「中国人的文化」为主题。

en: Li Bai's work is the most famous of Chinese poetry.
cn: 中国诗歌以李白的诗最为有名。

en: Cambridge is the most famous university in the world.
cn: 世界上的大学以剑桥最为有名 。

en: The American government has always regarded England as America's house pet.
cn: 美国政府一直视英国为美国的宠物。

en: Most parents see their own children as the best in the world.
cn: 大部分的父母视自己的孩子为世界上最好的。

en: He explained his plan both to my son and to me.
cn: 他把他的打算解释了给我和我的儿子两个人听。

en: Did you fall in love with her at first sight?
cn: 你对她是不是一见钟情？

en: Tom came on Monday and went back the day after.
cn: 汤姆星期一来的，第二天返回了。

en: He raised the glass to his lips and drained it at one gulp.
cn: 他把杯子举到嘴边，一饮而尽。

en: If you can see your breath when you exhale, you know it's cold.
cn: 如果呼气的时候能看到自己的气，你就知道天气很冷。

en: I keep saying that I'm innocent, but no one will listen.
cn: 我再三申明无罪，但是没人听我讲。

en: The home team always have an advantage over their opponents.
cn: 主场队总是比对手有优势。

en: I'd like to get you to help me ask the teacher for time off.
cn: 我想让你帮我向老师请个假。

en: I'd like to borrow your notes for a bit.
cn: 我想借你的笔记用一下。

en: I left the notes in the dormitory. I'll go back and get them now.
cn: 我把笔记放在宿舍了，现在回去拿。

en: Do you have cash on you now? Could you lend me some?
cn: 你现在手头儿有钱吗？先借我点儿。

en: I'll pay you back as soon as I have money.
cn: 我一有钱马上就还你。

en: Then I'll work on the principle that deference is no substitute for obedience.
cn: 那我就恭敬不如从命啦。

en: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
cn: 春节，即农历新年。

en: Celebrating Spring Festival is commonly referred to as 'passing the year'.
cn: 庆祝春节俗称过年。

en: Dumplings are essential at the New Year's Eve dinner table.
cn: 饺子是年夜饭桌上必不可少的。

en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
cn: 问题是, 太阳能太贵了。

en: I need someone to hold me and tell me everything will be alright.
cn: 我需要某人抱着我并对我说一切会顺利的。

en: We should always wear a seatbelt in case we have an accident.
cn: 我们总是应该带上安全带以防出事故。

en: There is nothing as relaxing as lying in a hot bath.
cn: 世上没有甚么东西比泡热水浴更舒服的了。

en: It makes no difference whether you go today or tomorrow.
cn: 你今天去和明天去也没有甚么分别。

en: A fallen leaf floated on the surface of the water.
cn: 水面浮着一片落叶。

en: Being written in great haste, this letter has quite a few mistakes.
cn: 这封信是十分匆匆忙忙地写的，所以有不少笔误。

en: As China develops, more and more countries want to have good relations with it.
cn: 越来越多国家随着中国的发展而希望跟中国有好的关系。

en: As global warming increases, sea levels get higher and higher.
cn: 海面随着全球变暖的加剧而越来越高。

en: With the arrival of winter, the leaves on the trees fall down.
cn: 树上的叶子随着冬天的到来而掉落。

en: With his interest in Justin Bieber, I just couldn't love him.
cn: 我随着他对Justin Bieber的兴趣而就不能爱他。

en: With the release of Skype, studying languages has become easier.
cn: 学习语言随着Skype的发行而变得更容易。

en: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
cn: 韩国随着朝鲜的外患而在边界附近集结军队。

en: As time goes on, China's economy gets stronger and stronger.
cn: 中国的经济随着时间的推移而变得越来越好。

en: As time goes on, my life gets worse and worse.
cn: 我的生活随着时间的推移而变得越来越糟糕。

en: It is not always easy to distinguish the Japanese from the Chinese.
cn: 日本人和中国人有时很难分辨。

en: Marriage has many pains, but celibacy has no pleasures.
cn: 婚姻生活固然有许多痛苦的地方，但单身也绝不是一件乐事。

en: This place still looks the same as it did a long time ago.
cn: 这里就像在古时候一样。

en: We went to the station to see her off.
cn: 我们去了车站为她送行。

en: Guilin's sceneries are the most beautiful ones under the heaven.
cn: 桂林山水甲天下。

en: You don't get up as early as your sister.
cn: 你没有你姐姐起得那幺早。

en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
cn: 劳动不仅是一种需要，而还是一种愉快。

en: He often stays away from home on the weekend.
cn: 周末他平常不在家。

en: No matter what you say, the answer is "no."
cn: 不管你说什么, 答案就是＂不。＂

en: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.
cn: 刚开始的时候你可能不会喜欢这个啤酒。这是需要多次品尝去习惯它的口味。

en: We were just talking about you when you called.
cn: 当你打电话来时, 我们正在谈论你。

en: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
cn: 你真笨去接受他的提议。

en: The information you gave me is of little use.
cn: 你给我的资料没有多大的用处。

en: I'd like to go with you, but as it is I can't.
cn: 我很想跟你一起去, 但重点是我不能去。

en: If only I could speak English as fluently as you!
cn: 如果我说英语能说得跟你一样流利的话就好了!

en: Where is your twenty? I'll give you five bucks for it.
cn: 你的二十块在哪里? 我给你五块钱找到它。

en: She has not seen him for a long time.
cn: 她很长时间没见过他。

en: Some of the bluest water in the world is found in Crater Lake.
cn: 一些世界上最蓝的水在火山湖。

en: The sky today is the bluest that I've ever seen it.
cn: 今天的天空是我看过最蓝的天空。

en: These are the bluest blueberries I have ever seen. They're almost unnaturally blue.
cn: 这是我看过最蓝的蓝莓。他们的蓝几乎不是自然的。

en: England expects that every man will do his duty.
cn: 英国期望每个人都会尽义务。

en: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
cn: 我觉得我好像从恶梦中惊醒。

en: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
cn: 人会因为体温而在红外线摄影机上显现。

en: Your intelligence is as vast as the distance between Bombay and Mumbai.
cn: 你的智慧广大的有如孟买和孟买之间的距离。

en: Life is half spent before we know what it is.
cn: 在我们了解人生之前人生已经过了一半。

en: They called in a doctor because the child was ill.
cn: 他们打电话给医生因为这个孩子生病了。

en: There's no way to get in touch with him.
cn: 没有联系他的方式。

en: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!

cn: 最后，她对他屈服了，并告诉了他这个秘密。

en: As soon as she opened the door, a cat ran out.
cn: 她一开门，一只猫就跑了出来。

en: My father usually leaves home while I am in bed.
cn: 我爸常常在我睡觉的时候出门。

en: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
cn: Charles Lindbergh于1927年成功完成了第一次独自飞越大西洋。

en: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
cn: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。

en: Bill got up early so he could catch the first train.
cn: 比尔很早起床这样他就可以赶上第一班火车了。

en: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.
cn: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。

en: She discovered that she had run out of salt.
cn: 她发现她已经断盐了。

en: They hope to be able to find a well-paid job.
cn: 他们希望会找到一份报酬优厚的工作。

en: To the best of my knowledge, the rumor is not true.
cn: 据我所知，这个谣言不是真的。

en: I am by turns an optimist and a pessimist.
cn: 我时而乐观，时而悲观。

en: His daughter is able to recite a lot of poems.
cn: 他的女儿能背诵很多诗。

en: I can't find the waistcoat of my three piece suit.
cn: 我找不到我三件套的背心。

en: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
cn: 你们有没有比较便宜的房间？

en: I have to brush up my French before I go to Paris to study.
cn: 我去巴黎读书之前要先练好我的法文。

en: You will be able to speak fluent English in another few months.
cn: 再过两、三个月，你就能说得一口流利的英语了。

en: David has so many girlfriends that he can't remember all of their names.
cn: 大卫有如此多的女朋友，以至于他无法记得他们所有的人的名字。

en: Hackers find new ways of infiltrating private or public networks.
cn: 骇客们找到渗透私人或公共网络的新方法。

en: Once he got the news of his daughter-in-law's death, he totally freaked out.
cn: 一到他知道儿子妇女的死亡的消息，他会暴跳如雷。

en: An old man was resting in the shade of the tree.
cn: 一个老人在树荫下休息。

en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
cn: 你曾经梦想在天空飞翔吗？

en: As is often the case, Mike was late for the meeting this afternoon.
cn: 麦克今天下午的会议迟到了，这是常有的事。

en: As soon as she heard the bell ring, she answered the telephone.
cn: 她一听到铃响，就接了电话。

en: It's rude to make fun of your boss in public.
cn: 在公开场合开你老板的玩笑是无礼的。

en: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.
cn: 从天色上判断，今天下午可能会下雨。

en: As soon as the bell rang, the teacher came into the classroom.
cn: 钟声一响起，老师就走进了教室。

en: Let's wait for a while and see how you do.
cn: 让我们等一会儿看看你怎么做。

en: About how long will it take to get there by bus?
cn: 搭公车到那里大约要花多久的时间？

en: Bill doesn't like the fact that his father smokes a lot.
cn: 比尔不喜欢他父亲抽很多烟的这个事实。

en: As a matter of fact, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
cn: 事实上，我从今天早上开始没有吃任何东西。

en: How far is it from here to the sea?
cn: 从这里到海边有多远？

en: Add the honey, lemon juice, chopped almonds and the chopped apples.
cn: 加入蜂蜜，柠檬汁，切碎的杏仁和切碎的苹果。

en: It cost me ten thousand yen to have my television set repaired.
cn: 把我的电视机修好花了我一万日元。

en: It is two miles from here to the park.
cn: 从这里到公园距离两英里。

en: Happy families are all alike; every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
cn: 幸福的家庭都是相似的，不幸的家庭却各有各的不幸。

en: If you can't make it, call us as soon as possible.
cn: 如果你做不到，尽快连络我们。

en: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
cn: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

en: Just as he was speaking, a fire broke out.
cn: 当他说话的时候，发生了火灾。

en: According to dentists, tooth decay is not always caused by sweets.
cn: 根据牙医，蛀牙并不总是甜食所引起的。

en: My sister can play the piano better than I can.
cn: 我妹妹钢琴可以弹得比我好。

en: One day in July, we went to the sea.
cn: 七月的某一天，我们去了海边。

en: They sent their son to Europe to acquire culture.
cn: 他们送他们的儿子到欧洲去学习文化。

en: Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
cn: 红色，相对于绿色，是危险的标志。

en: They will tear down the old building in two days.
cn: 他们将在两天内拆除这栋旧的建筑物。

en: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
cn: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个俱乐部的成员。

en: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
cn: 不知道为什么我夜里觉得比较有活力。

en: I really look forward to your visit in the near future.
cn: 我很期待在不久的将来您的光临。

en: Watch out for cars when you cross the street.
cn: 当你过马路的时候要当心汽车。

en: I got up today with a pain in my neck.
cn: 我今天起床的时候脖子很痛。

en: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
cn: 我们已经收到了很多回应我们广告的申请。

en: All that has happened before, and will happen again.
cn: 所有以前发生过的事，都将会再次发生。

en: I hope he'll be able to come! I'd like to see him.
cn: 我希望他能来！我想见他。

en: Bob missed the last train and had to take a taxi.
cn: Bob错过了最后一班火车，所以他必须搭计程车。

en: I heard someone in the crowd outside the station call my name.
cn: 我听到车站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。

en: We cannot see the other side of the moon.
cn: 我们看不到月亮的另一边。

en: The soldier kept a sharp lookout in the darkness.
cn: 这名士兵在黑暗中保持戒备。

en: He has not written to us since last February.
cn: 他从去年二月开始就没写信给我们。

en: The Japanese Parliament today officially elected Ryūtarō Hashimoto as the country's 52nd prime minister.
cn: 日本国会今天正式选举了桥本龙太郎作为全国第52届总理。

en: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
cn: 她买了六码的布做衣服。

en: This classroom is separated from that one by a wall.
cn: 这间教室与那间隔着一堵墙。

en: China and Mongolia are separated by the Great Wall of China.
cn: 中国与蒙古隔着万里长城。

en: He went on reading the book as if nothing had happened.
cn: 他继续读书，好像什么事也没有发生。

en: My home is separated from his by a river.
cn: 我的家与他的隔着一条江。

en: One day apart seems like a separation of three years.
cn: 一日不见如隔三秋。

en: He's of the type "do as I say, not as I do".
cn: 他是"说一套，做一套" 的人。

en: It is beyond my power to build my own house.
cn: 盖我自己的房子超出了我的能力范围。

en: He is the boy of whom we spoke the other day.
cn: 他是前几天我们谈到的那个男孩。

en: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
cn: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百货公司的特价活动。

en: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.
cn: 她弄丢了她的护照，所以遇到了麻烦。

en: He is a great statesman, and what is more a great scholar.
cn: 他是一个伟大的政治家，更重要的是，他也是一个伟大的学者。

en: Do I have to bring my son to your office?
cn: 我必须带我的儿子到你的办公室吗？

en: It is strange for Ken not to agree with us.
cn: 肯不同意我们，是件奇怪的事。

en: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.
cn: 不要害怕意外，但要有准备。

en: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
cn: 当你在阳光下的时候，遮住你的头。

en: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
cn: 虽然激情可能会褪去，却不容它破坏我们感情上的联系。

en: We should try to be philosophical about life; wealth gained could also vanish.
cn: 我们应该努力做到生活的哲学；获得的财富也会烟消云散。

en: How long does it take to go from here to the Hilton Hotel?
cn: 从这里到希尔顿饭店要花多久时间？

en: Father has now got a superior position in his office.
cn: 现在父亲在他的办公室已经得到了一个上级的地位。

en: Prices are double what they were two years ago.
cn: 价格是两年前的两倍。

en: Sorry it took me so long to write to you.
cn: 对不起, 我过了这么长的时间才回你的信。

en: I tried to change her mind, but I couldn't.
cn: 我试着改变她的心意，但我没有办法。

en: We couldn't open the door because it was locked from within.
cn: 我们无法打开这扇门，因为它从里面被反锁了。

en: A fall into a pit, a gain in your wit.
cn: 吃一堑，长一智。

en: I'd like to finish the work on my own.
cn: 我想自己把工作做完。

en: I don't know where my crutches are. Have you seen them?
cn: 我不知道把拐杖放哪去了，你有看到吗？

en: I saw the film, which was not so good.
cn: 我看了这部电影，但它没有那么好。

en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.
cn: 请接受我对您今天的成功最诚挚的祝贺。

en: He returned home from Europe in 1941, when the war broke out.
cn: 他在1941年战争爆发的时候，从欧洲回国了。

en: Lonely people perpetuate their own loneliness through their fear of others.
cn: 孤独的人会孤独，是因为他畏惧他人。

en: He is an excellent fixer, and has always been regarded as such.
cn: 他是一个出色的调停者，并一直被人认为如此。

en: Since then he has put his soul into his work.
cn: 从那时起，他就把他整个灵魂投入到他的工作。

en: This has been the driest six months in thirty years.
cn: 这是三十年代以来最干旱的六月。

en: Everyone can help ensure that sentences sound correct, and are correctly spelled.
cn: 每个人都可以协助确保句子念起来正确且拼写正确。

en: We give here a list of the usual Esperanto-related questions.
cn: 我们在这里罗列了通常有关世界语的问题。

en: Your mother must have been beautiful when she was young.
cn: 你母亲年轻的时候一定很美。

en: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
cn: 我太太兼职的工作赚进了一些额外的钱。

en: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
cn: 你想成为一名电影演员吗？

en: A cup of coffee relieved me of my headache.
cn: 一杯咖啡纾解了我的头痛。

en: Seen from a plane, that island is very beautiful.
cn: 从飞机上看，那是个非常美丽的岛屿。

en: He had the illusion that he was a genius.
cn: 他幻想自己是个天才。

en: As soon as I left home, I ran into her.
cn: 我一离开家就遇见了她。

en: I have been reading this for a few hours.
cn: 我一直读这个读了几个小时。

en: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
cn: 那是无稽之谈。只有傻瓜才会相信。

en: The miser opened the box to find his money stolen.
cn: 这个守财奴打开了盒子，发现他的钱被偷了。

en: We were more or less disappointed about the election.
cn: 我们或多或少对这次的选举感到失望。

en: He is now either in Rome or in Paris.
cn: 他不是在罗马，就是在巴黎。

en: I'll call as soon as I am at the airport.
cn: 我一到机场就会打电话。

en: Interest in baseball cuts across classes and ages in this country.
cn: 这个国家里不同年龄阶级的人都减少了对棒球的兴趣。

en: Many TV programs have a bad influence on children.
cn: 许多电视节目对儿童有不良的影响。

en: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.
cn: 安静到连针掉在地上的声音你都会听得到。

en: It took me half an hour to work out this problem.
cn: 我花了一个半小时的时间解决这个问题。

en: To me, there aren't any fundamental differences between the cultures of these two countries.
cn: 对我而言，这两个国家的文化没有什幺根本的区别。

en: However, I've never been a guest in an English household that wasn't generous.
cn: 不过，我从来没有在一个小气的英国家庭做过客。

en: It seems that everyone likes to be generous in welcoming guests to their home.
cn: 好像所有的人喜欢大方地欢迎客人来他们家。

en: This is due to English being a world language.
cn: 这是因为英语是全球性的语言。

en: The result is that English people usually have no problem understanding what foreigners say.
cn: 结果是英国人平时没问题听得懂外国人说的话。

en: Furthermore, I still don't think this a huge cultural difference.
cn: 而且，我还是认为这准不是个巨大的文化区别。

en: My brother would often stay up all night reading novels.
cn: 我哥哥经常熬夜看小说。

en: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
cn: 在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。

en: She was advised by him to go to the police.
cn: 他劝她去报警。

en: I passed the city hall on my way to the station.
cn: 我去车站的路上路过了市政厅。

en: If you want to learn a language well, learn it on your own.
cn: 如果你想学习好一种语言，自己学习它。

en: In U.S. bakeries, a "baker's dozen" is 13, not 12.
cn: 在美国的面包店，"面包师傅的一打"是13，不是12。

en: The man you see over there is my uncle.
cn: 你在那边见到的男人是我伯伯。

en: In the morning I always wake up around seven o'clock.
cn: 我早上总是大约七点钟醒来。

en: A perfect map would have to be as big as the territory it represents.
cn: 一个完美的地图必须要像它所代表的领土一样大。

en: As far as I could make out, he was experimenting with new methods.
cn: 就我所了解的，他正在实验新的方法。

en: If you enjoy the work you do, you have something worth more than money.
cn: 如果你喜欢你做的工作，你就有比金钱更有价值的东西。

en: I don't like to leave things up in the air.
cn: 我不喜欢让事情悬而未决。

en: It's not the person that's ugly, but the clothes.
cn: 难看的不是人的外貌，而是人的衣服。

en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
cn: 分支和合并是版本控制的两种基本操作。

en: This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.
cn: 这辆卡车从青森运输新鲜食品到东京。

en: From the look of the sky, it may rain in the afternoon.
cn: 从天色看起来，下午可能会下雨。

en: A fire broke out last night and three houses were burnt down.
cn: 昨晚发生了一场火灾，三栋房屋被烧毁了。

en: There is nothing wrong with knowledge obtained by asking.
cn: 问人而知，并非过错。

en: There are no difficult things in the world, but only weak-hearted people.
cn: 世上无难事，只怕有心人。

en: The joke loses everything when the joker laughs himself.
cn: 当讲笑话的人自己先笑时，这个笑话就失去了一切意义。

en: When I grow up, I want to be king.
cn: 当我长大后，我想当国王。

en: The whale is well known to be the largest mammal.
cn: 鲸是被公认为最大的哺乳动物。

en: It was lucky for you that you found it.
cn: 你很幸运找到了它。

en: It is difficult to catch a rabbit by hand.
cn: 徒手逮兔挺难。

en: When eating, the largest plate is always the table.
cn: 吃饭的时候，最大的盘子永远是桌子。

en: It won't be long before your dream comes true.
cn: 你的梦想很快就会成真了。

en: Take your hat off when you enter a house of worship.
cn: 当你进入礼拜堂时，把你的帽子脱下来。

en: The old houses were torn down to make room for a supermarket.
cn: 这栋老房子被拆除了，以腾出空间给超级市场。

en: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.
cn: 摇篮里学的带到坟墓。

en: I think you will have done all the work soon.
cn: 我想你很快就可以做完所有的工作。

en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
cn: 她把她的CD在书架上排成一排。

en: The major religions in China are Taoism, Buddhism, Islam and Christianity.
cn: 中国重要的宗教是道教、佛教、伊斯兰教和基督教。

en: Islam first reached China about the middle of the 7th century.
cn: 伊斯兰教大约在七世纪中传到中国。

en: In 1807, Robert Morrison, the first British Protestant missionary to China arrived in Guangzhou.
cn: 一八零七年，第一个到中国的英国新教徒传教士罗伯特马礼逊到了广州。

en: John finished the work at the expense of his health.
cn: 约翰牺牲自己的健康，完成工作。

en: John is brave in appearance, but is in reality a coward.
cn: 约翰看起来很勇敢，但其实是个胆小鬼。

en: John writes a letter to his parents once a month.
cn: 约翰每个月写一封信给他的父母。

en: John is head and shoulders above any of his classmates in French.
cn: 约翰的法文比他的同学都来得好。

en: Had I arrived earlier, I could have seen Kelly.
cn: 如果我早点到，就能遇到凯莉了。

en: The woman to whom you were talking is my sister.
cn: 跟你讲话的那个女人是我姐姐。

en: My hobbies are not only wide-ranging but also useful.
cn: 我的爱好不但广泛而且有用。

en: In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.
cn: 对知识的爱好而言，我真的喜欢学汉字。

en: Normally I might study Chinese characters for an hour a day.
cn: 我平时每天可能练习一个小时汉字。

en: Last time I counted, I estimated that I know around 2500 Chinese characters.
cn: 我上次计算，估计我已经学会了两千五百个汉字左右。

en: I think that computers can help students use more effective study methods.
cn: 我认为电脑会帮助学生以高效方式使学得更好。

en: I use all kinds of software to study Chinese.
cn: 我用各种各样的软件学习中文。

en: Of those, the one I use most often is a flashcard system.
cn: 其中我最常用的是一种抽认卡系统。

en: Every other day I go with a friend; we lift weights whilst chatting together.
cn: 我每隔一天就跟一个好朋友一起去，我们一起一边谈话一边举重。

en: They are not singing, they are flirting with each other.
cn: 他们不是在演唱，他们在调情说爱。

en: I have never heard him speak ill of others.
cn: 我从没听说他关于其他人说坏话。

en: Tom, what would you like to have for dinner?
cn: Tom, 晚餐想吃啥？

en: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
cn: 新鲜水果和蔬菜有益健康。

en: They wanted a wedding picture in front of the Eiffel Tower.
cn: 他们想在艾菲尔铁塔前面拍张结婚照。

en: The bus is full. You'll have to wait for the next one.
cn: 这班公车客满了。你必须等下一班。

en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
cn: 融合爵士是摇滚乐与爵士乐的融合。

en: You gain more than you spend when you go to college.
cn: 上大学的时候，你得到的比付出的还多。

en: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
cn: 大富翁是一个家庭玩的热门游戏。

en: Tom puts gas in his car twice a week.
cn: 汤姆每周帮车子加两次油。

en: There's no space in the room for another bed.
cn: 这间房间没有空间再放一张床了。

en: The history of China is older than that of Japan.
cn: 中国历史比日本历史更悠久。

en: As usual, I mispronounced words and broke my sentences up in the wrong places.
cn: 我老是写白字读破句。

en: Not that he couldn't, but he's too lazy a man to do it.
cn: 却不是不能作而是他这个男人太懒了。

en: I want to know what you did this summer.
cn: 我想知道，你这个夏天干了些什幺？

en: He can speak both English and French very well.
cn: 他的英语和法语都说得十分流利。

en: As soon as man is born, he begins to die.
cn: 从出生的一刻开始，我们就在步向死亡。

en: It is a pleasure to watch a baseball game on TV.
cn: 在电视上看棒球比赛是一件乐事。

en: We can hardly imagine our daily life without television.
cn: 如果没有了电视，实在很难想像我们的日常生活会变成怎样。

en: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
cn: 环境污染可以对一个区域的生态造成极大的影响。

en: We should learn from those who have gone before us.
cn: 我们应该向前人学习。

en: He saved the drowning child at the cost of his own life.
cn: 他把溺水的小孩救了起来，但是却牺牲了自己的生命。

en: When my mother was young, she was very beautiful.
cn: 我母亲年轻的时候十分漂亮。

cn: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。

en: I don't plan to hang out tonight. I need to prepare for my lessons.
cn: 我今晚不准备出去玩，我要预备功课。

en: He likes to get on the horse and go out.
cn: 他喜欢骑马出行。

en: A GPS device can pinpoint your location anywhere in the world.
cn: 无论你在世界的哪一个角落，你都可以使用全球定位仪来找出你的所在。

en: It was ages since we had had such a good time.
cn: 我们很久没有在一起这样快乐过了。

en: We find it difficult to decide which one to buy.
cn: 我们觉得很难决定买哪一个。

en: Two men are checking on what's wrong with the car.
cn: 两个男人在检查汽车出了什幺故障。

en: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.
cn: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。

en: This machine was of great use to us all.
cn: 这个机器对我们都很有用。

en: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
cn: 在回家的路上，我看到一场阅兵式。

en: I do not know when she will come back.
cn: 我不知道她什幺时候会回来。

en: It's very hard getting a taxi in this city.
cn: 在这个城市，很难打到的。

en: He was made a fool of by his neighbors.
cn: 他被他的邻居们愚弄了。

en: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
cn: 流经伦敦的河是泰晤士河。

en: Please turn off the light before you go to bed.
cn: 上床睡觉之前请关灯。

en: I am working to save for my college tuition.
cn: 我工作是为了攒大学学费。

en: I met him by chance on the train this morning.
cn: 今天早上我在火车上偶遇他。

en: I want a little bit of coffee. I don't want anything else.
cn: 我要喝一点咖啡，我不要别的。

en: It started raining as soon as we got home.
cn: 我们才一到家就下起雨来了。

en: It is careless of her to make such a mistake.
cn: 她犯这样的错真的很粗心。

en: We'll get a phone call from him tonight for sure.
cn: 今晚我们肯定会接到他的电话。

en: The longer I stayed in Paris, the more I liked it.
cn: 在巴黎待得越久，我就越喜欢巴黎。

en: They thought he was the son of the Sun.
cn: 他们认为他是太阳之子。

en: It was so cold yesterday that I stayed home.
cn: 昨天太冷了，我只好待在家里。

en: In Japan, the new school year begins in April.
cn: 日本的新学年在四月开始。

en: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
cn: 战争即和平，自由即奴役，无知即力量。

en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.
cn: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。

en: I will help you if I have finished my work by four.
cn: 如果我在4点之前能完成工作，我会来帮助你。

en: I thought he was going to fail the exam, but he passed after all.
cn: 本以为他不会及格，但最终还是及格了。

en: Hope to see you next time I'm in N.Y.
cn: 希望下次在纽约见到你。

en: It is said that the younger generation today is apathetic.
cn: 有人说新一代的人很冷漠。

en: Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
cn: 第一还是第二的版本比较齐全？

en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.
cn: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。

en: It cost him 50 dollars to rent a car in Hawaii.
cn: 他花了50美元在夏威夷租了一辆汽车。

en: I can't believe that you were the smartest kid in your class.
cn: 我不敢相信你是你们班里面最聪明的孩子。

en: It is close to eleven. It's about time we went to bed.
cn: 快11点了。我们该上床睡觉了。

en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
cn: 五岁以下的小孩票价全免。

en: What would you do if you had ten thousand dollars?
cn: 如果你有一万美元，你想做什幺呢？

en: It was Mr. Smith that taught me how to use that machine.
cn: 是史密斯先生教我使用那台机器的。

en: This is a problem you have to solve by yourself.
cn: 这是一个你必须自己解决的问题。

en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
cn: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

en: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
cn: 请在建筑的入口处等我。

en: One hundred and fifty people entered the marathon race.
cn: 150个人参加了马拉松比赛。

en: Having met the girl before, I recognized her at once.
cn: 因为曾遇见过那个女孩，我马上就认出来了。

en: You'll have three relationships before you meet your true soulmate.
cn: 要经历三段感情才能遇到真命天子。

en: I may be antisocial, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.
cn: 我或许不善于社交,但这并不意味我不和别人交谈。

en: When I call on you, I'll let you know in advance.
cn: 我若拜访你，会让你提前知道的。

en: Ellen was so tired that she went to bed early.
cn: 艾伦太累了，于是早早地上床睡觉了。

en: By the time that he tried 966, Dima was beginning to give up hope.
cn: 当迪马尝试了打九六六的时候， 他开始了放弃希望。

en: Do you think that he is equal to the task?
cn: 你认为他能够胜任这个任务吗?

en: He often sits by me and listens to music.
cn: 他经常坐在我旁边听音乐。

en: I wish I could go to the party with you.
cn: 我希望我能和你一起参加派对。

en: Keep your eyes closed until I tell you to open them.
cn: 闭着你的眼睛直到我告诉你睁开为止。

en: He and his companion asked me to come along with them.
cn: 他和他的伙伴让我跟他们一起去。

en: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.
cn: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。

en: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.
cn: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。

en: To tell the truth, I don't agree with you.
cn: 实话说，我不赞成你。

en: She warned him not to go out at night alone.
cn: 她警告他晚上不要一个人出去。

en: I don't want to go there. He doesn't want to go either.
cn: 我不想去那儿，他也不想。

en: The burglar gained access to the house through this door.
cn: 窃贼是从这扇门进到屋子里的。

en: Tom said that he didn't want to see or speak to anyone.
cn: Tom 说他不想看到或跟任何人交谈。

en: Tom came to Japan for the first time when he was three.
cn: Tom 在三岁的时候第一次来日本。

en: I'm afraid I cannot make myself understood in English.
cn: 我怕我的英文无人能理解。

en: If and only if the ice-cream is vanilla flavour will Xiao Wang eat it.
cn: 当且仅当冰淇淋是香草口味，小王会吃这个冰淇淋。

en: You can take a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.
cn: 你可以把马带到河边可是不能迫它喝水。

en: Get out! I don't want to talk to you!
cn: 出去！我不想跟你说！

en: I haven't seen you for ages. Do you remember when I saw you last?
cn: 好久不见了。记得上次我什幺时候看见你的吗？

en: He's not such a great writer and I think he knows it.
cn: 他不是那幺出色的作家我想他知道这一点。

en: I've got a feeling that Tom won't graduate this year.
cn: 我觉得汤姆今年不会毕业。

en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
cn: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。

en: Why are you worrying about something that doesn't matter so much?
cn: 你为甚么要为这种无关重要的事情忧心呢？

en: I was very tired, so I fell asleep right away.
cn: 我累得很，所以马上就睡着了。

en: We need food, clothes and a home in order to live.
cn: 食物、衣服和住所都是生活的必需品。

en: I didn't have the courage to tell her the truth.
cn: 我没有勇气把事实告诉她。

en: She took no notice of what her father said.
cn: 她把她父亲的话都当成了耳边风。

en: I hope we don't have to wait for too long.
cn: 希望我们不需要等太久。

en: He scrunched down in his seat so that I wouldn't see him.
cn: 他不想让我见到他，于是便在位子里缩作了一团。

en: It is an advantage to be able to use a computer.
cn: 懂得用电脑是一种优势。

en: He never fails to write to his parents once a month.
cn: 他每个月都会写一封信给他的父母，风雨不改。

en: My father has lived in Nagoya for 30 years.
cn: 我父亲在名古屋已经住了三十年了。

en: If you want to learn a language well, learn it yourself.
cn: 语言一定要自学才会学得好。

en: On the plate was a piece of chicken, a potato and some green peas.
cn: 盘子上盛着一块鸡肉、一块马铃薯和一些青豆。

en: This is a useful book and, what is more, it is not expensive.
cn: 这本书很实用，而且价钱也很相宜。

en: It fell upon me to take care of my mother.
cn: 照顾母亲的责任落在了我身上。

en: Why are men never happy? Because they always want the impossible.
cn: 人为甚么永远不会满足？因为他们总想得到不可能得到的东西。

en: My boss has the ability to read books very fast.
cn: 我的老板看书可以看得很快。

en: If I win the lottery, I'll be able to live high on the hog.
cn: 如果我中了彩劵，就一辈子衣食无忧了。

en: She hid behind the door and held her breath.
cn: 她屏着气息，躲了在门的后面。

en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
cn: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

en: What is the total amount of money you spent?
cn: 你一共花了多少钱？

en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
cn: 计划使村民的生活改善了不少。

en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?
cn: 你想看甚么类型的电影？

en: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
cn: 一旦爆发核战争，受苦的将会是全人类。

en: How can you be so indifferent to your wife's trouble?
cn: 你妻子遇上麻烦，你怎么还一副事不关己，己不劳心的样子？

en: Japan has an economy that is supported by hard-working company employees in big cities.
cn: 日本的经济是由一群勤奋工作的大城市上班族支撑起的。

en: These students work hard, but it's not that much efficient.
cn: 这些学生很努力，但效率不太高。

en: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.
cn: 这个镇海拔1500米。

en: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.
cn: 舅舅的公司上个月推出了一款新产品。

en: The big fire reduced the whole town to ashes.
cn: 那场大火把整个小镇烧成了灰烬。

en: John felt the presence of a ghost in the dark room.
cn: 约翰感觉到那黑漆漆的房间里有鬼。

en: Do you really want to see a French film?
cn: 你想看法国电影，真的吗？

en: It's against the rules to smoke at the office.
cn: 在办公室吸烟违背我们的原则。

en: I hate it when my clothes smell of smoke.
cn: 我讨厌我的衣服有烟味。

en: I can speak Chinese, but I can't read it.
cn: 我会说中文，但是我不会读中文。

en: This idea is a misperception, and makes no sense.
cn: 这个看法是个错觉，并且没道理。

en: America has the world’s largest economy, and its army is the most powerful.
cn: 美国是世界最大的经济体并拥有最强的军队。

en: We ordered the products on time. However, they won’t be dispatched until next month.
cn: 我们按时预定了产品。然而，要到下个月后才能发货。

en: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
cn: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。

en: Would you like to go for a drink or something to eat?
cn: 你想出去喝几杯或吃个饭吗？

en: Let’s either speak Chinese, or not speak at all.
cn: 咱们要幺说汉语，要幺就别说话。

en: If you don’t do more exercise, you’ll be unhealthy.
cn: 如果不多运动，你身体就不好。

en: If you're going to be like this, I'll just leave.
cn: 你这样的话我就走了。

en: If she didn't see you then there’s nothing to worry about.
cn: 她没看到你的话就没有什幺担心的。

en: If you go to Beijing, definitely have a look at Tiananmen Square.
cn: 要是去北京的话，一定要看一下天安门广场。

en: Only if you study hard will you be able to get into university.
cn: 只有你好好学习才可以考得上大学。

en: You can only come to China if you’ve got a visa.
cn: 只有得了签证才可以来中国。

en: As long as you’ve prepared, you won’t have any problems.
cn: 只要你准备了，你就不会遇到问题。

en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
cn: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。

en: Unless there is reliable evidence for it, we should not believe anything.
cn: 除非有可靠的证据，不然我们不应该相信任何事。

en: You can come in if and only if you know our password.
cn: 当且仅当你知道我们的密码你才可以进来。

en: Parents often sacrifice themselves to ensure that their children receive a good education.
cn: 父母为了确保孩子受到良好的教育常常牺牲自己。

en: Please take the pillow and blanket and give them to me.
cn: 请把枕头和毯子拿给我。

en: He's a very good teacher, so his children really listen to him.
cn: 他很会教育人所以他的孩子都很听话。

en: How far is it from here to the museum?
cn: 这里离博物馆多远？

en: He doesn't look willing to come to the concert.
cn: 他好像不怎么想来听音乐会。

en: He was a great teacher so his children were very obedient.
cn: 他很会教育人, 所以他的孩子都很听话.

en: It is said that Peng Zu was the grandson of a celestial emperor.
cn: 传说彭祖是天帝的孙子。

en: He is a painter, but he can't paint in the traditional Chinese style.
cn: 他是个画家，但他不会画国画。

en: The train was so crowded that I had to stand all the way.
cn: 火车拥挤极了，我整趟车程都没有位子坐。

en: Things change from time to time, and one should change with them.
cn: 世事变幻无常，人不能因循守旧、一成不变。

en: Like any company, we've got to look ahead and plan for the future.
cn: 和其他公司一样，我们得向前看，规划好未来。

en: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
cn: 你活着，但是却不知道为什幺活着。

en: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
cn: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。

en: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.
cn: 明明签订了互不侵犯条约，竟然还来攻击我们。

en: This is the room where the body was found.
cn: 这就是发现尸体的房间。

en: This guidebook might be of use to you on your trip.
cn: 这本导游册子或许会对你的旅行有帮助。

en: Hi, I have an appointment with the general manager. This is my interview notice.
cn: 您好，我跟总经理有约十点见面，这是我的面试通知。

en: If you have no character to lose, people will have no faith in you.
cn: 如果你没有尝试过失败的角色，那幺人们也就不会相信你。

en: Up to now, how many books do you think you've read?
cn: 到目前为止，你认为你阅读过多少书籍？

en: The library is in the middle of the city.
cn: 图书馆位于市中央。

en: When I was a child, I spent most of my time indoors reading.
cn: 当我是个孩子的时候，我会把大部分时间都用于室内阅读。

en: The child is wearing a belly-slip made of silk.
cn: 这个小孩穿着一件丝绸织成的肚兜.

en: Are there any students from Korea in your class?
cn: 你们 班 有 韩国 学生 吗 ?

en: Don't worry, you shall get the answer this afternoon.
cn: 别着急，今天下午你就可得到答复了.

en: Shougongsha is an old Chinese technique to test a woman's virginity.
cn: 守宫砂是中国古代用来验证女人贞操的方法.

en: She hung a little Picasso on the wall of the drawing room.
cn: 她把一幅小尺寸的毕卡索画作挂在会客厅的墙上。

en: How would you feel if your wife left you?
cn: 如果你的妻子离开了你，你会怎幺想？

en: The weather report says it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
cn: 天气预报说明天下午会下雨。

en: The religion was in its glory in those days.
cn: 这个宗教当时处于全盛时期。

en: He fell into the habit of keeping late hours.
cn: 他养成了熬夜的习惯。

en: You can make up to 80,000 yen a month in that part-time job.
cn: 你做那份兼职工作最多能赚到八万日元。

en: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.
cn: 吃药之前一定要仔细看说明书。

en: The car won't start because the battery has run down.
cn: 车发动不了因为电池没电了。

en: In order to apply, you have to go in person.
cn: 要申请的话，你得亲自去。

en: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.
cn: 火车在快到交叉路口的时候减速、按喇叭。

en: I am in the habit of taking a shower in the morning.
cn: 我习惯早上洗澡。

en: She replied that she had never seen the man before.
cn: 她回答说她从来没有见过那个男人。

en: It was not until the baby was fed that he stopped crying.
cn: 这个婴儿直到吃饱了才停下不哭。

en: How many kinds of birds are in your backyard?
cn: 你家后院有几种鸟？

en: Tom can't cook very well, so he often eats out.
cn: 汤姆不怎幺会烧饭所以他经常出去吃。

en: I never felt at ease in my father's company.
cn: 我在我爸的公司一直感觉不自在。

en: She persists in saying that her analysis is correct.
cn: 她坚持认为自己的分析是正确的。

en: How much time did it take you to learn Chinese so well?
cn: 你花多长时间汉语学这幺好。

en: Whether you know him or not, you have to support his opinion.
cn: 不管你认不认识他，你都应该支持他的想法。

en: She said that she had to be back before dawn.
cn: 她说她黄昏之前必须回来。

en: When I was growing up, I never imagined that I would become famous.
cn: 我小的时候从没想过自己会出名。

en: He is fresh from college, so he has no experience.
cn: 他刚刚大学毕业，所以没什幺经验。

en: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
cn: 在我看来，汽车是弊大于利。

en: That house with the red roof is Tom's house.
cn: 那个有红色房顶的是汤姆的家。

en: I know that I should not tell him a lie.
cn: 我知道我不应该跟他说谎。

en: It took me five hours to drive from here to Tokyo.
cn: 从这儿开到东京我花了五个小时。

en: To be honest, I've never heard of this place before.
cn: 说实话，我以前没听说过这个地方。

en: Seen from a distance, the hill looks like an elephant.
cn: Cóng yuǎnchù kàn，nàzuòshān xiàng yìtóu dàxiàng。 从远处看，那座山像一头大象。

en: I feel bad about not having gone to his funeral.
cn: 我因为没有参加他的葬礼而感到很糟糕。

en: They were looking for a place at which they could pitch the tent.
cn: 他们在找一个可以搭帐篷的地方。

en: I was moved by her love for other people.
cn: 我被她对别人的爱心所感动。

en: I prefer going outside to spending time on Facebook.
cn: 比起上Facebook，我更喜欢去外面。

en: In France did you work at the embassy or in the consulate?
cn: 在法国，你在大使馆工作还是领事馆？

en: I went to bed early, for I was tired.
cn: 我很早上床睡觉了，因为很累。

en: Burj Khalifa is currently the tallest skyscraper in the world.
cn: 哈里发塔是现时世界上最高的摩天大楼。

en: Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
cn: 麦根沙士被视为一种经典的美式碳酸饮品。

en: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.
cn: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。

en: If you have a thought, please raise your hand.
cn: 如果你有意见请举手。

en: This is a world where the sun doesn't shine.
cn: 这是一个没有阳光的世界。

en: This area is still underdeveloped because of a lack of interest from the government.
cn: 因为缺乏的政府的关注，这个区域还不发达。

en: I'm afraid I can't help you. You must ask someone else.
cn: 我担心可能帮不了你，你需要找其他人帮忙。

en: No thank you, I don't need a plastic bag.
cn: 不，谢谢。我不需要塑料袋。

en: When a team makes its entrance, the captain leads the way.
cn: 上场时,队长先上.

en: What's happened has happened; there's no use in whining and complaining.
cn: 要发生的已经发生了，你摇头叹息也没用。

en: Apart from the cost, it will take long to build the bridge.
cn: 撇开费用不说，建这座桥也会耗费不少的时间。

en: I don't know what kind of person he is.
cn: 我不知道他是怎么样的一个人。

en: His main object in life was to become rich.

en: There's no need to be polite with this kind of person.
cn: 对这种人，用不着客气。

en: When was the last time you cut the engine?
cn: 你最后一次关掉引擎是什幺时候？

en: Mr. Wang learnt German because he wanted to go to Germany.
cn: 王先生学德文，因为他想去德国。

en: If you ever come back to me, I'll never treat you badly again.
cn: 如果你肯回到我的身边，我一定会永远好好待你。

en: Mr. Wang learnt German because he wanted to work in Germany.
cn: 王先生学德文，因为他想在德国工作。

en: She is a British citizen, but she was born in France.
cn: 她是一个英国公民，但她是在法国出生的。

en: She should be there now because she left an hour ago.
cn: 她是在一个小时前出发的，所以现在应该已经到了。

en: It's raining but never mind, I can still go.
cn: 下雨也没关系，我还是可以去。

en: Do you have any idea what they're talking about?
cn: 你知道他们在说甚么吗？

en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
cn: 你知道银行什幺时候关门吗？

en: We know it's difficult, but please don't translate literally.
cn: 我们知道这很困难，但请不要直译。

en: I think you will find it convenient to put a short-cut on the desktop.
cn: 我想你迟早会知道在桌面建立一个快捷方式是有多方便。

en: The real problem is not whether machines think but whether men do.
cn: 真正的问题不是机器有没有思想，而是人类有没有思想。

en: If we knew what we were doing, it wouldn't be called research, would it?
cn: 如果我们知道我们在做什幺，那幺这不能称之为研究，是吗？

en: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
cn: 他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。

en: I have to give back the book before Saturday.
cn: 我必须在礼拜六之前把书还回去。

en: Why are people always called Tom in random sentences?
cn: 为什幺随机句子中的人总是叫汤姆？

en: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.
cn: 让我像这样继续下去是绝对不可能的。

en: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
cn: 变量的声明在C和C++中极其重要。

en: Do you know how to use these command line tools?
cn: 你知道怎样使用这些命令行工具吗？

en: There are many lakes in the area where you live.
cn: 在你生活的地方有许多湖泊。

en: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?
cn: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？

en: If you want to be credible, tell people only what they believe.
cn: 如果你想使他人相信你的话，那就只说他已经相信的东西吧。

en: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.
cn: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。

en: You are no better at remembering things than I am.
cn: 你记事情的能力并不比我好多少。

en: Tom is the last person I want to see right now.
cn: 汤姆是我现在想见到的最后一个人。

en: He had his hat blown off by the strong wind.
cn: 他的帽子给强风吹走了。

en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
cn: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。

en: I ran as fast as possible to catch up with her.
cn: 我尽快跑以赶上她。

en: His name was on the tip of my tongue, but I couldn't remember it.
cn: 我都快要说出他的名字了，可就是记不起来。

en: I'd like a doll, a new bicycle..... and peace on earth!
cn: 我想要一个洋娃娃，一辆新自行车……以及世界和平。

en: This is a map of the city of Sendai.
cn: 这是一张仙台市的地图。

en: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
cn: 在传给玛丽之前，汤姆把纸条折了起来。

en: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?
cn: 你还和你的高中同学保持联系吗？

en: I was unable to go to his birthday party.
cn: 我那时没法去他的生日派对。

en: China is about twenty-five times as large as Japan.
cn: 中国的版图大概是日本的二十五倍。

en: You are adding new names to the list, aren't you?
cn: 你在把新的名字放在程序里面。

en: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.
cn: 我在电视上看到过他，不过没有看到过他本人。

en: Let me help you. Your bag looks very heavy.
cn: 让我来帮你吧。你的包看起来很重。

en: My brother has lived in England for more than thirty years.
cn: 我哥哥已经在英格兰生活三十多年了。

en: What country has the absolute advantage in the production of corn?
cn: 哪一个国家拥有生产玉米的绝对优势？

en: I cannot write traditional characters, but I am fine reading them.
cn: 我不会写繁体字，但我可以读。

en: Assets have earning power or some other value to their owner.
cn: 资产盈利能力或一些其他的价值，它们的主人。

en: You don't have to go to school on Sunday.
cn: 你没必要周日去上学。

en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
cn: 你长大后想成为什幺？

en: All you have to do is to take care of yourself.
cn: 你要做的只是照顾好你自己。

en: I was the second to last person to hear the bad news.
cn: 我是倒数第二个得知这个坏消息的。

en: I'd like to teach you Chinese in exchange for your teaching me another language.
cn: 我想用汉语交换另一种语言.

en: China is an advocate for the Diaoyu Islands' sovereignty.
cn: 中国主张钓鱼岛的主权。

en: Don't try to pull a fast one on me!
cn: 你别想骗我！

en: Are you sure you don't want me to go with you?
cn: 你确定不要我跟你一起去吗？

en: Last night I was dead drunk and fell asleep without having a bath.
cn: 昨夜，我烂醉了，我没洗澡就睡觉了。

en: You're working too hard. Take it easy for a while.
cn: 你工作太勤奋了。休息一会吧。

en: He advised me not to believe what she says.
cn: 她劝我别相信她的话。

en: He asked me if I knew her telephone number.
cn: 他问我知不知道她的电话号码。

en: I hope that some scientist will soon discover a cure for AIDS.
cn: 真希望科学家们能早点找到艾滋病的治疗方法。

en: She writes to her pen pal in London twice a month.
cn: 她每两个月给在伦敦的笔友写一封信。

en: You need to stop posting private photos on Facebook.
cn: 别再往Facebook上发私人照片了。

en: Be careful what you say, Andrea; the walls have ears.
cn: 安德里亚，说话注意点，小心隔墙有耳。

en: He lost his reason when he saw his house burn down.
cn: 看着自己的房子被烧得精光，他顿时丧失了理智。

en: A long time ago, there lived an old king on a small island.
cn: 很久很久以前，在一座小岛上，住着一个老国王。

en: After all his efforts, he also failed this time.
cn: 虽然这次他很努力，但最后还是失败了。

en: Thank you for the present you gave my son.
cn: 谢谢你送给我儿子礼物。

en: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
cn: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。

en: Excuse me, but would you mind if I opened the window?
cn: 不好意思，请问我可以开窗吗？

en: What's this song? I've heard it before, but I can't remember the name.
cn: 这是什幺歌？我以前听过，但是我想不起歌名了。

en: I was too tired to care for anything but bed.
cn: 我累得只想躺在床上。

en: When are you going to come and see me?
cn: 你啥时候来看我？

en: I think you're the most beautiful girl I've ever seen.
cn: 我想你是我一生中见过最漂亮的女孩。

en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
cn: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。

en: In 1900, he left England, and he never returned.
cn: 1900年他离开英格兰后，就没有再回来。

en: No hobby is as cheap as reading, nor provides such long lasting enjoyment.
cn: 没有任何娱乐像阅读这般廉价，也没有任何愉悦像阅读这般持久。

en: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.
cn: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。

en: The sports world should, at this time, eliminate the collusion with criminal organizations.
cn: 在这个时候，体育世界应当减少犯罪组织的勾结。

en: The boy was not humiliated by the laughter of his classmates.
cn: 那个男孩没有因为他同学的笑而谦卑。

en: The flowers will look more beautiful in the vase.
cn: 把这些花插在花瓶里会更好看。

en: There should be something for us to talk about.
cn: 我们之间应该有共同话题。

en: I didn't go to the party because I was sick.
cn: 我病了，所以那次聚会没去。

en: I think of him as one of my good friends.
cn: 我把他当成自己的好友之一。

en: Tom died two years ago in a plane crash.
cn: 汤姆死于两年前的一次空难。

en: What is written on the road sign? - ONE WAY.
cn: 路标上写的什幺？- 单向行驶。

en: I would like to go to the concert with you.
cn: 我想和你一起去音乐会。

en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.
cn: 你能看到天空中的繁星。

en: On Mid-Autumn Day, families gather, eat moon cake together, and watch the moon.
cn: 在中秋节，家人团聚，一起吃月饼、赏月。

en: I would have liked to come with you, but I didn't have time.
cn: 我想和你一起去，但是我没有时间。

en: I had to abstain from smoking while I was in the hospital.
cn: 在医院的时候，我不得不戒烟。

en: I'll need at least three days to translate that thesis.
cn: 要翻译那篇论文，我最少需要三天时间。

en: The mountain is not as high as Mt. Fuji.
cn: 这座山没有富士山高。

en: There are more than 4000 languages in the world.
cn: 全世界有超过4000多种的语言。

en: He likes not only baseball but football as well.
cn: 他不但喜欢棒球，还喜欢足球。

en: There really is such a thing as Internet addiction.
cn: 确实有网瘾这回事。

en: Private detectives were hired to look into the strange case.
cn: 私家侦探们受雇调查这桩奇怪的案件。

en: He who helps others, in turn shall be helped by them.
cn: 助人者得人助。

en: To tell the truth, I don't really like her.
cn: 老实说，我不太喜欢她。

en: Only a few people came to the meeting yesterday.
cn: 参加昨天会议的只有几个人。

en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
cn: 委员会调查了事故的原因。

en: I got up early to be in time for the train.
cn: 为了赶上那趟火车，我特意起了个大早。

en: This factory's productive capacity is 250 cars a week.
cn: 这家工厂每周能够生产250台车。

en: What are you going to do with your first pay?
cn: 你的第一份工资要怎幺花？

en: She was born in a remote village in Nepal.
cn: 她出生于尼泊尔的一个偏远小山村。

en: She is the most boring girl I ever knew.
cn: 她是我认识的最烦人的女孩。

en: She laughed the way schoolgirls do, with her hand over her mouth.
cn: 她捂着嘴，笑得跟个小女生似的。

en: Some verbs in some languages can have up to one hundred different meanings.
cn: 在一些语言中，部分动词可能会有上百种不同的意思。

en: Tom doesn't know whether Mary likes him or not.
cn: 汤姆不清楚玛丽是否喜欢他。

en: He explained to Mary why he was late for her birthday party.
cn: 他向玛丽解释自己为什幺会在她的生日聚会上迟到。

en: You'll have to get a move on if you want to catch the train.
cn: 要想赶上火车就动作快点。

en: I will tell him about it when he comes next time.
cn: 等他下次来时，我会把这件事告诉他。

en: I need a tool for pulling weeds in my garden.
cn: 我需要工具来给花园除草。

en: I think I will take a vacation this week.
cn: 我觉得我这个星期要度假了。

en: For my part I prefer to stay at home and read a novel.
cn: 至于我比较喜欢待在家看小说。

en: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.
cn: 计算机产业能够提供相当多的就业岗位。

en: He likes to watch the birds fly above his head.
cn: 他喜欢看着鸟儿从头上飞过。

en: Peru is the third largest country in South America after Brazil and Argentina.
cn: 秘鲁是排在巴西和阿根廷之后的南美第三大国家。

en: Excuse me for interrupting you, but would you mind opening the window?
cn: 对不起，打扰一下，能帮忙开下窗子吗？

en: The man next door said he goes for a jog every morning.
cn: 隔壁帅哥说他每天都去慢跑。

en: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
cn: 我被鱼骨刺到了喉咙。

en: You have only to ask him if he'd like to join us.
cn: 你只要问他想不想加入我们就可以了。

en: The longer we waited, the more impatient we became.
cn: 我们越等越不耐烦。

en: If you study earnestly, you can expect to pass the exam.
cn: 如果你认真学习，就有希望通过考试。

en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
cn: 这两条线成直角相交。

en: I got out of the car at 40th Street.
cn: 我在第四十大街下了车。

en: She seems to devote all her effects to her career.
cn: 她似乎把自己所有的精力都投入到了事业上。

en: I can't make out what the man is saying.
cn: 我听不清那个男的在说些什幺。

en: The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
cn: 政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。

en: Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
cn: 汤姆请求妈妈给他买新玩具。

en: Even if it rains, the game will be played.
cn: 就算下雨，比赛也将照常进行。

en: We have five days to go before the summer vacation.
cn: 离放暑假还有五天。

en: Have you already booked our seats on a plane?
cn: 订机票了吗？

en: Can you hear the noise of the waves on the beach?
cn: 你能听到沙滩上海浪的声音吗？

en: It cost me 5,000 yen to repair my bicycle.
cn: 修理自行车花了我5000円。

en: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.
cn: 他们的调查结果显示这篇报导是真实的。

en: Tom was in a hurry so he left his breakfast only half eaten.
cn: Tom赶时间，所以早餐只吃了一半。

en: Who took care of the dog while you were away?
cn: 你不在的时候谁照看狗？

en: He was known to the English as King Philip.
cn: 他是英国人所知的菲利普国王。

en: Do you think he still wants to marry me?
cn: 你认为他还想娶我吗？

en: I am unable to walk as fast as he can.
cn: 我走得没他快。

en: His age didn't enter into our decision not to employ him.
cn: 我们决定不录用他时，并没有考虑他的年龄问题。

en: Can you make out what he is trying to say?
cn: 你明白他想说些什幺吗？

en: I thought I told you that you should get to the concert early.
cn: 难道我没有告诉你演唱会的时候要早点去吗？

en: I can never make my son to eat any vegetables.
cn: 不管我用什幺招数，儿子就是不肯吃青菜。

en: I am still waiting to be told what happened.
cn: 谁来告诉我到底发生了什幺事？

en: Why don't we go to the bookstore on foot?
cn: 不如我们走着去书店吧？

en: If you stand on this stool, you can reach the top of the closet.
cn: 站在这个凳子上的话，你可以摸到衣柜顶。

en: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
cn: 他很坚强，不会那幺容易灰心。

en: I cannot calculate this. I am not an engineer.
cn: 我不是工程师，不会算这个。

en: The baby was sleeping soundly in his mother's arms.
cn: 宝宝在妈妈的怀里睡得很香。

en: This book is easy enough for a five-year-old child to read.
cn: 这本书五岁小孩都能读。

en: Tom couldn't understand why no one else wanted to go to the zoo.
cn: 汤姆想不通为啥没人想去动物园了。

en: I never dreamed that there would be a typhoon.
cn: 我做梦也没想到那儿会有台风。

en: I was really disappointed when I found out that I hadn't passed the exam.
cn: 当我发现我没通过测验时我实在是太沮丧了。

en: There is nothing new transpired since I wrote you last.
cn: 上次写信以来没有什幺新鲜事发生。

en: My heart beat when I heard my name called.
cn: 当我听到我的名字时，我的心都快跳出来了。

en: She's not old enough to get a driver's license.
cn: 她没到拿驾照的年龄。

en: This is the tallest tree I have ever seen.
cn: 这是我见过的最高的树。

en: As was the custom in those days, he married young.
cn: 如当时的习惯，他很年轻便成婚了。

en: The car broke down, so they had to walk.
cn: 因为车子坏了，他们只好步行。

en: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
cn: 我想这工作粗略估计得花上两个星期的时间。

en: How can I deactivate my account on this site?
cn: 我要怎么停用我在这个网站上的帐户？

en: Do you know the girl standing by the window?
cn: 你知道站在窗边的女孩是谁吗？

en: Tokyo, as you know, is one of the financial centers of the world.
cn: 如你所知，东京是全球金融中心之一。

en: I know a good lawyer who can help you.
cn: 我认识一个不错的律师，他可以帮你。

en: Tom always feels hungry at least one hour before lunch.
cn: 汤姆总是在离午餐至少还要一个小时之前就饿了。

en: This book will be of great use to you.
cn: 这本书会对你有很大的用处。

en: Tom can't move this bookcase without a little help.
cn: 如果没人帮点忙的话，汤姆是没办法移动书柜的。

en: I had a dream where a baby was playing with a knife.
cn: 我梦到宝宝在玩刀。

en: Not only the student but their teacher is looking forward to holiday.
cn: 老师和学生一样盼望假期。

en: I do not know whether to take it as a compliment or an insult.
cn: 我真是哭笑不得。

en: The shop is just in front of the station.
cn: 那家店正对着车站。

en: I never dreamed that I would win first prize.
cn: 我从没想到我会得头奖。

en: She went to the station to see her teacher off.
cn: 她去车站给她老师送行。

en: We talked in a low voice so as not to be heard.
cn: 我们小声谈话以免被人听到。

en: Man eats to live, he does not live to eat.
cn: 人为生而食，非为食而活。

en: Whether you will succeed or not depends on your efforts.
cn: 爱拼才会赢。

en: A moldy loaf of bread lay on the table.
cn: 台子上有个发霉的面包。

en: Tatoeba: We've got more sentences than your mom could ever say in her lifetime.
cn: Tatoeba:我们有的句子比你妈这辈子说的都多。

en: However, some people in the audience were not pleased with the results.
cn: 尽管如此，观众中仍有些人不满意这个结果。

en: As far as I know, he is the shortest student in this school.
cn: 据我所知，他是这所学校最差的学生。

en: Tom wanted to talk to Mary face to face.
cn: 汤姆想和玛丽面对面交谈。

en: There are many stores on either side of the street.
cn: 街道两边有许多商店。

en: The book is full of far-flung theories without any basis in scientific fact.
cn: 书中满是遥不可及、没有科学根据的理论。

en: He has to support his mother and his sister.
cn: 他要供养他的妈妈和妹妹。

en: There are no less than five hundred students here.
cn: 这儿有不少于500名的学生。

en: When he saw a policeman coming, he began to run like anything.
cn: 看到警察走来，他猛地跑了开去。

en: A day full of sunshine and a heart full of wishes...
cn: 充满阳光的天和充满愿望的心...

en: The scenery of the city reminded me of London.
cn: 这座城市的景色让我想起了伦敦。

en: Do you have any information on classical music concerts?
cn: 你对古典音乐会有什幺可说的吗？

en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent right away.
cn: 如遇情况紧急，请立即联系我的代理。

en: It is a matter of principle with him to answer your questions honestly.
cn: 诚实地回答你的问题对他来说是个原则问题。

en: Do you have one a little bigger than these?
cn: 有没有比这些稍微大一点的？

en: Could you please tell me again who your father is?
cn: 能再说一遍你爸是谁吗？

en: I can't swallow these tablets without a drink of water.
cn: 不喝水我咽不下这些药片。

en: We should take into account she is still young.
cn: 我们得体谅她年轻。

en: He does not have the money for buying a new car.
cn: 他没钱买新车。

en: Would you like to take a stroll around the park with me?
cn: 你想陪我逛公园吗？

en: I have already completed 4 out of 6 tasks on my to-do list today.
cn: 我已经完成了我今天6点任务列表的4点。

en: I didn't sleep well last night so I have little energy today.
cn: 昨天晚上没睡好，所以我今天精神不振。

en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
cn: 台币上涨，造成台湾的出口贸易萎靡不振。

en: I called at Nancy's house on my way home from school.

cn: 你打算参加汤姆和玛丽的婚礼吗？

en: Tom is writing a letter to his best friend.
cn: 汤姆正给他的好友写信。

en: Tom wasn't as handsome as Mary said he was.
cn: 汤姆并不是玛丽说得那样英俊。

en: Tom couldn't go to college because his family didn't have enough money.
cn: 因为家里钱不够所以汤姆没能念大学。

en: Every time he comes here, he orders the same dish.
cn: 每次他来这里点一样的菜。

en: We are going to the lake to have lunch.
cn: 我们要去湖边吃午餐。

en: Linda is the most beautiful woman in the whole world.
cn: Linda是世上最美的女人。

en: God created all men equal but men think it differently.
cn: 神平等造人而人心各异。

en: I will never forget the day when I first met him.
cn: 我永远不会忘记那天我第一次与他见面。

en: It's the police, perhaps we should get out of their way.
cn: 是警察，也许我们应该让道。

en: She had my mother take care of the baby.
cn: 她让我母亲照顾孩子。

en: It's not wrong, but it's rarely written like that.
cn: 写的没错，不过很少那幺说。

en: My travel fees to Japan are paid for by the university.
cn: 去日本的旅费由大学替我支付。

en: As this girl entered the room, every child was laughing at her little hat.
cn: 当这个女孩走进房间时, 每个孩子都在嘲笑她的小帽子。

en: Yesterday night, I was almost bitten to death by the laboratory mosquitoes.
cn: 昨天晚上，我快被实验室的蚊子咬死了。

en: Tom and Mary could learn a lot from each other.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽可以互相学习很多。

en: I have a ball-point pen, but I want another.
cn: 我有一支圆珠笔，可是我还想再要一支。

en: Tom fell into the ice-cold water of the river.
cn: 汤姆掉进了冰冷的河水里。

en: Is it true that Tom can't read or write?
cn: 汤姆真的不能读或写字吗？

en: The number 4 is considered an unlucky number in Japan.
cn: 四在日本是一个不幸的数字。

en: Scott traded a watch for a book, and then traded the book for money.
cn: 斯科特先用一块手表换了一本书，再把书换成了钱。

en: Happiness is not to be loved, but to love.
cn: 被爱不一定是幸福，去爱才真的幸福。

en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
cn: 茶点过后我们接着开会。

en: Try not to think about her all the time.
cn: 你最好别总去想她。

en: Only sixteen percent of the teachers at the school are female.
cn: 这所学校的老师只有百分之十六是女性。

en: Many important historical events took place 7000 years B.C.
cn: 公元前七千年那段时间发生了很多重要的历史事件。

en: The horse stopped and refused to go any further.
cn: 马停了下来，而且拒绝移动。

en: Tom is a Christian in name only. He never goes to church.
cn: 汤姆名义上是基督徒。他从来不去做礼拜。

en: Tom told me that he had lost his textbook.
cn: 汤姆告诉我他丢了课本。

en: Tom told me that he won't come to school tomorrow.
cn: 汤姆告诉我他明天不来上学。

en: Tom told me that he'd like to become a doctor.
cn: 汤姆告诉我他想当医生。

en: Tom told me that his father had passed away.
cn: 汤姆告诉我他父亲去世了。

en: Tom told us this morning that he and Mary were moving to Boston.
cn: 汤姆告诉我今天上午他和玛丽要搬到波士顿。

en: Tom took out his key and opened the door.
cn: 汤姆掏出钥匙开了门。

en: Tom wanted Mary's phone number, but she refused to give it to him.
cn: 汤姆想要玛丽的电话号码但是被拒绝了。

en: Joseph can say 'I love you' in five languages.
cn: 约瑟夫会说五门语言“我爱你”。

en: Even if I were rich, I wouldn't give him money.
cn: 就算我富有，我也不会给他钱。

en: I can't concentrate. Do you mind turning off the TV?
cn: 我没法集中注意力。你介意关掉电视吗?

en: It's been two years since I started learning Chinese.
cn: 自从我开始学汉语以来已经有两年了。

en: Tom wants to pay back the money he owes.
cn: 汤姆想去还欠的钱。

en: You are the most beautiful girl I have ever seen.
cn: 你是我见过的最漂亮的女孩。

en: Tom is no longer a member of this club.
cn: 汤姆不再是俱乐部的成员了。

en: I don't care as long as you are happy.
cn: 只要你开心就行了。

en: My first day in the university was rather boring.
cn: 我大学里的第一天相当没意思。

en: If you had a time machine, where would you go?
cn: 要是你有架时光机，你想去哪儿？

en: I felt a drop of rain on my head.
cn: 我感觉有滴雨落在头上。

en: She is busy with the care of her children.
cn: 她忙着照料孩子。

en: If I had taken that plane, I would be dead now.
cn: 要是我坐了那架飞机的话，我现在早就死了。

en: You had better take an umbrella with you in case it rains.
cn: 以防下雨你最好带把伞。

en: Your sneakers are dirty; take them off before you come in.
cn: 你的运动鞋太脏了，进来前脱掉。

en: Let me read the paper when you have finished with it.
cn: 报纸看完后借我看下。

en: What would you like to do in the future?
cn: 以后打算干什幺？

en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
cn: 我打心底里感激你。

en: I take a walk every day except when it rains.
cn: 除了雨天我每天都散步。

en: When I left the shopping center, the car wasn't where I had left it.
cn: 当我离开购物中心，车子不在我停的地方。

en: John Dalton was the creator of the atomic theory.
cn: 约翰·道尔顿是原子学说的创始人

en: Mary and Tom have been in love since the eighth grade.
cn: 玛丽和汤姆从8年级开始就相爱了。

en: For some reason she didn't come home last night.
cn: 不知道怎幺回事，她昨天晚上没回家。

en: I want to buy a few pairs of sunglasses.
cn: 我想买几副墨镜。

en: I can't lift a suitcase heavier than 30 kilos.
cn: 我没法举起超过30千克的箱子。

en: I suggest that, out of politeness, we drink as little as possible.
cn: 我建议，为了礼貌起见，我们尽可能少喝。

en: She gave me a hand gesture I didn't understand.
cn: 她给我打了一个看不懂的手势。

en: I've told you not to give me any hickies!
cn: 我都跟你说过了，不要留吻痕！

en: He asked me if I know her phone number.
cn: 他问我，是不是知道她的电话号码。

en: I can't believe Tom was able to do this all by himself.
cn: 没法相信，汤姆没人帮助自己一个人就做到了这些。

en: You need a car if you live in the suburbs.
cn: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。

en: I didn't pay attention to what they were saying.
cn: 他们说了什幺，我并不注意。

en: My wife often called me when I was travelling abroad.
cn: 我在国外旅行的时候，我老婆老给我打电话。

en: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
cn: 你想要知道如何避免皱纹吗？

en: Tom got mercury poisoning from eating canned tuna every day.
cn: Tom汞中毒，因为他每天吃罐装鲔鱼。

en: I don't give a damn what people think about me.
cn: 我才不管别人怎幺想我。

en: In front of you, you can see Tiananmen Square.
cn: 前边儿是天安门。

en: Are you sure you don't want me to say anything?
cn: 你确定要我什幺都不说？

en: I like swimming, but I don't like to swim here.
cn: 我喜欢游泳，但我不想在这里游。

en: Tom has contributed a lot of money to this hospital.
cn: 汤姆捐献了很多钱给这间医院。

en: Tom didn't let his children go to Mary's party.
cn: 汤姆没有让他的孩子们去玛莉的派对。

en: Tom used a fire extinguisher to try and put the fire out.
cn: 汤姆试着用灭火器把火扑灭。

en: Mary doesn't like men who are stingy like Tom.
cn: 玛莉不喜欢跟汤姆一样吝啬的男人。

en: Can you tell me how to get to the train station?
cn: 你可以告诉我如何到火车站吗?

en: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.
cn: 汤姆被卡车撞到而且当场死亡。

en: Tom has made up his mind to go to Boston to study.
cn: 汤姆已经下定决心要去波士顿念书。

en: You'd better keep your money for a rainy day.
cn: 你最好未雨绸缪。

en: That was the first time I'd seen Tom so angry.
cn: 那是我第一次见到汤姆如此生气。

en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
cn: 这场爆炸有可能是瓦斯外泄引起的。

en: Tom began to learn French about three years ago.
cn: 汤姆大约三年前开始学法语。

en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll give you a kiss.
cn: 如果你买给我冰淇淋，我就亲你一下。

en: Tom spends most of his spare time practising the guitar.
cn: 汤姆把他大部分的空闲时间花在练习吉他上。

en: What do you mean? What do you want to tell me?
cn: 你什幺意思？你到底想对我说什幺？

en: That's one of the things that I like about Tom.
cn: 这是我喜欢汤姆的一个方面。

en: Junior, why don't we go into a group together?
cn: Junior，我们为何不一起加入同一个小组呢

en: Being at least bilingual is a must in today's world.
cn: 在当今的世界，拥有双语种是必要的

en: It would be better if you would eat more.
cn: 如果你吃的多一点，你将会比现在好一点

en: In life, you gain and lose things, but also can't force things to happen.
cn: 在人生中，你将会收获和失去，当时你不会强迫事情去发生

en: Courage is a strange thing: One can never be sure of it.
cn: 勇气是一个奇怪的东西：没有任何人对它有把握

en: The main problem with Tom is that he has no sense of humor.
cn: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

en: Christmas gingerbread, also called honey cake, is a traditional German dessert.
cn: 圣诞姜饼/蜂蜜饼是一种传统的德国点心

en: Everyone's used to calling Shanghai "Módū" and calling Beijing "Dìdū".
cn: 大家习惯把上海称为魔都，把北京称为帝都。

en: This newspaper is well known in the local area.
cn: 这家报社在当地知名度颇高。

en: If the Earth went into an Ice Age next month, how would you prepare?
cn: 如果地球下个月将进入冰河期，你将如何准备？

en: I hear that the network is very popular now.
cn: 听说大数据技术现在很热门。

en: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?
cn: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？

en: What a pity that there are more foolish people than smart ones.
cn: 可惜，世界上的愚人总比聪明人要多。

en: Is it more idiomatic if I say it like this?
cn: 这样说是不是更加地道呢？

en: With the increase of cars, the air pollution has gotten worse.
cn: 随着汽车的增加，空气也跟着变糟。

en: I don't know how to say this in Japanese.
cn: 我不知道这个用日语该怎幺说。

en: There are so many example sentences using "Tom" and "Mike". It's very strange.
cn: 很多例句用到“汤姆”和“麦克”，这很奇怪。

en: This is a nice place, but I don't want to live here.
cn: 这是个好地方，但我不想住在这儿。

en: Don't worry, I'm sure that I can find someone else!
cn: 别担心，我确定我能找到其他的人。

en: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
cn: 曾经试过，曾经失败过。没关系，再试一次，再次失败，更好地失败。

en: Tom was the best friend I've ever known, but he also disappointed me.
cn: Tom 是我曾经的朋友里最好的，但是他依然让我失望了。

en: You're the one who decided to do this job, right?
cn: 你是决定做这个工作的那个人，对吗？

en: Am I seriously the only one who isn't bilingual here?
cn: 严肃的讲在这里只有我一个人不会双语的吗？

en: Tom told me that he has no intention of marrying you.
cn: Tom告诉我他们有想要娶你的想法。

en: It feels like it's going to absorb you into another world.
cn: 它的感觉像是它把你吸到了另外一个世界。

en: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
cn: 奥地利在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。

en: Is the water in the Black Sea actually black?
cn: 黑海里的水事实上是黑的吗？

en: In the evening quiet, we enjoy the song of the euphonious nightingale.
cn: 在安静的晚上，我们沉浸在夜莺悦耳的歌声中。

en: Courage is very important. Like a muscle, it is strengthened by use.
cn: 勇气是非常重要的。比如肌肉，经常使用才得以加强。

en: He left for Europe a week ago, that is, on the tenth of May.
cn: 他在一周前离开去往欧洲，就是说，是在五月十号。

en: Tom seems to hardly ever get his homework done on time.
cn: Tom似乎没办法准时完成他的作业。

en: Tom is looking for someone to take Mary's place.
cn: Tom正在找其他人代替Mary。

en: He plays golf two or three times a month.
cn: 他一个月玩两到三次高尔夫。

en: Do you want to know why I lied to Tom?
cn: 你想知道为什幺我对Tom说话吗？

en: He is an honest person, and he will always be lied to.
cn: 他是个忠厚老实的人，不免上当。

en: I don't know whether Tom will eat with us or not.
cn: 我不知道Tom是否和我们一起吃饭。

en: When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
cn: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。

en: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
cn: Tom没有意图去邀请Mary去即将来临的舞会。

en: I let Tom watch a little TV after he finished his homework.
cn: 我让Tom在做完作业后看一点电视。

en: Tom bought a camera at a store not too far from here.
cn: Tom在离这里不远的一家商店里买了一台相机。

en: If I were you, I'd want to know what Tom is doing right now.
cn: 如果我是你，我不会想去知道Tom现在正在做什幺。

en: Tom said he read a book about this ship.
cn: Tom说他在这次的航行中读了一本书。

en: Tatoeba: Better to make no sense than no sentence!
cn: Tatoeba：比起没有句子，没有感觉更好。

en: When was the last time you talked to Mary?
cn: 你上次跟玛丽说是什么时候？

en: The simplest way is often the best way to solve a problem.
cn: 解决问题最简便的方法往往是最好的办法。

en: You must be joking! I can't find my passport!
cn: 别吓我！我的护照不见了！

en: There is a bottle of wine on the table.
cn: 桌子上有一瓶葡萄酒。

en: Give a hug to your parents before you get far away from your hometown.
cn: 在你们远离家乡之前请给父母一个拥抱。

en: I love to watch people's reactions when I say who I am.
cn: 我喜欢观察人们在听到我说出我是谁时的反应。

en: You need to have quick reactions to play these computer games.
cn: 玩这些电脑游戏要反应灵敏。

en: Are you going to eat here or do you want us to wrap it?
cn: 您是在这儿用餐，还是给您打包带走？

en: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
cn: 律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。

en: I'd like some time to consider before I make a decision.
cn: 我想花点时间斟酌斟酌再作决定。

en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
cn: 政府明确宣布了降税的意图。

en: Do you believe that he is telling the truth?
cn: 你相信他在说实话吗？

en: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
cn: 云是天空中的水汽团。

en: The light is too dim for me to read easily.
cn: 灯光太暗了，我没法阅读。

en: I have to go to the dentist this afternoon.
cn: 我今天下午要看牙医。

en: What kind of songs does Tom sing at karaoke?
cn: 汤姆在唱卡拉OK时喜欢什么类型的歌曲呢?

en: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
cn: 最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。

en: I think it necessary for you to study harder.
cn: 我认为你需要更努力学习。

en: Passing through the strong wind, the planes rock like this, but don't worry.
cn: 当飞机穿越强风时，它们会像这样摇晃，但是别担心。

en: The house whose roof you can see is Mr Baker's.
cn: 你能看到屋顶的那栋房子是贝克先生的。

en: How long did it take you to write this report?
cn: 你写这份报告花了多长时间？

en: That man, the child of whom is very friendly.
cn: 那个男人，就是他的孩子很友好的那个.

en: Let's meet at the station at eight tomorrow morning.
cn: 明早八点车站见。

en: When she was thirteen, she ran away from home.
cn: 她十三岁的时候离家出走了。

en: Tom didn't tell me he didn't know how to swim.
cn: 汤姆没有告诉我他不会游泳。

en: There are lots of people who say that's a lie.
cn: 很多人说那是谎话。

en: The best way to solve unemployment is to work.
cn: 解决失业最好的办法是去工作

en: That is the man I see every day on the train.
cn: 那是我每天在火车上看到的男人。

en: I am leaving work, so let's talk another day.
cn: 我下班了，改天聊。

en: It doesn't seem very fair to treat him like this.
cn: 这样对待他似乎不太公平。

en: A lack of exercise is bad for your health.
cn: 缺少运动有害健康。

en: Tom always meddles in affairs that do not concern him.
cn: 汤姆总是多管闲事。

en: Why did you interfere in an affair that did not concern you at all?
cn: 为什幺你要干涉一件跟你完全不相干的事呢？

en: People shouldn't be allowed to invade countries whose names they can't pronounce correctly.
cn: 人们不应该侵犯自己读不正确名字的国家。

en: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.
cn: 就连最黑暗的夜晚都会结束，太阳仍会照常升起。

en: I heard you were injured trying to help Tom.
cn: 我听说你在试图帮助汤姆的时候受伤了。

en: When Mike returned to Jane's house, she was sleeping.
cn: 当迈克返回到简的家的时候，她睡得正熟。

en: Two persons were killed when an elevated bike path collapsed in Rio.
cn: 当里约热内卢的一条高架自行车道倒塌时，有2人被砸死了。

en: Tom learned to ride a bike when he was ten.
cn: 汤姆在10岁的时候就学骑了自行车。

en: Do you know for sure that Tom is behind that?
cn: 你确信汤姆躲在那后面吗？

en: I do not know how to read nor write.
cn: 我不知道如何读或写。

en: That piece of furniture is not fitting for the living room.
cn: 那件家具不适合摆在客厅。

en: Tom never did what we asked him to do.
cn: 我们叫汤姆做什幺，他从来不做。

en: Tom went into the kitchen and poured himself a cup of coffee.
cn: 汤姆进了厨房，给自己倒了杯咖啡。

en: Everyone in the room checked their watches at the same time.
cn: 房间里的所有人都同时看了看自己的手表。

en: I have a few friends who speak French well.
cn: 我有一些法语说得好的朋友。

en: I found a good place to buy fruit a couple of days ago.
cn: 前几天我发现了一个买水果的好地方。

en: Tom had a lot of problems at the school.
cn: 汤姆在学校遇到了很多问题。

en: Mary came home from school in tears because her friends had teased her.
cn: 玛丽哭着从学校跑回了家里，因为她的朋友捉弄了她。

en: It took a long time to take in what she was saying.
cn: 花了很久才能听懂她在说什幺。

en: Kissing a person who smokes is like licking an ashtray.
cn: 亲吻一个抽烟的人就像在舔烟灰缸。

en: I want you guys to do me a favor.
cn: 我想要大家伙帮我个忙。

en: She wrote him a long letter, but he didn't read it.
cn: 她给他写了一封长信，但是他没有看。

en: It is like looking for a needle in a haystack.
cn: 这好比大海捞针。

en: I am not in a situation to discuss this problem.
cn: 我不在讨论这个问题的状态。

en: You should learn how to control that mood of yours.
cn: 您应该学会控制自己的情绪。

en: You'll get used to the dorm life pretty quickly.
cn: 你很快会适应在宿舍的生活的。

en: Most of the residents on this street are wrong 'uns.
cn: 这条路上的许多居民素质都很差。

en: I don't even know what you are called, mate.
cn: 我连你叫什么都不知道。

en: The American mission is to eliminate communism from the world.
cn: 美国的任务是将共产主义从世界上消除。

en: Fuck this, I'm done, spent way too much money.
cn: 完蛋了，钱花得太多了。

en: The problem is, I don't have anything to say to him.
cn: 问题是，我没甚么要跟他说的。

en: I never expected I would end up crying today.
