en: It has always been a pleasure to work with you.
cn: 跟你共事总是很愉快。

en: Tom said it was cold in Boston this time of year.
cn: 汤姆说一年中这时候波士顿很冷。

en: I don't know if that's what Tom wants or not.
cn: 我不知道那是不是汤姆想要的。

en: I don't even know if Tom went to college or not.
cn: 我连汤姆有没有上过大学也不知道。

en: Since he is old, this task must be difficult for him.
cn: 他老了，所以这任务对他来说一定很难。

en: I'll deal with this problem as soon as I can.
cn: 我会尽快处理这问题。

en: All you have to do is say the word, and I'll leave.
cn: 你只要说句话，我就走。

en: You cannot solve this problem in an ordinary way.
cn: 这个问题不能用普通的办法解决。

en: He likes to spend some time in solitude every day.
cn: 他喜欢每天都享受一下一个人的时间。

en: I can't go out, because I was injured a week ago in an accident.
cn: 我一星期前意外受伤，现在不能出外。

en: I don't want to sleep yet, so I'm still studying.
cn: 我还不想睡觉，所以我还在看书。

en: I'll turn over a new leaf and study English very hard.
cn: 我会重新开始，努力学习英语。

en: Mary has more than a hundred pairs of shoes.
cn: 玛丽有一百多双鞋。

en: I didn't know Tom didn't have a driver's license.
cn: 我不知道汤姆没有驾照。

en: How did Tom get Mary to go to the dance with him?
cn: 汤姆怎幺能让玛丽跟他去跳舞呢？

en: This is the shortcut that I usually take to school.
cn: 这通常是我去学校的捷径。

en: It's a pleasure to have you with us again.
cn: 真高兴你又跟我们在一起了。

en: He must have said so without giving it much thought.
cn: 他一定没有多考虑就说了。

en: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.
cn: 听讲座时，你应该保持安静。

en: If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist.
cn: 如果你的牙齿疼，你就应该去看牙医。

en: I'd like to get married to someone like you.
cn: 我想跟你这样的人结婚。

en: This is a good book for children to read.
cn: 这是本对儿童有益的书。

en: Tom told me that I shouldn't go out alone at night.
cn: 汤姆跟我说我不应该晚上一个人出门。

en: How did Tom talk Mary into babysitting his children?
cn: 汤姆是怎幺说服玛丽照顾他的小孩的呢？

en: I don't think I like this game very much.
cn: 我觉得我不太喜欢这游戏。

en: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.
cn: 多数人每天至少刷两次牙。

en: My brother and I are in the same class.
cn: 我的兄弟和我在一个班级。

en: You should have a doctor take a look at it.
cn: 你应该让个医生看看。

en: I don't know about the past, but now we have faxes and emails.
cn: 我不知道以前怎样，但现在我们有传真和电子邮件。

en: I know that you still want to be with me.
cn: 我知道你还是想跟我一起。

en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
cn: 汤姆从没忘记在婚礼周年纪念日送给他妻子花。

en: I worked as a piano tuner for many years.
cn: 我做钢琴调音师很多年了。

en: You cannot buy friends, you can only make friends.
cn: 你买不来朋友，你只能交朋友。

en: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
cn: 必须有外交解决的途径。

en: Would you like to know how I did that?
cn: 你想知道我是怎么做的吗？

en: I need to find out when we need to be there.
cn: 我得知道我们要什么时候到。

en: The company medical treatment insurance covered all the medical treatment costs.
cn: 公司的医疗保险覆盖了全部的医疗费用。

en: He has an interesting job but it requires a lot of skill.
cn: 他有个很有意思但很费功夫的工作。

en: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.
cn: 哪怕没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。

en: He thought she spoke reasonably, so he accepted her suggestion.
cn: 他觉得她说得很有道理，于是接受了她的建议。

en: This morning, I was very lazy and didn't go out.
cn: 今天早上我因为太懒而没有出门。

en: I would like to have a discussion with Mr. Zhang and Mr. Li.
cn: 我要和张先生、李先生谈谈。

en: The two of them are two busy now; they can't talk to you.
cn: 他们两位现在太忙了，不想跟你谈。

en: After today, I want to send the manuscript to a publishing house.
cn: 天好以后，我要把稿子送到出版社去。

en: Good. Can you make long distance calls from the room?
cn: 好的。房间里长途电话可以直拨吗？

en: No need to say anything more. How about we go to Zhouzhuang?
cn: 不谈了！我们去周庄玩怎幺样？

en: Look at him. He looks like an idiot but he's also very cute.
cn: 你看他傻乎乎的模样，倒也挺可爱。

en: Between friends, to have a heart-to-heart is really rejuvenating.
cn: 朋友之间，大家谈谈心，非常爽快。

en: In Japan, it is polite to bow when one meets someone.
cn: 在日本，遇到人鞠躬是有礼貌的表现。

en: Can you help me dial? The telephone is put too high.
cn: 您能帮我拨号吗？电话机放得太高了。

en: He told me sadly, "I'm not sure whether I should be alive."
cn: 他难过的对我说: "我很犹豫我是否应该活下来".

en: He's making it clear that he's an ideal husband.
cn: 他表明自己是一个理想的丈夫。

en: The girl waiting for that boy is a friend of mine.
cn: 她在等的那个男孩是我的一个朋友。

en: The multinational corporation has forecast the implementation of economies of scale.
cn: 跨国公司预料到了规模经济的实行。

en: She spent a lot of time practicing the piano.
cn: 她花很多时间在练习弹钢琴。

en: When one is in difficulty and comports themselves well, that is a master.
cn: 人之患，在好为人师。

en: You just put a toy down on the table.
cn: 你刚才把一个玩意儿落在桌上了。

en: His parents are moving back to their home town.
cn: 他父母搬回乡下去了。

en: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.
cn: 你的歌声像太平洋的海水一样清澈。

en: Every day I think: wouldn't life be great if I didn't have to work.
cn: 我每天都在想，要是可以不用上班能有多好。

en: This boy often breaks our window with his ball.
cn: 这个男孩常常用球打破我们的窗户。

en: Only if you put up a different sign can you become a miscellany store.
cn: 只要换上不同招牌，就能成为各种商店。

en: There are some things that people like to avoid discussing.
cn: 有些事情，人们喜欢避而不谈。

en: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.
cn: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。

en: Who doesn't know that if there's someone who loves showing off, it's him?
cn: 谁人不知，最爱卖弄的就是他！

en: No one could guess why that thing had happened to him.
cn: 没有人猜得出为什幺那种事会发生在他身上。

en: We're going to hire the most famous makeup artist for our cast's makeup.
cn: 我们将邀请最有名的化妆师为我们的演员化妆。

en: Everything has been suspected and been inspected; thoughts have no boundaries.
cn: 所有的事物都要被怀疑、被验证，思想没有界限。

en: For one's health, both work and play are necessary.
cn: 为了健康，工作和玩乐都是必要的。

en: He is already skilled in both math and literature.
cn: 他既精于数学又精于文学。

en: Tom, I want to have a chat with you.
cn: Tom，我想和你谈谈。

en: You think adding a little salt will make it taste much better?
cn: 你觉得再加一点盐味道会更好？

en: I got to the bank and luckily didn't have to get in line.
cn: 我到银行去，很幸运地不必排队。

en: Your way of looking at criticism and self-criticism is not right.
cn: 你对批评和自我批评这两者的看法不对。

en: I like shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
cn: 我喜欢在纽约第五大街购物。

en: I'll go with you as far as the bridge.
cn: 我会跟着你走到桥那里。

en: I wonder why they left my name off the list.
cn: 我奇怪他们为什幺在表里把我的名字落下了。

en: Tom has no one to turn to for help.
cn: 汤姆没有能求助的人。

en: A lot of people swim here in the summer.
cn: 许多人夏天在这里游泳。

en: You should set a good example for your children.
cn: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好榜样。

en: Tom told me he had a right to see it.
cn: 汤姆告诉我他有权看它。

en: Could you please talk a bit louder? I can't hear very well.
cn: 你能大声点讲吗？我听不太清。

en: If you have something to say, just say it.
cn: 你想说就说。

en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.
cn: 汤姆拿起罐子读标签。

en: I am entirely incapable of accepting this minister's arguments.
cn: 我完全无法接受这位公使的言论。

en: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
cn: 你在签字前必须仔细看合同。

en: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.
cn: 看来汤姆热恋着玛丽。

en: If I'd known the truth, I'd have told you.
cn: 如果我知道真相，我就告诉你了。

en: I'll let you know when I've figured it out.
cn: 我搞明白了会告诉你。

en: It was very kind of you to lend me an umbrella.
cn: 你借给我伞真好。

en: Do you want to go on a picnic with me?
cn: 你想跟我去野餐吗？

en: It is an hour's drive from here to there.
cn: 从这到那驾车要一个小时。

en: I'll stop by your place on my way home.
cn: 我会在回家路上顺便去你家。

en: He failed the exam, but he doesn't care too much.
cn: 他考试失败了，但他不太在意。

en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
cn: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

en: Tom and Mary went to the best restaurant in town.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽去了镇上最好的饭店。

en: Tom didn't doubt that there would be a lot of people there.
cn: 汤姆确定那里会有很多人。

en: We need you to tell us why you were absent all last week.
cn: 我们要你告诉我们你为什幺整个上周都缺勤。

en: Feel free to get yourself a drink if you are thirsty.
cn: 觉得渴了就喝点。

en: Tom said he wouldn't be able to do what we asked him to do.
cn: 汤姆说他做不成我们要他做的事。

en: We used to go to the movies on Saturday evening.
cn: 我们曾经总在星期六傍晚去看电影。

en: Tom didn't need to finish that work by today.
cn: 汤姆不必今天就完成那工作。

en: Can you please tell me your name once more?
cn: 请问你能再告诉我一遍你的名字吗？

en: Can I get a refund for this train ticket?
cn: 这张火车票能报销吗？

en: How do you get your children to eat vegetables?
cn: 你怎样让你的孩子们吃蔬菜？

en: I came to warn you not to do that.
cn: 我来警告你别那样做。

en: I want to go to school and study hard.
cn: 我想上学并努力学习。

en: Tom said he wasn't sure what Mary wanted to do.
cn: 汤姆说他不确定玛丽想做什幺。

en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.
cn: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。

en: I studied in the morning during the summer vacation.
cn: 我在暑假里早晨学习。

en: Although he was exhausted, he had to keep working.
cn: 尽管他累极了，他还得继续工作。

en: Tom has been to this park with Mary at least a dozen times.
cn: 汤姆跟玛丽来这公园至少十二次。

en: Tom told me to take good care of myself.
cn: 汤姆告诉我要照顾好我自己。

en: He is richer than anyone else in this town.
cn: 他比镇里的其他人都有钱。

en: Tom is wearing the same clothes he wore yesterday.
cn: 汤姆穿着昨天穿的衣服。

en: There were so many things I wanted to ask Tom.
cn: 我有很多事想问汤姆。

en: Tom wrote his name in the sand with a stick.
cn: 汤姆用棍子在沙上写了他的名字。

en: He has three times as many books as I have.
cn: 他的书有我的三倍多。

en: Does it matter to you how much it costs?
cn: 它花多少钱对你很重要吗？

en: Don't worry. We have plenty of water and food.
cn: 别担心。我们有大量水和食物。

en: A great number of books are published every year.
cn: 每年都有大量新书出版。

en: Every day I waited for her at the bookstore after school.
cn: 我每天放学后都在书店等她。

en: Tom is in the living room, sleeping on the couch.
cn: 汤姆在客厅长沙发上睡觉。

en: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.
cn: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。

en: I believe the actions that he took were right.
cn: 我相信他采取的行动是对的。

en: It's getting dark. I wonder if it's going to rain.
cn: 天变暗了。我不知道是不是要下雨。

en: She and I have been married for ten years.
cn: 他和她结婚十年了。

en: I've been feeling sick for the last two days.
cn: 我这两天感觉难受。

en: I think I can run as fast as Tom.
cn: 我认为我能跑得跟汤姆一样快。

en: We have one of your friends here with us.
cn: 你的一个朋友在我们这里。

en: Tom can't go out because he has a lot of homework.
cn: 汤姆因为有很多作业不能外出。

en: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.
cn: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。

en: I think I'll be able to deal with that.
cn: 我认为我能做好。

en: I found a taxi, but there was no driver inside.
cn: 我找到了一辆出租车，但里面却没有司机。

en: So as to avoid being late, we went by car.
cn: 我们乘车去以免迟到

en: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
cn: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

en: Three weeks went by with no sign of Tom.
cn: 三星期过去了，没有Tom一点消息

en: Tom might be here by 2:30, but then, maybe not.
cn: tom 两点半可能会到，不过，也可能不会

en: When were you planning on telling Tom about what happened?
cn: 你准备啥时候告诉Tom发生了什幺

en: It would've been better if you'd stayed with Tom.
cn: 如果你和Tom呆在一起，结果会更好

en: She is proud that her son has become a doctor.
cn: 她为自己的儿子成为医生而自豪。

en: Can I talk to you privately for a minute?
cn: 我能跟你私下谈一分钟吗？

en: I met Tom for the first time three days ago.
cn: 我三天前第一次见汤姆。

en: Tom ran out of matches so he couldn't light the fire.
cn: 汤姆用尽了火柴，不能点火了。

en: You'll get used to this in three or four weeks.
cn: 你在三或四周内就会习惯。

en: Tom wished he hadn't borrowed the book from Mary.
cn: 汤姆希望他没有从玛丽那里借书。

en: Tom came up with an answer to our problem.
cn: 汤姆给我们的问题想出了个答案。

en: She stayed in that area for a short while.
cn: 她在那地方待了片刻。

en: We want to be on the first bus tomorrow morning.
cn: 我们想乘明天早上第一班公交车。

en: I was kept waiting for nearly half an hour.
cn: 我等了接近半小时。

en: If you are me, how can you do it?
cn: 如果你是我，你会怎么做？

en: Someone who doesn't understand you is not necessarily an idiot.
cn: 一个不懂你的人不一定就是一个笨蛋。

en: I am waiting for you to finish your homework.
cn: 我等你把作业做完。

en: We can find similar situations in these next few cases.
cn: 同样的情况我们还能在下面这几个例子中找到。

en: We can now say definitely that this hypothesis holds water.
cn: 我们现在能肯定地说，这个假设是成立的。

en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.
cn: 冷战以苏联解体结束。

en: She may be late, in which case we will wait.
cn: 她可能迟到，然后我们就要等。

en: Are you sure you don't want to sleep on it?
cn: 你确定你不想睡在它上面吗？

en: I wish I could buy you everything you wanted.
cn: 我希望我能买下你想要的所有东西。

en: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.
cn: 他的失败看来有几个原因。

en: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
cn: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。

en: I can't let you give me your last ten dollars.
cn: 你就剩下这十美圆了。我不能要。

en: This is where I want to live for the rest of my life.
cn: 这里是我余生想待的地方

en: What time did you get to bed last night?
cn: 你昨天甚么时候睡觉？

en: The problem is who is going to tell him the truth.
cn: 问题是谁要告诉他真相。

en: We haven't yet been told what we need to do.
cn: 还没人告诉我们要做甚么。

en: I can talk about anything with my best friend.
cn: 我能跟我最好的朋友说任何事。

en: Did you have any difficulty in finding my house?
cn: 你找我的房子有困难吗？

en: I've done bad things that I should be punished for.
cn: 我做了该受罚的坏事。

en: Tom was the first to arrive and the last to leave.
cn: 汤姆最先来，最后走。

en: Tom has spent the past three years in prison.
cn: 汤姆在监狱里待了三年。

en: It was a bag that I lost in the room yesterday.
cn: 那是我昨天落在房间里的包。

en: Tom took out his wallet and paid the bill.
cn: 汤姆拿出钱包付了账。

en: He is going to drive you to the airport.
cn: 他要载你去机场。

en: Tom has never been willing to help us before.
cn: 汤姆以前从不这样愿意幚我们。

en: That coat may have cost a lot of money, but it's worth it.
cn: 那件大衣可能需要很多钱，但它值得。

en: One morning I shot an elephant in my pyjamas.
cn: 一天早晨我穿着睡衣射了一头大象

en: I will make it clear that I won't come again.
cn: 我要明确表示我不会再来了。

en: You may have been the last person to see Tom.
cn: 你可能是最后一个见汤姆的人。

en: Tom was the one that told us about the problem.
cn: 汤姆是告诉我们问题的人。

en: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
cn: 我不想把结局提前透露给你。

en: I made a bet that she would win the game.
cn: 我赌她赢这比赛。

en: What's the difference between an eagle-owl and a barn owl?
cn: 雕鸮和仓鸮有什幺区别？

en: She put two pairs of sheer tights in the suitcase.
cn: 她在行李箱中放进了两条裤袜。

en: Do you still want to give me a hug?
cn: 你还想拥抱我一下吗？

en: As soon as he sat down, he picked up the telephone.
cn: 他一坐下，就拿起了电话。

en: I think you should do that before you go home today.
cn: 我认为你该在今天回家前做。

en: Many of Europe's metropolises are plagued by the doughnut phenomenon.
cn: 许多欧洲的大都市饱受“甜甜圈现象”困扰。

en: One more effort, you will get on in life.
cn: 再努力一下，你的人生会成功的。

en: Mike said a few words by way of suggestion.
cn: 麦克以建议的口气说了些话。

en: The police seem to know exactly where we are.
cn: 警察看来很清楚我们在哪里。

en: All I really want to do is talk to Tom.
cn: 我就想跟汤姆说话。

en: I think we've found what we were looking for.
cn: 我看我们找到要找的东西了。

en: It looks like Tom has bought a new bicycle.
cn: 看来汤姆借了辆自行车。

en: Tom knows I want to leave as soon as possible.
cn: 汤姆知道我想尽早离开。

en: Can I have a free ride, please? My wallet was stolen.
cn: 请问我能搭下车吗？我的钱包被偷了。

en: He was born in a palace that isn't there any more.
cn: 他出生在一个宫殿里，那宫殿已经不存在了。

en: Do you think Tom will let us do that?
cn: 你认为汤姆会让我们做吗？

en: Tom went out for a walk with his dog.
cn: 汤姆带他的狗出去走。

en: She's practicing English so she can get a better job.
cn: 她练习英语以找更好的工作。

en: I think we shouldn't let Tom do that again.
cn: 我认为我们不该让汤姆再那么做。

en: For the sake of living things, please do not play around with the water.
cn: 关爱生命，请勿嬉水。

en: One step forward is a step forward for civilization.
cn: 向前一步，走向文明。

en: You're too old to be doing this kind of thing.
cn: 你太老了，做不得这种事了。

en: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?
cn: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？

en: I think you're a lot stronger than you know.
cn: 我认为你比你想象的更强。

en: I'm sure I can find something for you to do.
cn: 我确定我能找点给你做的事。

en: He became a member of this club five years ago.
cn: 他在五年前成为了这个俱乐部的成员。

en: Tom said he wanted to try riding a unicycle.
cn: 汤姆说他想试试骑独轮车。

en: You can see the roof of the house from there.
cn: 你能从那里看到房顶。

en: I've been looking for a new job for a long time.
cn: 我找工作已经很久了。

en: The taxi I took was very old and small.
cn: 我打的这辆出租车很老，也很小。

en: I did what I promised to do for them.
cn: 我做到了我承诺要为他们做的事情。

en: Tom had no intention of giving Mary any money.
cn: 汤姆不想给玛丽一分钱。

en: What do you think about having breakfast at McDonald's?
cn: 你觉得在麦当劳吃早餐如何？

en: Is it true that you built this house by yourself?
cn: 你真是自己造了这栋房子吗？

en: This book says that elephants live to be over 100 years old.
cn: 这本书上写，大象能活过一百岁。

en: That was the most interesting novel that I had ever read.
cn: 这是我所读过的最有趣的小说。

en: The red house is the one that Jack built.
cn: 那个红房子就是杰克盖的房子。

en: Since I was sick, I didn't go to school.
cn: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。

en: Tomorrow, my father is going to make a good meal.
cn: 我父亲明天会做一桌好菜。

en: Have you been feeling a bit of discomfort lately?
cn: 你最近是不是身体有点不舒服？

en: Everyone gathered together in the open space to meet.
cn: 大家都在空地集合开会。

en: We are finding it difficult to decide which one to buy.
cn: 我们发现很难决定买哪个。

en: If you were a squirrel, what would you do?
cn: 如果你是只松鼠，你会怎幺做？

en: How much do you want in terms of salary?
cn: 您想要多少工资？

en: In March next year, I will take a plane to the USA.
cn: 明年三月我坐飞机去美国。

en: I don't think you need to give an explanation.
cn: 我觉得你不要解释。

en: From a distance, this stone looks like a human face.
cn: 从远看得话，这个石头看起来像人的脸。

en: He has endured sacrifices for America that most of us cannot begin to imagine.
cn: 他为美国承受了比我们大多数人所能想象的更多的牺牲。

en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
cn: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

en: I don't think that it's going to be easy to find Tom.
cn: 我认为，要找到汤姆可不容易。

en: Anna, where will your father be at this time tomorrow?
cn: 安娜，你爸爸明天这个时候在哪里？

en: Xiaolin's eyebrows are thick, his eyes are big, and his eyelashes are long.
cn: 小林的眉毛长得浓，眼睛又大，睫毛很长。

en: You are so beautiful, you do not need to use makeup.
cn: 你很美, 甚至不必使用化妆品。

en: Tonight we are planning to go to the concert.
cn: 今晚我们打算去听音乐会。

en: Even though we are far apart, we still keep in touch.
cn: 尽管距离很远，我们还是保持着通信联系。

en: He can speak not only English, but also French.
cn: 他能通英语甚至法语。

en: My son is not at home, he is at school.
cn: 我儿子不在家，他在学校。

en: Our football team defeated all the other teams in the city.
cn: 我们的足球队打败了市里所有其他队。

en: I am sorry, he is not at home, he left for Madrid yesterday.
cn: 对不起，他不在家，他昨天去马德里了。

en: You are to come here at 9 o'clock tomorrow.
cn: 明天你九点钟要来这里的。

en: Tomorrow we are going to see the meteor shower!
cn: 明天要看流星雨啊！

en: I'm sorry that I made you wait for so long today.
cn: 今天很抱歉，让你等了这幺多时间。

en: Our biggest enemy may not be someone else, but ourselves.
cn: 我们最大的敌人不是别人，可能是自己。

en: If you have any other issues, please notify me through the form.
cn: 如果你有其他问题，请通过表格发给我。

en: The soul is made up of reason, determination, and passion.
cn: 灵魂是由理性、意志和情欲构成的。

en: I don't dare to do that kind of thing.
cn: 我不敢做这种事。

en: What are the prerequisites for a child to learn the piano?
cn: 孩子学钢琴要具备哪些条件？

en: The man I bumped into yesterday was Mr. Hill.
cn: 我昨天碰到的男人是Hill先生。

en: Using only "Tom" and "Mike" in many sentences is very strange.
cn: 在很多句子里只用“汤姆”和“迈克”，这很奇怪。

en: When the lights went out, Tom lit a candle.
cn: 灯灭了，汤姆点起了蜡烛。

en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
cn: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

en: My father has never been outside the country until now.
cn: 此前我父亲从没出过国。

en: I think you're going to want to sit down.
cn: 我觉得你想坐下。

en: I often slept on that bench when I was homeless.
cn: 当我无家可归的时候，我常在那张长椅上睡觉。

en: Now is a great time to buy one of those.
cn: 现在是买它的最好时机。

en: I am surprised that your family has a Japanese car.
cn: 我很惊讶，你家居然有辆日本车。

en: Do not leave the lights on when you leave the room.
cn: 离开房间时，不要留灯。

en: Australia is about twenty times as large as Japan.
cn: 澳大利亚差不多比日本大二十倍。

en: He sat down and read while his wife was cooking by the fire.
cn: 他妻子在灶旁做饭，而他在坐着读书。

en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
cn: 规则要少，并且最重要的是要简单。

en: I thought Tom would want to know about that.
cn: 我本以为汤姆愿意了解这件事。

en: Whoever said money can't buy happiness simply didn't know where to go shopping.
cn: 那些说钱不能买来幸福的人，只是不知道上哪里去买而已。

en: Music is well said to be the speech of angels.
cn: 人们说得好，音乐是天使的话语。

en: Everyone was just flabbergasted that she was able to get pregnant at 48.
cn: 她48岁怀上了孩子，所有人都目瞪口呆。

en: I have no more time to talk with you.
cn: 我没时间再跟你说话了。

en: I don't know what I'm going to do next.
cn: 我不知道接下来我要做什幺。

en: Tom went over and sat down next to Mary.
cn: 汤姆来了，坐到了玛丽的边上。

en: One generation builds the street that the next will travel on.
cn: 前人铺路，后人行路。

en: I am certain that we will find a solution.
cn: 我确信我们会找到解决办法的。

en: Why do you need to read such a book?
cn: 为什幺你要读这样一本书？

en: We were disappointed to hear that Tom couldn't get a visa.
cn: 我们很遗憾地听说，汤姆没能拿到签证。

en: Tom told Mary that it would probably snow all day.
cn: 汤姆告诉玛丽雪可能会下一整天。

en: Tom wants to learn boxing, but his mother thinks it's too dangerous.
cn: 汤姆想学拳击，但他妈妈觉得这太危险了。

en: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
cn: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？

en: Those who know don't speak much; those who speak don't know much.
cn: 懂的不多说，说的多不懂。

en: My school is to the left of my house.
cn: 我的学校在我家左边。

en: I love the name Bella. It means "pretty", right?
cn: 我喜欢Bella这个名字，它的意思是“漂亮”，是吗？

en: I'm very tired and don't have a place to sleep.
cn: 我很累，还没地方睡觉。

en: I know the real reason you don't want to go.
cn: 我知道你不想去的真实原因。

en: It is impossible to master English in a short time.
cn: 不可能短时间内学会英语。

en: Dan left Linda when life became unbearable with her.
cn: Dan离开了Linda，因为已经没法和她一起过日子了。

en: Had I the money, I would immediately acquire this computer.
cn: 我要是有钱，立马就买这台电脑。

en: My friend believes conspiracy theories; should I try to prove him wrong?
cn: 我的朋友相信阴谋论，我该试着向他指出他错了吗？

en: You can lie to everyone else, but you can't lie to yourself.
cn: 你可以向别人撒谎，但你不会向自己撒谎。

en: Every dumbass with a camera thinks he is a photographer.
cn: 每个有照相机的傻瓜都觉得自己是摄影家。

en: I suspect they water down the beer in that pub.
cn: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。

en: Let's go for a walk after it stops raining.
cn: 等雨停了，我们去散步吧。

en: I think she is showing off her new dress to us.
cn: 我觉得，她想向我们显摆她的新裙子。

en: I've dreamt about you nearly every night this week.
cn: 这个礼拜的每个晚上，我几乎都会梦到你。

en: This is the house of Mary, her brother and their parents.
cn: 这是玛丽、他兄弟以及他们父母的房子。

en: Please buy me a turtle, Mother, please buy me a turtle.
cn: 给我买只乌龟吧，妈妈，求你给我买只乌龟吧！

en: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
cn: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎幺办。

en: I want to show you something in my office.
cn: 我想给你看看我办公室里的一些东西。

en: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
cn: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。

en: How do I get my dog to eat dog food?
cn: 怎幺样才能让我的狗吃狗粮？

en: They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.
cn: 他们往前走而我一直都在往后退。

en: Due to the heavy rain, vegetable prices have risen.
cn: 多亏了这场大雨，蔬菜价格直线上升。

en: My parents live a carefree life in the countryside.
cn: 我父母在乡村过着无忧无虑的生活。

en: He has his faults, but I still like him.
cn: 他有他的缺点，但是我依然喜欢他。

en: In IT companies, people who are good at maths are well respected.
cn: 在 IT 公司里，数学好的人容易得到尊敬。

en: Maybe I will have to spend my entire life in prison.
cn: 也许我要在牢里度过一生。

en: By the time I arrived at the school, the class had already finished.
cn: 当我到学校的时候，课程已经结束了。

en: People who play with mud will get their hands dirty.
cn: 玩泥的人会弄脏自己的双手。

en: Tom asks his mother if she can but him a new toy.
cn: 汤姆请求他母亲给他买新玩具。

en: At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.
cn: 典礼结束时，新人接了吻。

en: Jump down! There is nothing else you can do!
cn: 跳下来！没有任何别的可作的！

en: I am sorry to bother you at this time.
cn: 很抱歉在这个时间打扰您。

en: If you want to change the world, then you should start with yourself.
cn: 如果你想改变世界，就从你自己开始吧。

en: Many people think that success means having a lot of money.
cn: 很多人认为成功就是拥有很多钱。

en: Look at this table; it has been written out clearly.
cn: 你看这张表吧，上面已经写清楚了。

en: In this soup there are carrots, onions, parsley, celery and potatoes.
cn: 这个汤里有胡萝卜、洋葱、欧芹、芹菜和土豆。

en: Tomorrow will be a sunny day, and very hot.
cn: 明天是晴天，很热。

en: My school library has a collection of 2.5 million books.
cn: 我校图书馆藏书二百五十万册。

en: It's been a very long time since I saw him last.
cn: 我很久没见他了。

en: Her parents are very beautiful, but she looks ordinary.
cn: 她父母很漂亮，而她却长得一般。

en: I am telling a good story to my younger friend.
cn: 跟我的年轻朋友讲一个好听的故事。

en: If you want to lose weight, then you need to control your appetite.
cn: 想要减肥就必须控制食欲。

en: The bus stop is located right outside where I live.
cn: 公共汽车的停车站正好坐落在我的住所前面。

en: He is contemplating whether or not to buy the book.
cn: 他在纠结要不要买这本书

en: If I had the money, I would buy a new house.
cn: 如果我有钱，我会买一个新房子。

en: I have three times as many books as you do.
cn: 我有的书是你的三倍。

en: I have a friend whose father is a magician.
cn: 我有一个父亲是魔术师的朋友。

en: Yesterday, I went to the doctor to see if I was ill.
cn: 昨天我去看医生做检查，看看有没有病。

en: Who can tell me what the acronym Tatoeba stands for?
cn: 谁能告诉我TATOEBA首字母缩合词的意思？

en: He is about to become a diplomat at the Chinese Embassy in France.
cn: 他将要成为中国驻法国大使馆的外交官。

en: Please go to the supermarket to buy some fruit.
cn: 请你去超市买些水果来。

en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.
cn: 他们垄断了原物料供应，并开天价。

en: She will never be able to get the things she pursues!
cn: 她追求的东西，可是永远无法得到的啊！

en: I don't have a car, but my sister does.
cn: 我没有车，但我姐妹有。

en: I bought this pair of shoes, but they are a bit too small.
cn: 我买了这双鞋，但是有点太小了。

en: The customer and the salesman spoke for two hours on the phone.
cn: 客人和售货员打了2小时电话。

en: He is always very respectful of his wife's opinions.
cn: 他总是很尊重妻子的意见。

en: Schoolwork, cultural work and academic work should all be promoted together.
cn: 学生工作、文化工作和学术工作应该同时推进。

en: Every year, the summers get hotter and the winters get colder.
cn: 夏天一年比一年热，冬天一年比一年冷。

en: There can only be one world champion. The question is: Who will it be?
cn: 只有一个人能成为世界冠军。问题是：会是谁呢？

en: You understand more than me about this sort of thing.
cn: 这件事，你知道得比我清楚。

en: There was enough of A, but not enough of B.
cn: A够了，但是B不够。

en: Are you going to the airport to see your teacher off?
cn: 你去不去飞机场送你老师？

en: I don't want to go in the car. I would rather walk.
cn: 我不想坐汽车去，宁可走去。

en: He doesn't have a friend he can rely on.
cn: 他没有一个能依靠的朋友。

en: He is now running the business for his father.
cn: 他为他父亲打理生意。

en: The world is not so bad. Of course, it is better when you succeed.
cn: 世界不是如此糟糕，当然，你成功后，他会更美好。

en: He not only graduated from studying sociology, but also philosophy.
cn: 他不仅社会学毕业，还有哲学。

en: How many chairs do you have around your table?
cn: 你家桌子边有几个椅子？

en: The young man is both capable and energetic, needless to say.
cn: 这小伙子既能干又积极，真是没说的。

en: It is easy to write love letters in Esperanto.
cn: 用世界语写情书很容易。

en: There hasn't been a drop of rain in two weeks.
cn: 两周没有下过一滴雨了。

en: Lucy and I are not colleagues, we are classmates.
cn: 我和露西不是同事，是同学。

en: I don't know what I should be doing right now.
cn: 我不知道，我现在应该做什幺。

en: She likes to drink red wine, but doesn't like to drink white wine.
cn: 她喜欢喝红酒，不喜欢喝白酒。

en: Hey, could you send over a stack of manuscripts straight away?
cn: 喂，请问现在能给我马上送一叠稿子吗？

en: Is there anyone who wants to keep the cute kitten?
cn: 有没有人要养可爱的小猫？

en: I will need to think for a while before I answer you.
cn: 我回答您之前要好好考虑一下。

en: There is nowhere in the whole world without poverty.
cn: 全世界没有一个地方没有贫穷。

en: If there is something you don't understand, then ask.
cn: 如果你有什么不懂的就问。

en: We study English, since it is an important subject nowadays.
cn: 我们学习英语，就今天来说是一项重要科目。

en: Run faster, or you won't be able to catch the train.
cn: 跑得再快些，不然你就赶不上火车了。

en: I have less than five friends who can speak French.
cn: 我有不到五个朋友会说法语。

en: The sky will probably turn clear in the afternoon.
cn: 下午大概天转晴。

en: Tom ran as fast as he could to announce the good news to Mary.
cn: 汤姆以最快的速度跑着，好向玛丽宣布好消息。

en: My sister is 20 years old. She is a university student.
cn: 我妹妹二十岁。她是大学生。

en: When I heard the news, I wanted to cry.
cn: 当我听到这个消息时，我想哭。

en: Inside the room there is a smell of smoke.
cn: 房间里一股烟味。

en: Last Thursday, I was at his home in Madrid.
cn: 上个星期四我在他马德里的家。

en: In an empty place, an emperor has no power.
cn: 在空无一物的地方, 皇帝再大的权力也无用。

en: All of the children are listening to the teacher's words.
cn: 所有小孩都听老师的话。

en: He speaks English so fluently that he resembles an American.
cn: 他说英语流利得就好像他是美国人。

en: Even though she is dieting, the chocolate cake still tempts her.
cn: 虽然她节食, 巧克力蛋糕仍然诱惑着她。

en: It's best if you don't poke your nose into other people's business.
cn: 你最好不要插手别人的事务。

en: The wind is strong, so I am not going quickly.
cn: 风很大, 所以我走不快。

en: I was forced to go to work on Sunday.
cn: 我被迫在星期天上班。

en: We have to be there an hour in advance to get our tickets.
cn: 咱们的票是得提前一小时去取得。

en: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
cn: 抱歉，地铁几号线去市中心？

en: There are often border conflicts between these two countries.
cn: 这两个国家经常发生边境冲突。

en: I have no intention in arguing about your theory.
cn: 我无意争辩你的理论。

en: When I first met her, she was nearly 30 years old.
cn: 我第一次遇到她的时候，她将近三十岁的年纪。

en: Tomorrow, I want to go to Madrid. It is the capital city of Spain.
cn: 我明天要去马德里，也就是西班牙的首都。

en: Your Chinese is so good, you can quote proverbs.
cn: 你中文真好，都能引用俗语了。

en: She can only go to the company to do voluntary work on Sundays.
cn: 她星期天也只能去公司做义务劳动了。

en: Despite a lot of difficulties, he still completed the task.
cn: 虽然困难重重，他还是完成了这个任务。

en: Please give it a check, then hand in the examination paper.
cn: 请大家认真检查一次，再把考卷交上来。

en: I am writing a paper on the French Revolution.
cn: 我在写一篇有关法国大革命的论文。

en: Then people knew, that the world is a sphere.
cn: 当时人们就知道，地球是个球体。

en: I don't know if I can go to the party.
cn: 我不知道我是否可以去派对。

en: The clouds are large, and the raindrops are small.
cn: 云朵大，雨点小。

en: I have a question I want you to answer. Can you?
cn: 有个问题想请教您，可以吗？

en: The widow mourned for her husband for a long time.
cn: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

en: I came to know this from some reliable sources.
cn: 这件事是我透过可靠的消息来源得知的。

en: I can translate between Chinese and English, and can participate in negotiations with foreigners.
cn: 我可以做中英双向翻译，参加跟外国人交际谈判。

en: I don't have time to meet up with you.
cn: 我没时间跟您碰头。

en: I don't believe that there are ghosts in the world.
cn: 我不相信世界上有鬼的存在。

en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
cn: 我的三明治里有肉，奶酪和番茄。

en: I want to take a look at this room.
cn: 我想看看这个房间。

en: The teacher easily loses his temper with the students.
cn: 老师很容易对学生发脾气。

en: Every person should be able to speak their mother tongue.
cn: 每个人都该会讲他的母语。

en: Despite different languages and cultures, everyone still became friends.
cn: 尽管语言和习俗不同，大家还是能够成为朋友。

en: Hey, sir, the function on the blackboard is not exponential, but trigonometric.
cn: 嗨，先生，黑板上的不是指数函数，而是三角函数。

en: For the whole day yesterday I was learning English words off by heart.
cn: 我昨天一天都在背英语单词。

en: He has some foreign books that cannot be found in Japan.
cn: 他有些在日本不能找到的外书。

en: He recorded a documentary and gave it to me.
cn: 他录了一个纪录片给我。

en: This is not a cat, it is a dog.
cn: 这不是猫，这是狗。

en: Due to the rainstorm, the river water surged over the river banks.
cn: 因为暴雨，河水暴涨漫过河岸。

en: The weather is too cold to swim in the sea.
cn: 这天气在海里游泳太冷了。

en: That's kind of far from Europe, don't you think?
cn: 那离欧洲有点远，你不觉得吗？

en: Many people rejected the invitation to the welcome party.
cn: 许多人拒绝了欢迎会的邀请。

en: If you are not busy, why don't you come fishing with me this weekend?
cn: 如果你不忙，这周末为何不来跟我钓鱼呢？

en: He spent a lot of money on helping the poor.
cn: 他花了一大笔钱来帮助穷人。

en: If you need a dictionary, I can lend you my old one.

cn: 宇宙的实际大小至今无人知道。

en: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.
cn: 他不愿意为同胞作证。

en: It seemed that she had already received the money.
cn: 看来她已经收到了钱。

en: I am either going to watch a movie, or chat with my friends.
cn: 我要幺去看电影，要幺和朋友聊天。

en: Do you have a lot of money on you?
cn: 你身上有很多钱吗？

en: The main type of tree in this part of the forest is the cypress.
cn: 这片森林的树主要是柏树。

en: When you have free time, please come and play.
cn: 有空的时候，请过来玩儿。

en: Every morning, while he is eating his breakfast, his dog looks at him.
cn: 每天早上当他吃早餐的时候，他的狗都看着他。

en: In Spain, they wear red boxers or knickers on Christmas.
cn: 在西班牙，圣诞节要穿红内裤红内衣。

en: Going to sleep and waking up early is good for the body.
cn: 早睡早起身体好。

en: Currently, having a hood is part of young people's fashion.
cn: 现代年轻人戴风帽是装一种派头。

en: Please get here with the ambulance quickly. Hurry up!
cn: 请你们快点来一辆救护车，快！

en: She bought a woollen pullover to give to him.
cn: 她买了件羊毛套衫给他。

en: She is wearing a pair of white, silk socks.
cn: 她穿着一双白色丝袜。

en: This is an automated payphone; you use it by inserting a coin.
cn: 这是自动投币电话，用一元硬币来打的。

en: It still isn't time to leave work, and everyone wants to escape.
cn: 下班时间还没到，大家就想溜走。

en: Tomorrow I am going to the bookshop to buy books.
cn: 明天我在一家书店买书。

en: I am staying in my uncle's house in Tokyo.
cn: 我待在东京的舅舅家。

en: Can you confirm that it is a correctable error?
cn: 你确认那是可纠正的错误吗？

en: The solar system is a small celestial system in the Milky Way.
cn: 太阳系是银河系中一个小的天体系统。

en: Because American dramas are very bloody, he doesn't like watching them.
cn: 因为他认为美剧镜头很血腥，所以他不喜欢看美剧。

en: Sir and Miss, what type of jewellery are you looking to buy?
cn: 先生小姐，你们买点什幺首饰？

en: Philosophy is not a written subject, but a way of life.
cn: 哲学不是书面上的学问，而是一种生活的方式。

en: For one thing, I've no money, and for another, I've no leisure.
cn: 我一没钱，二没时间。

en: So how many places have you been to in the afternoon?
cn: 那幺你下午到过几个地方？

en: Tom's task is to teach the kid horse riding.
cn: 汤姆的任务是教孩子骑马。

en: He has patched up the hole in the wall.
cn: 他把墙壁的洞补好了。

en: Are you going to sing an English song for us?
cn: 你将为我们唱英文歌吗？

en: He is in a relationship with a foreign student.
cn: 他正在和一个外国学生交往。

en: The city is at the northern end of Japan.
cn: 城市位于日本的最北端。

en: In other words, I don't like working with him.
cn: 换句话说, 我不喜欢和他一起工作。

en: We spent three hours to come to this conclusion.
cn: 做出这个结论花了我们三个小时。

en: At what age did you have your first girlfriend?
cn: 你几岁交了第一个女朋友？

en: He didn't pass the exam, but it doesn't bother him.
cn: 他考试没过，但他不是特别在意。

en: What matters in life is not where you are but where you are headed.
cn: 人生重要的不是所站的位置，而是所朝的方向。

en: I have two cats: one is white and the other is black.
cn: 我有两只猫: 一只是白色的，另一只是黑色的。

en: Could you tell me the way to the station?
cn: 能否告诉我去车站的路怎幺走？

en: Tom found the key that he thought he'd lost.
cn: 汤姆找到了他以为已经遗失的钥匙。

en: I need you to promise that you'll do what I ask you to do.
cn: 我需要你承诺你会照我说的话去做。

en: I don't think I'll be able to get there on time.
cn: 我估计我无法及时赶到。

en: Tom and Mary said they'd be willing to go.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽说他们愿意去。

en: It is my pleasure to wait for a beautiful lady.
cn: 等待一位漂亮的姑娘是我的荣幸。

en: Sorry, I forgot to bring the book I meant to return to you.
cn: 对不起，我忘了把要还给你的书带来。

en: Some things I will never be able to learn in my lifetime.
cn: 有些东西是我永远也学不会的。

en: There's a short-term task to be done for our team today.
cn: 今天咱们团队还有一个阶段性任务没有完成。

en: We have more important things to do right now.
cn: 我们现在有较重要的事情要做。

en: One of the children asked one day: "Where do babies come from?"
cn: 有一天，其中一个小孩问我，「宝宝是怎么来的？」

en: It's close to ten o'clock. It's about time we went to bed.
cn: 已将近十点了。该是睡觉的时候了。

en: Tom could write his name when he was three years old.
cn: 汤姆三岁的时候就能写自己的名字了。

en: Would you like me to get you something from the supermarket?
cn: 你要不要我从超市给你带些什么？

en: I know I left it somewhere down here in the basement.
cn: 我知道我把它放在地下室的某个地方了。

en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
cn: 比起出门，我更喜欢待在家。

en: I want to be able to hold my liquor better.
cn: 想酒量大一些。

en: Could you rearrange this list so it's in alphabetical order?
cn: 你能把这清单按字母顺序排列吗？

en: Take care of yourself, and have a good time!
cn: 你自己小心，玩得开心点！

en: As soon as he saw a policeman, he ran away.
cn: 他一看见警察就逃走了。

en: I don't know if she wants to go with me.
cn: 我不知道她想不想和我一起去。

en: I can't even read Italian, let alone speak or write it.
cn: 我意大利语读都读不了，更不要提说和写了。

en: On Saturday, you don't need to come in to the office.
cn: 周六你没必要来办公室。

en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
cn: 警察调查事故的原因。

en: I came to Tokyo three years ago and have been living here ever since.
cn: 三年前我来到东京并一直住在这儿。

en: I need a bag. Will you lend me one?
cn: 我需要个包。你能借我一个吗？

en: How late did you stay at the party last night?
cn: 昨晚的派对你待到多晚？

en: If you don't help him, he won't make it.
cn: 你要是不帮他，他做不到的。

en: There was no point in arguing with him at this point.
cn: 都到了这地步，跟他争论也没有用。

en: How many rooms does she have in her apartment?
cn: 她的公寓有几间房呢？

en: I'd like to help him, but I don't know how.
cn: 我想帮他，但不知如何。

en: Excuse me, do you know where the economics department library is?
cn: 不好意思，请问你知道经济学部图书馆在哪里吗？

en: Who can tell what will happen in the future?
cn: 谁能说将来会发生什幺呢。

en: How long does it take from here to your house on foot?
cn: 从这里步行到你家要多长时间？

en: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.
cn: 墙上挂着 Bob 的肖像画。

en: This day was just a waste of time and money.
cn: 这一天只是浪费时间，浪费金钱。

en: The patient, despite having taken the new medication, didn't feel any better.
cn: 病人吃了新药后没觉得好些了。

en: The store can supply us with anything we need.
cn: 这家商店可以提供所有我们需要的东西。

en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
cn: 他给我看了他最新剧的底稿。

en: I don't know why I'm a little tired today.
cn: 不知道为什幺今天有点累。

en: No wonder she doesn't want to see him again. Because they broke up.
cn: 难怪她表示不想再见到他了。因为他们分手了。

en: That old man, let's just say, is a living dictionary.
cn: 那个老人，这幺说吧，是一本活字典。

en: You look as though you have just lost your best friend.
cn: 你看上去就像是刚刚失去了自己最好的朋友似的。

en: No matter what, I'm leaving when the rain stops.
cn: 不论怎幺样，雨一停我就走。

en: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
cn: 早饭是一天中最重要的一顿饭。

en: My mother stood for awhile, then sighed as she returned to her room.
cn: 母亲又站了一会，然后叹着气回到了自己的房间。

en: With this little money, I can't even support my family.
cn: 靠这点钱，我连自己的家庭都养不活。

en: I've decided to go to Hokkaido with my friends next month.
cn: 我打算下个月和朋友一起去北海道。

en: He was bathed in the warmth of the kind light.
cn: 亲切的灯光让他的身上充满了温暖的感觉。

en: Don't forget to fill in your name on the form.
cn: 别忘了在名单上写上你自己的名字。

en: Seen at a distance, the rock looks like a human face.
cn: 从远处看，岩石像一张人的脸。

en: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.
cn: 你妹妹看上去那幺高贵，就像是个公主一样。

en: When my parents get old, I will support them.
cn: 等父母老了，我会赡养他们。

en: Why hasn't the landlord come to collect rent this month?
cn: 为什幺这个月房东还不来收房租？

en: Kurt didn't wake up yesterday because the alarm didn't ring.
cn: 昨天闹钟没响，Kurt也就没醒过来。

en: No one has forgotten to do the homework, right?
cn: 没有人忘记做功课吧？

en: I don't want to know what I'll be like in 30 years.
cn: 我真不想知道三十年后我会是什幺样。

en: Sato is the new secretary of the company president.
cn: 佐藤是社长的新秘书。

en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
cn: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

en: No worries, I will send you to the elevator.
cn: 没关系，送你到电梯口。

en: I ate lunch two and a half hours ago.
cn: 我在两个半小时以前就吃了午饭。

en: I whispered to her quietly "Don't be afraid, I'm here."
cn: 我轻轻地对她说：《不要怕，我在这儿》

en: He hurt his foot, he can't play football anymore.
cn: 他脚受伤了，不能再继续踢足球。

en: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.
cn: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。

en: Correct, one has a stomachache, the other has a headache.
cn: 对，一个人肚子疼，另一个人头疼。

en: She not only ridiculed him, but also drove him out.
cn: 她不止嘲笑了他，还把他赶了出去。

en: Math is like love: a simple idea, but it can get complicated.
cn: 数学就像爱情，一个简单的意思，但可以变得很复杂。

en: Had it not been for your courage, you would have been killed.
cn: 要是没您这样的勇气，就您肯定会被杀死的了。

en: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
cn: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。

en: We'll have lived here for two years next April.
cn: 到明年四月我们住在这儿就满两年了。

en: Why say sorry for something you haven't even done?
cn: 为什幺你要对你没做过的事表示抱歉？

en: You may not rest now, there are monsters nearby.
cn: 你现在不能休息，附近有怪物。

en: All you have to do is to write your name and address here.
cn: 你只要在这里写下你的姓名和地址就行了。

en: There are a few apples on the tree, aren't there?
cn: 树上有些苹果，不是吗？

en: We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.
cn: 我们估计能在两周内到那个地方。

en: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.
cn: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。

en: As far as I'm concerned, the situation is getting worse and worse each day.
cn: 对我来说, 情况一天比一天糟。

en: I bought a coat and a jacket at the department store.
cn: 我在百货公司买了大衣和夹克

en: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
cn: 汤姆穿着一件防弹衣，所以子弹没把他杀死。

en: You need to reverse your vest, it's back to front.
cn: 背心反了， 要翻一个面。

en: My father took out his wallet and gave me ten dollars.
cn: 我爸爸拿出他的钱包，并给了我10美元。

en: Parents are responsible for the safety of their children.
cn: 父母要对他们子女的安全负责。

en: Tom got mercury poisoning because he ate canned tuna every day.
cn: Tom汞中毒了，因为他每天都吃罐装金枪鱼。

en: Mommy, why don't I have an uncle with a beard?
cn: 妈妈，为什幺我没有长胡子的舅舅呢？

en: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
cn: 学生不该忽略自己的身份。

en: My father is very much involved in the stock market now.
cn: 我爸爸现在非常专注于股市。

en: She spent a good deal of money on her vacation.
cn: 她休假期间花了一大笔钱。

en: Thanks to a cold summer, beer has sold poorly.
cn: 多亏了冷夏，啤酒卖的不好。

en: You can go to the ballpark on this bus.
cn: 坐这个公车可以到球场。

en: He hasn't yet turned in the report this month.
cn: 他这个月还没有提交报告书。

en: The baby seemed to be sleeping a sound sleep.
cn: 那个婴儿似乎在熟睡中。

en: I got lost when I visited you for the first time.
cn: 我第一次来拜访你的时候迷路了。

en: Do you want to go to the station with me?
cn: 要不一起到车站去？

en: I went and bought some cream puffs. Do you want any?
cn: 我去买了泡芙，你要吃吗？

en: What are you doing in a freezing place like this?
cn: 在这幺冷的地方做什幺？

en: If you eat that much, you'll have a stomachache.
cn: 那幺吃的话，肚子会吃坏的噢。

en: It would be helpful if you could do that for me.
cn: 您那样做的话，可就帮到我了。

en: Did you plan to eat all of that yourself?
cn: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了吗？

en: Do you play any other instruments besides the piano?
cn: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什幺乐器吗？

en: Excuse me, do you know what time it is?
cn: 不好意思，请问您知道现在几点了吗？

en: There was a big gold star on the door.
cn: 在门上有一个大大的金色星星。

en: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.
cn: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

en: I was about to leave when you came in.
cn: 你来的时候我刚好要走。

en: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
cn: 在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。

en: Don't write extra information, such as the name of the author, within the sentence.
cn: 在句子中不要写入额外信息，比如作者姓名。

en: This is one of the best restaurants that I've ever eaten in.
cn: 这是我吃过的最好的餐馆之一。

en: There was nothing I could do at that time.
cn: 当时我什幺都不能做。

en: I don't mind being criticized when I am wrong.
cn: 要是我说错话被人议论，我是不管的。

en: I don't eat as much as I used to.
cn: 我比以前吃得少了。

en: Is it a bit lighter or a bit heavier?
cn: 轻一点还是重一点？

en: How long are you going to stay in Shanghai?
cn: 你在上海要住多少时间？

en: The memories we make with our family are everything.
cn: 我们和家人一起创造的记忆最为重要。

en: Omit this word in your sentence because it's not necessary.
cn: 把你句子中的这个词去掉，因为它是多余的。

en: Each age has deemed the new-born year the fittest time for festal cheer.
cn: 岁岁皆为新生之年，都值得好好庆祝。

en: Anything you say can be used against you in court.
cn: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

en: At that time, I was still taking French lessons.
cn: 那个时候，我还在上法语课。

en: He drew her to him and kissed her on the mouth.
cn: 他一把拉过她，然后吻了下去。

en: Tom has been a friend of mine for years.
cn: 汤姆是我多年的朋友。

en: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.
cn: 今晚我非常享受和你的聊天。

en: The company went public and became listed on the stock exchange in 1990.
cn: 该公司于1990年挂牌上市。

en: Tom meant it as a joke, but nobody laughed.
cn: 汤姆认为那是个玩笑，但是没人笑。

en: My office is on the fourth floor of that gray six-story building.
cn: 我的办公室在那幢灰色的六层楼的四楼。

en: Tom began to sing "Happy Birthday" and the entire restaurant joined in.
cn: 汤姆开始唱“祝你生日快乐”，然后整个餐厅的人都加入了进来。

en: I will never know the reason why he lied to me.
cn: 我永远无法知道他对我说谎的理由。

en: Many improvements have been made since this century began.
cn: 本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。

en: Could you please pull the weeds and water the flowers?
cn: 你可不可以帮忙除草浇花？

en: I wasn't very hungry, so I decided to eat later.
cn: 因为我不是很饿，所以我决定晚点吃。

en: I made no attempt to make friends with her.
cn: 我没打算和她做朋友。

en: Tom told Mary not to waste her time trying to convince John to help.
cn: 汤姆对玛丽说，不要浪费时间去说服约翰来帮忙。

en: My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.
cn: 着火的时候我妈妈恰好在那。

en: Everyone was more or less interested in the arts.
cn: 每个人都或多或少对艺术感兴趣。

en: Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
cn: 汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。

en: What time was it when you entered the building?
cn: 你进这幢楼的时候是几点？

en: Tom told me not to open the envelope until my birthday.
cn: 汤姆告诉我，到我生日那天我才能打开信封。

en: Are you sure that you want to go there?
cn: 你确定你要去那儿吗？

en: The proletarians lose nothing in this revolution but their chains.
cn: 无产者在这个革命中失去的只是锁链。

en: He once knew her, but they are no longer friends.
cn: 他过去认识她，但他们现在不再是朋友了。

en: Mr Johnson, president of the club, will soon come.
cn: 俱乐部会长Johnson先生很快就要来了。

en: The swimming pool is used in common by all the children in the neighborhood.
cn: 游泳池由住在附近的孩子们共同使用。

en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
cn: 穿上你的鞋，我们出去吃晚饭。

en: She will be a famous artist in the future.
cn: 她将来会是一个有名的艺术家。

en: Be patient and keep your chin up. Some things just take time.
cn: 耐心地坚持下去，有些事急不来。

en: The orange left a strange taste in my mouth.
cn: 橙子在我嘴里留下了一种奇怪的味道。

en: My father has already given up smoking and drinking.
cn: 我爸爸已经戒烟戒酒了。

en: What subject do you think he is interested in?
cn: 你觉得他会对什幺主题感兴趣？

en: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.
cn: 门铃响的时候，我正准备出门。

en: Is it necessary for me to explain the reason to him?
cn: 我有必要向他解释原因吗？

en: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
cn: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

en: We have a good view of the sea from the window.
cn: 透过窗，我们可以看到很美的海景。

en: I bear in mind that misfortunes never come singly.
cn: 我谨记祸不单行。

en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
cn: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

en: What is that big building in front of us?
cn: 我们面前的这幢高楼是什幺？

en: Tom says that he doesn't feel like going out.
cn: 汤姆说他不想出去。

en: Algeria is a close ally of both Russia and China.
cn: 阿尔及利亚是俄罗斯和中国的亲密盟友。

en: Only small populations of giraffes remain in this country.
cn: 这个国家只剩下少量的长颈鹿。

en: A giraffe's heart is nearly thirty times heavier than a human's.
cn: 长颈鹿的心脏几乎比人的心脏重三十倍。

en: Tom put the large picnic basket on the passenger seat next to him.
cn: 汤姆把那个大野餐篮子放在他旁边的乘客座位上。

en: That was the part that Tom and I were most confused about.
cn: 这是我和汤姆最困惑的部分。

en: Is it true that you authorized the driver to take the car home?
cn: 你批准司机把车开回家的事是真的吗？

en: Tom was so drunk that he didn't even recognize me.
cn: 汤姆醉得连我都认不出来了。

en: Tom confided in his friend that he was going to hang himself.
cn: 汤姆向他的朋友吐露他要上吊自杀。

en: Tom didn't like spinach when he was a child.
cn: 汤姆小时候不喜欢菠菜。

en: If Tom doesn't take the prescribed medicine, his state of health might deteriorate.
cn: 如果汤姆不服用处方药，他的健康状况可能会恶化。

en: I just wanted to prove to myself that I could do this.

cn: 我已经不记得第一次碰到汤姆的情形了。

en: Can't you keep your dog from coming into my garden?
cn: 您不能防止您的狗跑到我的院子里来吗？

en: The two birds built a nest without a building permit.
cn: 这两只鸟在没有建筑许可的情况下筑了巢。

en: My mother bought my little brother a yellow umbrella.
cn: 我母亲给我弟弟买了把黄色的雨伞。

en: Superstitions derive from the inability of men to acknowledge that coincidences are merely coincidences.
cn: 迷信之所以存在，是因为人无法接受巧合只是巧合而已。

en: He's making a lot of money in the stock market.
cn: 他炒股赚很多钱。

en: Some people think that eating grapefruit with every meal will help you lose weight.
cn: 有些人认为吃饭的时候吃葡萄柚会有助于减肥。

en: Very few people know what their blood group is.
cn: 知道自己血型的人没几个。

en: Tim's motorbike is far more expensive than mine is.
cn: 提姆的摩托车比我的贵多了。

en: What is permitted to Jove is not permitted to an ox.
cn: 朱庇特能做的，公牛做不得。

en: English is spoken in many parts of the world.
cn: 英语在世界许多地方通行。

en: I can't do that, because I don't want to go to jail.
cn: 我不会那样做的，因为我不想进监狱。

en: I'm not as healthy as I used to be.
cn: 我已经不像从前那样健康了。

en: You mustn't eat too much ice cream and spaghetti.
cn: 你不该吃太多冰激淋和太多意大利面。

en: I thought you said Tom didn't live in Boston anymore.
cn: 我以为你说过汤姆已经不住在波士顿了。

en: If she was still alive, she would be able to help me.
cn: 如果她还活着的话，现在能帮我。

en: Do you think Tom knows that Mary is married?
cn: 你觉得汤姆知道玛丽已经结了婚了吗？

en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
cn: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。

en: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
cn: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

en: This elevator is capable of carrying 10 persons at a time.
cn: 这部电梯一次能运送10个人。

en: He puts a lot of thought into how he thinks.
cn: 他对自己的思维方式进行着很多思考。

en: The living room in my new house is very large.
cn: 我新家的客厅很宽敞。

en: Bob, help me carry his suitcase to the living room.
cn: Bob，帮我把他的行李搬到客厅。

en: My little brother ran through the living room stark naked.
cn: 我弟弟全身光溜溜地跑过客厅。

en: No, until now she has never fallen in love.
cn: 不，直到现在她都没有恋爱过。

en: I'm going to die tomorrow, and so I won't be free the day after.
cn: 我明天要死了，所以后天没空。

en: I still don't know who Tom and Mary are.
cn: 我还是不知道汤姆和玛丽是谁。

en: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my wallet.
cn: 我到处都找了，就是找不到我的钱包。

en: I can't turn it on, because the switch is broken.
cn: 因为开关坏了，我没法儿把它打开。

en: He had a cold, but he went to work.
cn: 他得了感冒，但还是去上了班。

en: I believe it my duty to protect these children.
cn: 我认为我有义务保护这些孩子。

en: Whenever he comes up to Tokyo, he stays with us.
cn: 他每次来东京的时候都会在我们这儿过夜。

en: If you get lost in the street, ask a policeman.
cn: 如果你迷路了，请向警察询问。

en: Mr. Sato asked me many questions about the election.
cn: 佐藤先生问了我很多有关竞选的问题。

en: The time will come when your dream will come true.
cn: 您的梦想有朝一日会成真的。

en: The age of the universe is about 13.75 billion years.
cn: 宇宙的年龄大约为137.5亿年。

en: We had to nix tomorrow's meeting because of a scheduling problem.
cn: 因为日程安排的问题，我们必须取消明天的会议。

en: How long have you been waiting to make your dream come true?
cn: 你等待你的梦想成真已经等了多久了呀？

en: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.
cn: 我想要去探索世界。那是我的梦想。

en: What are your dreams for the future of humankind?
cn: 你对人类的未来有什么幻想吗？

en: Believe in your dreams, no matter how impossible they seem.
cn: 相信你的梦想，不论它们有多么地不切实际。

en: Don't let narrow-minded people convince you that your dreams are too big.
cn: 别让狭隘的人让你相信你的梦想过于宏大。

en: If this is a dream, I will kill the man who wakes me up.
cn: 要是这是场梦，我会把那个把我叫起来的人杀掉。

en: If you're not busy, could you please help me?
cn: 你要是不忙的话可以帮我吗？

en: Do you think I don't know what I'm doing?
cn: 你们觉得我不知道自己在干什么吗？

en: What are the chances that we'll have a white Christmas?
cn: 耶诞节下雪的概率有多大呢？

en: I considered changing my job, but in the end I decided not to.
cn: 我考虑过要不要换工作，但是我最终还是决定不要那样做。

en: Tom is at least one head taller than I am.
cn: 汤姆起码比我高一个头。

en: You need to decide what kind of person you want to be.
cn: 你必须得决定你想要成为一个什么样的人。

en: Tom was extremely shy when he was a kid.
cn: 汤姆小时候非常害羞。

en: All I want to know is where Tom is.
cn: 我只想知道汤姆在哪儿。

en: Tom and Mary often speak to each other in French.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽经常用法语跟对方讲话。

en: My mother told me I needed to eat more vegetables.
cn: 我妈说了我得多吃些蔬菜。

en: Which one of the books that I lent you did you like the best?
cn: 你最喜欢我借给你的哪一本书呢？

en: What part of the movie did you like best?
cn: 你最喜欢这部电影的哪一部分呢？

en: How long, O Catiline, will you abuse our patience?
cn: 喀提林，你还会滥用我们的耐心多久呀？

en: Sixty-nine percent of adult Americans are either overweight or obese.
cn: 69%的美国成人超重或肥胖。

en: I don't know what Tom does for a living.
cn: 我不知道汤姆做什么过活。

en: You must compensate him for the money he lost.
cn: 你需要赔偿他损失的钱。

en: All you have to do is apologize for being late.
cn: 你要做的只是为迟到而道歉。

en: Leave it to me, I'll take care of this problem.
cn: 交给我吧，我会把这个问题解决掉的。

en: You should always save money for a rainy day.
cn: 你应该经常为了雨天攒钱。

en: Do we have time for another cup of coffee?
cn: 我们有时间再喝一杯咖啡吗？

en: What should I do if a customer tries to flirt with me?
cn: 要是有顾客尝试和我调情我该怎么办呀？

en: There is not much possibility of his coming on time.
cn: 他十有八九不会准时来。

en: Tom didn't start to study French until he was thirty.
cn: 汤姆三十岁的时候才开始学法语。

en: Tom, if you're not going, I'm not going either.
cn: 汤姆，要是你不去，我也不去。

en: How far is it from here to the station?
cn: 这儿离车站有多远呀？

en: Were your eyelids stuck together when you woke up this morning?
cn: 您今天早上醒来的时候您的眼皮有没有粘在一起？

en: Mrs. White broke into tears when I told her the news.
cn: 当我告知她那件消息时，怀特小姐哭了出来。

en: Parks are to the city what lungs are to the animal.
cn: 公园和城市的关系，就好比肺和动物的关系一样。

en: All animals are equal, but some animals are more equal than others.
cn: 所有的动物都是平等的，但是有的动物比别的动物更平等。

en: In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
cn: 有些动物会在秋天为冬季储藏食物。

en: I go to the library at least once a week.
cn: 我每周至少去图书馆一次。

en: The only thing that will redeem mankind is co-operation.
cn: 合作是人类唯一的救赎。

en: The dog fell asleep on top of the blanket.
cn: 狗在毯子上睡着了。

en: She walked with her head down like an old woman.
cn: 她当时像老太太一样低着头走路。

en: I am not rich, nor do I wish to be.
cn: 我既不富有，也不想变得富有。

en: Did you know there was a secret passage hidden behind the bookcase?
cn: 你知道书架背后藏着一条秘密通道吗？

en: He's only a couple of years older than me.
cn: 他只比我大个把岁。

en: She says that she's never seen hedgehogs with ears.
cn: 她说她从未见过有耳朵的刺猬。

en: Tom quietly opened the door and tiptoed into the room.
cn: 汤姆悄悄地打开了门，蹑手蹑脚地走进了房间。

en: Tom ran and ran, until at last he saw the telephone booth.
cn: 汤姆跑啊跑, 直到他终于看到了电话亭。

en: It takes us a long time to master a foreign language.
cn: 精通一门外语需要很长时间。

en: My sister likes classical music no less than I do.
cn: 我姊姊对古典音乐的热爱不亚于我。

en: You should be able to read this book easily.
cn: 你读这本书应该很容易。

en: Because there was traffic, I was late to the meeting.
cn: 因为堵车， 我开会迟到了。

en: The explanation Tom gave us was easy to understand.
cn: 汤姆给我们的解释很好懂。

en: Most people think computers will never be able to think.
cn: 大多数人认为计算机永远不会有思考的能力。

en: I am grateful to you for inviting me to the party.
cn: 谢谢你邀我参加派对。

en: Tom asked Mary if she knew John's new telephone number.
cn: 汤姆问玛丽是否知道琼的新电话号码。

en: You should pay more attention to what you say.
cn: 你应该更注意你说的话。

en: The important thing is not to win, but that the other loses.
cn: 自己赢不重要，重要的是对手要输。

en: First they laugh at you, then they fight you, and then you win.
cn: 首先他们嘲笑你，其次他们和你争执，然后你赢了。

en: I used to run a small bookstore in a shopping centre.
cn: 我以前经营一家在商场里的小书店。

en: Neither Tom nor Mary knows how to play the clarinet.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽都不会吹单簧管。

en: Kansas is smack dab in the middle of the US.
cn: 堪萨斯州刚好位于美国的中央。

en: The police now believe that Tom had something to do with Mary's disappearance.
cn: 警方现在认为汤姆和玛丽的失踪有干系。

en: A detective arrived upon the scene of the crime.
cn: 一名警探到达了犯罪现场。

en: As for the papers, I have custody of them.
cn: 至于该文件，我在保管。

en: Speakers of various dialects are in the majority in this region.
cn: 这一带的方言使用者数量居多。

en: Standard Chinese, commonly referred to as Mandarin, is based on Pekinese.
cn: 中文的标准语，也就是人们常说的普通话，以北京口音为基础。

en: It's April already; why is it still so cold?
cn: 都四月了天气怎幺还是这幺冷？

en: Different variants of Shanghainese differ greatly with each other.
cn: 吴语的方言差异很大。

en: The weather is excellent today. Go for a walk.
cn: 今天天气不错，出去走走吧。

en: Losing your temper for no reason would invite the resentment of others.
cn: 无理由乱发脾气会让别人反感。

en: He was again looking forward to the start of winter.
cn: 他又在期待着冬天到来了。

en: This idea has been in his mind for a long time now.
cn: 这个想法已经在他脑中存在了好久。

en: Do you think this is a language or a dialect?
cn: 你认为这是语言还是方言？

en: How long did it take Tom to read this book?
cn: 这本书汤姆看了多久？

en: Why's Tom allowed to do that, but I'm not?
cn: 凭什么汤姆可以那样做，而我就不行？

en: It's a ghost, and only I can speak to him.
cn: 那是个幽灵，只有我能和它交谈。

en: The professor was unable to comprehend what I meant.
cn: 教授不明白我说了甚么。

en: No matter what he may do, he will be praised.
cn: 他无论做什么都会受到赞赏。

en: This piece of music is way too difficult for me to play.
cn: 这首曲子对我来说太难演奏了。

en: I always drink a cup of coffee in the morning.
cn: 在早晨，我总是喝一杯咖啡。

en: He divided one million dollars among his five sons.
cn: 他把一百万美元分给他五个儿子。

en: Tom needs to stay in the hospital for a few more days.
cn: 汤姆还得在医院里多待几天。

en: I waited for the bus in the snow as long as two hours.
cn: 我站在雪里等了两个小时的公交车。

en: The woman sitting over there is his present wife.
cn: 坐在那边的女性是他现在的妻子。

en: It goes without saying that health is above wealth.
cn: 健康胜过财富，这件事谁都知道。

en: It was foolish of him to do such a thing.
cn: 他那样做很不明智。

en: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
cn: 离我们太阳系最近的恒星是比邻星。

en: Are you sure you don't want me to talk to Tom about that?
cn: 您确信您不想让我和汤姆谈谈这事儿吗？

en: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.
cn: 人生就像骑单车一样，要保持平衡就得不停地前进。

en: Tom and Mary told John that they thought Alice wasn't done doing that.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽娅对约翰说，他们觉得埃尔克还没完成呢。

en: I can't for the life of me remember her address.
cn: 她的地址死活想不起来。

en: Tom and I haven't seen each other since we were kids.
cn: 我和汤姆长大以后就再也没见到对方。

en: I can't get that song out of my head.
cn: 那首歌在我脑中挥之不去。

en: How much money do you spend in a month?
cn: 你每个月花多少钱呀？

en: Just as he was going out, there was a great earthquake.
cn: 就在他要出门的时候，发生了强震。

en: Mademoiselle, would you like a platinum necklace to accompany your ring?
cn: 小姐已经有一个戒指，要不要配一条铂金项链？

en: I make it a rule to keep early hours.
cn: 我一向都早睡早起。

en: Last year was the first time I went to Geneva.
cn: 去年我第一次去了日内瓦。

en: I don't know what you are trying to say, but I like it.
cn: 我不知道你想讲的是什么，但是我喜欢。

en: Please let me see your passport, also did you complete the immigration form?
cn: 请你把护照出示给我看看，还有入境表格填好了吗？

en: These guys are all part of the 'nomophobic' group.
cn: 这些家伙都是手机控。

en: Sorry, I'm not used to seeing a priest with a sense of humor.
cn: 不好意思，有幽默感的牧师我是真的不太习惯。

en: When I was young, I also liked this one.
cn: 当我年轻的时候，我也喜欢这个。

en: What would you say if there weren't any more fish?
cn: 如果没鱼了您会说什幺？

en: Tom tried to kiss me, but I didn't let him.
cn: 汤姆要亲我，但我不让他亲。

en: I spoke slowly so that they might understand me.
cn: 我为了让她们听懂所以讲得很慢。

en: Better get preparing! Tomorrow will be the last day.
cn: 快点准备！明天是最后一天了。

en: Only going half way is more painful than continuing on to your goal.
cn: 站在半路，比走到目标更辛苦。

en: I've come across all kinds of trials and tribulations.
cn: 我遇见过各种各样的困难。

en: If for some reason they come early, please tell them to wait.
cn: 如果他们由于什幺原因早到的话，请转达他们再等一会儿。

en: Many parents think it's important for their children to eat before 8:00 p.m.
cn: 许多父母认为让自己的子女在下午八点前吃完饭是很重要的。

en: According to the Bible, God made the world in six days.
cn: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

en: There is no treasure more precious than a child.
cn: 孩子是宝中之宝。

en: It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
cn: 不言自明，金钱买不到幸福。

en: He lives alone in a little cottage in the swamp.
cn: 他独自一人住在沼泽地里的一栋小屋里。

en: He gave me a promise to come here at five.
cn: 他答应了我五点钟过来。

en: I have known her since she was a little girl.
cn: 我从她还是个小女孩儿的时候就认识她。

en: What they told you is the opposite of what they told me yesterday.
cn: 她们跟你说的可和她们昨天跟我说的完全相反。

en: Are you sure you can't buy one of those in Boston?
cn: 你确信你在波士顿买不到那样的东西吗？

en: There's a body in the trunk of the car.
cn: 后备箱内有具尸体。

en: In my opinion, German is the best language in the world.
cn: 我个人认为德语是世界上最好的语言。

en: I just felt like hearing the sound of your voice.
cn: 我只是想要听听你的嗓音。

en: After retirement, Teresa devoted herself to caring for orphans.
cn: 退休后，德蕾莎投身照顾孤儿的工作。

en: The most important feature of all games is that they are governed by rules.
cn: 在所有的游戏里有最重要的特点: 它们都拥有法则。

en: Which one do you prefer, this one or that one?
cn: 你喜欢哪一块？这块还是那块？

en: Have you noticed any changes in your hair or nails?
cn: 您有注意到您的头髪或者指甲有什么变化吗？

en: To learn a foreign language requires a lot of time.
cn: 学外语很费时间。

en: She has a view that is different from mine.
cn: 她持有与我不同的观点。

en: He wants to be a scientist in the future.
cn: 他想成为科学家。

en: If Bob had taken my advice, everything would be all right now.
cn: 如果Bob 听从了我的忠告，一切都还应该好好的。

en: The picnic was called off because of the rain.
cn: 由于下雨，野餐泡汤了。

en: I hope to be able to finish my book tonight.
cn: 我希望今天晚上我能完成我的书。

en: The difference between Facebook and Twitter is that Twitter is a microblogging service.
cn: Facebook 和 Twitter 的不同在于，Twitter 是微博服务。

en: Professor Kai has been studying insects for forty years.
cn: 凯教授已研究昆虫四十年。

en: Tokyo is the most expensive town in the world.
cn: 东京是世界上最贵的城市。

en: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.
cn: 我和妈妈，弟弟还有爷爷奶奶住在一起。

en: How can I rid myself of my inferiority complex?
cn: 我有什么办法可以脱离我的自卑情结吗？

en: Are you sure you don't want something to eat?
cn: 你确信你什么都不想吃吗？

en: Is this the reason you didn't want to come with me?
cn: 这是你不愿意一起来的原因吗？

en: I have no friend with whom to talk about it.
cn: 我没有任何可以谈这件事的朋友。

en: When was the last time you gave flowers to your wife?
cn: 你最后一次给你妻子送花是什么时候？

en: A girl gave me an orange in exchange for a piece of cake.
cn: 有个女生用一个橙子跟我换了一块蛋糕。

en: He doesn't have the guts to say no to my plan.
cn: 他没那个胆拒绝我的提议。

en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
cn: 屋子物美价廉。

en: Don't bother Mary; she's in a rotten mood at the moment.
cn: 别打扰玛丽，她现在脾气不好。

en: Tom and Mary have lived together for a long time.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽住在一起很久了。

en: I want to live in a quiet city where the air is clean.
cn: 我想在一个宁静、没有空气污染的城镇里生活。

en: Psycho-horror films dealing with the mysteries of human psychology are popular these days.
cn: 这几年有关心理之谜的心理恐怖片很热门。

en: I got a piece of lead for my mechanical pencil from her.
cn: 我从她那里拿了一根自动铅笔芯。

en: Cook the peeled and chopped potatoes for 20 minutes in boiling water.
cn: 把去皮切成小块的土豆放在滚水里煮20分钟。

en: Tom doesn't seem to be as talented as Mary seems to be.
cn: 汤姆看起来没有玛丽那幺才华横溢。

en: It's a rainy day, so we can't play outside.
cn: 今天下雨，我们不能出去玩。

en: My father is always poking his nose into my private life.
cn: 我的父亲总是干涉我的私生活。

en: Without a dictionary, it would probably be hard to study English.
cn: 如果没有字典，学英文应该是很难的事吧。

en: I will sell it as soon as I find a buyer.
cn: 我一找到买家就会把它卖掉。

en: Mary looks unfriendly, but she is really very kind at heart.
cn: 玛丽虽然看起来好像不是很友好，其实她有颗很善良的心。

en: Such a teacher may as well retire from his work.
cn: 像那样的老师还是别干了比较好。

en: Do you think I think of myself as an idiot?
cn: 你认为我把自己当傻瓜？

en: He runs every day so he is very healthy.

cn: 天开始变黑了。你可以帮忙去开个灯吗？

cn: 这里有间供儿童玩耍的房间。你可以把你的小孩带到那里。

cn: 家人或朋友会来接你吗？

en: I have been taking this medication for many years.
cn: 这种药我吃了好多年了。

en: While camping, Tom gave Mary dysentery by not thoroughly cleaning the pots and pans.
cn: 露营时，汤姆没有彻底清洗锅碗瓢盆，导致玛莉得了痢疾。

en: Because Tom didn't thoroughly clean the pots, Mary got dysentery.
cn: 汤姆没有彻底清洗锅碗瓢盆，导致玛莉得了痢疾。

en: My name is Park Hae-soo. "Hae" as in "sea," and "Soo" as in "excellent."
cn: 我叫朴海秀。大海的「海」，优秀的「秀」。

en: The governor's recent scandal was a blight on her otherwise pristine track record.
cn: 州长最近的丑闻玷污了她原本完美无瑕的政绩。

en: Among the students there's a rumor that this teacher fails everyone on their exams.
cn: 学生中流传着一个传言，说这位老师会让所有学生考试不及格。

en: You didn't actually want to go to Australia, did you?
cn: 你其实不想去澳大利亚吧？

en: Tom and Mary practiced their speeches in front of the mirror.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽对着镜子练习演讲。

en: A mirror wall in the room creates an illusion of spaciousness.
cn: 房间里的镜面墙营造出宽敞的错觉。

en: Tom was in the bathtub when he felt the earthquake.
cn: 汤姆当时正在浴缸里，突然感觉到了地震。

en: About how long does it take to fill the bathtub?
cn: 注满浴缸大约需要多久时间？

en: There is a toilet on the fourth floor, too.
cn: 四楼也有厕所。

en: I've left my toilet bag in the hotel room.
cn: 我的洗漱包落在饭店房间里了。

en: It was cold, and in addition, it was windy.
cn: 天气很冷，而且风很大。

en: Acai is a berry that comes from the state of Pará, Brazil.
cn: 阿萨伊是一种产自巴西帕拉州的浆果。

en: A product that costs 10 reals in Brazil costs about 25 pesos in Argentina.
cn: 在巴西售价 10 雷亚尔的商品，在阿根廷大约要卖 25 比索。

en: How long do you intend to stay here in Brazil?
cn: 你打算在巴西待多久？

en: Do you go to school by bus on rainy days?
cn: 下雨天你坐公车上学吗？

en: It seems that the rainy season is over at last.
cn: 雨季似乎终于结束了。

en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
cn: 下雨天容易发生交通事故。

en: Sunshine is a warm burst of joy after a gloomy, rainy week.
cn: 阴雨连绵的一周后，阳光让人感到一阵温暖喜悦。

en: It was during the rainy season three years ago that Tom first met Mary.
cn: 三年前的雨季，汤姆第一次遇见了玛丽。

en: Unable to find a spatula, Tom used tongs to flip the pancakes.
cn: 汤姆找不到锅铲了，只好用夹子为煎饼翻面。

en: He uses a spatula to scrape off advertisements that were stuck on the ground.
cn: 他用铲子刮掉黏在地上的广告单。

en: The spatulas, ramekins, plates, and mugs are all from the collection.
cn: 这些锅铲、烤盅、盘子和马克杯都来自这套集合。

en: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
cn: 我每天至少用一次煎锅。

en: You scorned both the Nymphs, who beheld your deeds, and me the mighty Pan.
cn: 你蔑视了目睹你罪行的仙女们，也蔑视了我を这位强大的潘神。

en: He fell out of the frying pan into the fire.
cn: 他真是刚出狼窝又入虎穴。

en: When sautéing vegetables, it is important to use a non-stick pan.
cn: 炒蔬菜时，重要的是使用不沾锅。

en: Don't leave dirty pots and pans on the stove; wash them.
cn: 不要把脏锅碗瓢盆放在炉子上，去洗。

en: Tom is probably going to do that on Monday.
cn: 汤姆很可能会在星期一做这件事。

en: Mary promised she'd go to Boston with Tom next Monday.
cn: 玛丽答应汤姆下周一会去波士顿。

en: She gave birth on Monday to her first child.
cn: 她于周一生下了她的第一个孩子。

en: Tom and Mary said they thought they'd be able to do that on Monday.
cn: 汤姆和玛莉说他们觉得星期一就能做到。

en: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday are the days of the week.
cn: 一周有星期一、二、三、四、五、六、日。

en: I come home at 2:30 on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
cn: 我星期二和星期四下午 2:30 回家。

en: It was so foggy I couldn't tell who it was.
cn: 雾太大了，我看不清楚是谁。

en: China has the means to destroy your aircraft carriers.
cn: 中国有能力摧毁你们的航空母舰。

en: China is incorporating Algeria into its Belt and Road strategy.
cn: 中国正将阿尔及利亚纳入「一带一路」战略。

en: Algeria should become China's main investment hot spot in the Mediterranean region.
cn: 阿尔及利亚应该成为中国在地中海地区的主要投资热点。

en: I watched as my grandmother pulled a golden butter pie from the oven.
cn: 我看着奶奶从烤箱里拿出一个金黄色的奶油派。

en: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
cn: 蛋糕应该差不多可以出炉了。

en: I forgot to tell Tom to take the cookies out of the oven.
cn: 我忘了告诉汤姆把饼干从烤箱拿出来。

en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
cn: 厨房有烤箱，可以用来烤面包。

en: That year's buzzword was digital: digital clocks, digital microwave ovens, even digital pens.
cn: 那一年的流行语是「数位」：数位钟、数位微波炉，甚至还有数位笔。

en: It was raining when we left; it was sunny when we arrived.
cn: 我们离开时下着雨；我们到达时晴空万里。

en: I also hope for sunny weather at the weekend.
cn: 我也希望周末是晴天。

en: It was raining this morning, but now it's sunny.
cn: 今天早上一直在下雨，但现在晴了。

en: In this country, the majority of the population espouses Sunni Islam.
cn: 在这个国家，大多数人口信奉逊尼派伊斯兰教。

en: He's the new CEO from the parent company in France.
cn: 他是来自法国母公司的新任执行长。

en: I'm meeting a buddy tomorrow who's arriving from France.
cn: 我明天要和一位从法国来的朋友见面。

en: I usually don't get up until noon on Sundays.
cn: 我通常星期天要到中午才起床。

en: Edmundo hid in the back corner of the bathroom.
cn: 艾德蒙多躲在浴室的角落。

en: People were carrying signs saying, "No men in women's bathrooms."
cn: 人们举着牌子，上面写着：「男士不得进入女士洗手间。」

en: Martino excused himself from the table to go to the bathroom.
cn: 马蒂诺以去洗手间为借口，离开了餐桌。

en: I sometimes hear my father singing in the bathroom.
cn: 我有时会听到父亲在浴室里唱歌。

en: The "anti-woke" propaganda being imported into your country's media comes straight from actual fascists.
cn: 你们国家媒体中输入的「反觉醒」宣传，是直接来自真正的法西斯的。

en: I have to be absent from school next week.
cn: 我下周必须请假。

en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
cn: 上周的暴风雨损坏了我们社区的许多树木。

en: I think you should let Tom know you can't do that next week.
cn: 我认为你应该告诉汤姆你下周做不了。

en: Today the weather is magnificent and the children play in the fields.
cn: 今天天气晴朗，孩子们在田野里玩耍。

en: The weather forecast says that it's going to snow this evening.
cn: 天气预报说今晚会下雪。

en: I don't think that Tom is alone in the kitchen.
cn: 我不认为汤姆是一个人在厨房。

en: Can you change the kitchen light bulb before you leave?
cn: 您离开前能帮忙换一下厨房的灯泡吗？

en: I can hear Tom in the kitchen washing dishes.
cn: 我听到汤姆在厨房洗碗的声音。

en: David decided to sneak into the kitchen and find something delicious to eat.
cn: 大卫决定偷偷溜进厨房，找点好吃的吃。

en: The blizzard has already had a severe impact on the economy.
cn: 这场暴风雪已经对经济造成了很严重的影响。

en: Jonas left under the pretext of going to the bathroom.
cn: 乔纳斯以去洗手间为借口离开了。

en: My mother was too tired, so she went to bed early.
cn: 我的母亲太累了，她早早地去睡了。

en: Mom took the blanket along with the bedsheet to wash.
cn: 妈妈把被单连同床单一起拿去洗了。

en: Our mountains aren't really very high. Yours are much bigger.
cn: 我们的山不怎么高，你们的高多了。

en: The website you told me about was very interesting and also useful.
cn: 你跟我讲的那个网站很有意思，也很有用。

en: The newly bought quilt is very warm when covered.
cn: 新买的被子盖起来非常暖和。

en: At dusk, the sky was dyed with purple light.
cn: 黄昏时分，天空染上了紫色的光。

en: Last night, my father took me to the cinema.
cn: 昨晚我父亲带我去电影院了。

en: That little naughty one is running around the living room again!
cn: 这个小皮蛋，又在客厅乱跑！

en: She held a large bouquet of artificial flowers in her hands.
cn: 她手里拿着一大束假花。

en: Tom bought, for his rendezvous, a flower and some gifts.
cn: 汤姆为约会买了一束花和一些礼物。

en: I want some beautiful flowers put on the table.
cn: 我想在桌子上摆放一些漂亮的花。

en: Why are you in such a bad mood this morning?
cn: 你今天早上为什么心情这么差？

en: I haven't been in the mood lately to watch any films.
cn: 我最近一直没心情看电影。

en: I hope Tom is in a good mood tomorrow.
cn: 我希望汤姆明天心情愉快。

en: I asked Tom if I could borrow his car.
cn: 我问汤姆能不能借他的车。

en: Flavio saw a road with a car parked on it.
cn: 弗拉维奥看到一条路，路上停着一辆车。

en: Tom slammed on the brakes and the car began to skid.
cn: 汤姆猛踩煞车，汽车开始打滑。

en: In my family there are two birthdays in September.
cn: 我家九月有两人过生日。

en: I will give you a new bicycle for your birthday.
cn: 生日的时候我会送你一辆新脚踏车。

en: Tom doesn't know what Mary wants him to buy her for her birthday.
cn: 汤姆不知道玛莉想要他买什么生日礼物给她。

en: I'm going to buy a book for Tom for his birthday.
cn: 我打算买本书给汤姆当生日礼物。

en: There are a lot of flowers in this garden.
cn: 这个花园里有很多花。

en: All the top teams in England are in the Premier League.
cn: 英格兰所有顶级球队都在英超联赛。

en: Did you ask Tom what that had to do with anything?
cn: 你问过汤姆那件事与这件事有任何关系吗？

en: I don't think Tom would like that very much.
cn: 我觉得汤姆不会很喜欢那样。

en: You cannot wake a person who is pretending to be asleep.
cn: 你无法叫醒一个装睡的人。

en: Putin's Russia isn't afraid of the United States and NATO.
cn: 普丁领导下的俄罗斯并不惧怕美国和北约。

en: I don't agree with hospitals being run like businesses.
cn: 我不赞成将医院像企业一样经营。

en: Tom and Mary said they were really sure they needed to do that.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽说他们非常确定自己需要这样做。

en: Tom wanted to check the applicant's character reference before extending an offer.
cn: 汤姆想在发出录取通知前先确认申请人的品行证明。

en: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
cn: 这起空难是迄今为止加拿大境内最严重的空难。

en: The belt became a symbol of fear for me.
cn: 这条腰带对我来说成为了恐惧的象征。

en: I'm not a cherry! I've gotten laid lots of times!
cn: 我不是处男！我做过很多次爱了！

en: On a rainy day, we keep guests; Heaven keeps you, but I won't.
cn: 下雨天留客天留我不留。

en: Rainy day, a day for keeping guests. Will you keep me or not?
cn: 下雨天，留客天，留我不留？

en: Rainy day, a day for keeping guests. Do you keep me? No.
cn: 下雨天，留客天，留我？不留。

en: It’s raining. Heaven keeps the guests; Heaven may keep them, but I won’t!
cn: 下雨，天留客；天留我不留。

en: The quick brown fox jumps over a lazy dog.
cn: 身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的狗。

en: The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy brown dog.
cn: 身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的棕狗。

en: The quick brown fox didn't jump over the lazy dog.
cn: 身手矫健的棕狐狸没有跃过懒洋洋的狗。

en: Knowing That the Mountain has tigers, so don't go to Knowing That the Mountain.
cn: 明知山有虎，别去明知山。

en: I don't remember when I gave Tom that book.
cn: 我不记得是什么时候把那本书送给汤姆的了。

en: I will ensure that your salary increases after one year.
cn: 我保证你一年后加薪。

en: Tom wasn't with me at the time Mary was murdered.
cn: 当玛丽被谋杀时，汤姆不在我身边。

en: Athletic boys are very popular with American female students.
cn: 运动型男生很受美国女学生欢迎。

en: While eating dessert, our desire to travel to that country grew stronger.
cn: 我们吃甜点的时候，去那个国家旅游的愿望更强烈了。

en: You ordered so many desserts and still felt unsatisfied. You're such a glutton.
cn: 点了这么多甜点还是不满足，真是个贪吃鬼呢。

en: Tom said the scenery was more beautiful than he thought it would be.
cn: 汤姆说，风景比他想像的还要美。

en: When it got dark, the scenery became strange and spooky.
cn: 天黑之后，景色变得诡异阴森。

en: He must have been crazy to climb the mountain in winter.
cn: 他一定是疯了才会在冬天爬山。

en: Tom climbed all the way to the top of the mountain.
cn: 汤姆一路爬到了山顶。

en: The rope broke when we were climbing the mountain.
cn: 我们爬山的时候绳子断了。

en: This famous mountain climber is a critic of mass tourism.
cn: 这位著名的登山家批评大众旅游。

en: That sign over there says that swimming isn't allowed in this lake.
cn: 那边那个牌子写着这片湖里禁止游泳。

en: There are a lot of fish in that lake.
cn: 那片湖里有很多鱼。

en: Gabriel watched a family of swans gliding gracefully on the lake.
cn: 加布里埃尔看着一群天鹅在湖面上优雅地游着。

en: I'd like to go to the seaside with you.
cn: 我想和你一起去海边。

en: If the weather's nice, I'll go to the seaside tomorrow.
cn: 如果天气好的话，我明天就去海边。

en: I'm going to the seaside tomorrow if the weather's nice.
cn: 如果明天天气好的话，我就去海边。

en: It's time for the Tuaregs to transfer their herds to the valley.
cn: 图阿雷格人该把他们的牲畜转移到山谷去了。

en: I bought a sprig of lily of the valley.
cn: 我买了一小枝铃兰。

en: We went down to the valley where the village is.
cn: 我们下到山谷里，那里有个村庄。

en: Ziri heard the sound of a motorcycle echoing in the valley.
cn: 齐里听到山谷里传来摩托车的轰鸣声。

en: Without music, the world is a valley of tears.
cn: 没有音乐，世界将变成一片泪谷。

en: Tom said that school did little to prepare him for life.
cn: 汤姆说学校并没有让他为人生做好准备。

en: Ziri and Rima didn’t even call the school to inform them.
cn: 齐里和里玛甚至没有打电话通知学校。

en: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
cn: 汤姆将在后年高中毕业。

en: The teacher warned me not to be late for school.
cn: 老师警告我不要上学迟到。

en: Tom didn't know that I was a French teacher.
cn: 汤姆并不知道我是法文老师。

en: I did that once when I was a student.
cn: 我学生时代也做过一次。

en: The teacher started hitting Layla's head against the blackboard.
cn: 老师开始拿莱拉的头猛击黑板。

en: Take this piece of chalk and write on the blackboard.
cn: 拿起这支粉笔，在黑板上写字。

en: Has anyone here in the classroom heard about Norman Finkelstein?
cn: 在座各位有人听过诺曼芬克尔斯坦吗？

en: There were only a few pupils left in the classroom.
cn: 教室里只剩下几个学生了。

en: The teacher tells us to clean our classroom every day.
cn: 老师要求我们每天都打扫教室。

en: The strawberry tree is a commonly used landscape plant in this area.
cn: 草莓树是该地区常见的景观植物。

en: The Spanish make a type of brandy with the fruits of the strawberry tree.
cn: 西班牙人用草莓树的果实酿造一种白兰地。

en: If trees could talk, what would they tell us?
cn: 如果树木会说话，他们会告诉我们什么？

en: He looked at the pine tree behind the house.
cn: 他望向房子后面的那棵松树。

en: A vase of frost-bleached ferns and ruby-red maple leaves adorned the table.
cn: 桌上摆放着一瓶被霜冻漂白的蕨类植物和红宝石色的枫叶。

en: From a small acorn grows a tall oak tree.
cn: 一粒小小的橡实可以长成一棵高大的橡树。

en: Ziri saw a large claw mark on the oak tree.
cn: 齐里看到橡树上有一个很大的爪痕。

en: This is Professor Oak, the director of this experiment.
cn: 这位是奥克教授，他是这项实验的负责人。

en: When it's windy, the leaves of the old oak rustle and its branches creak.
cn: 刮风的时候，老橡树的叶子会沙沙作响，树枝会发出嘎吱声。

en: They made huge, grotesque, yet beautiful poles of red cedar.
cn: 他们用红雪松制作了巨大、怪诞却又美丽的木杆。

en: There used to be a large cedar tree there.
cn: 那里以前有一棵高大的雪松树。

en: Did you stay till the end of the concert?
cn: 你一直待到演唱会结束吗？

en: Let me get you a ticket to the concert.
cn: 我来帮你弄张演唱会门票吧。

en: I gave my daughter an entry ticket to the concert for her birthday.
cn: 我送了我女儿一张音乐会门票作为生日礼物。

en: Lachin hosted concert marking May 28 – Independence Day.
cn: 拉钦举办了一场音乐会，庆祝 5 月 28 日的独立纪念日。

en: I was sick, so I couldn't go to the concert.
cn: 我生病了，所以没能去看演唱会。

en: Tom said that you're a better singer than Mary.
cn: 汤姆说你比玛莉唱得好。

en: The classified ad wanted female singers to form an a cappella group.
cn: 这则分类广告招募女歌手组成无伴奏合唱团。

en: Mary discovered that Tom was secretly a talented singer.
cn: 玛莉发现汤姆其实是一位很有才华的歌手。

en: I know Tom is a good singer, but I think Mary is better.
cn: 我知道汤姆唱歌很好听，但我认为玛丽唱得更好。

en: Japan fans may like the article "Ergativity and Bare Nominals in Early Old Japanese."
cn: 日本文化爱好者可能会喜欢《早期古日文中的作格与裸名词》这篇文章。

en: Benedito gave out high fives to fans in the queue.
cn: 贝内迪托与排队的粉丝们击掌。

en: I got a disease from listening to that band.
cn: 光是听那个乐团的歌就会染病。

en: The band will play their latest song for you now. Take it away, guys!
cn: 乐团现在将为大家演奏他们的最新歌曲。开始吧，伙计们！

en: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
cn: 体育场内已搭建起舞台。

en: Sami reenacted for us what he did on stage.
cn: 萨米为我们重现了他在舞台上的表演。

en: Putin will be a pariah on the international stage.
cn: 普丁将成为国际舞台上的弃儿。

en: The winner of this quarter-final match will advance to the semi-final stage.
cn: 这场四分之一决赛的胜者将晋级半决赛。

en: Rodrigo’s car crashed in the fourth and last stage of the race.
cn: 罗德里戈的赛车在比赛的第四阶段 (也是最后一个阶段) 发生撞车事故。

en: Mother gives my sister two thousand yen every month.
cn: 母亲每个月给妹妹两千日元。

en: Have you ever made more than $30,000 in one month?
cn: 你曾经一个月赚过 3 万美元以上吗？

en: Ziri only lived in that house for a few months.
cn: 齐里在那房子里只住了几个月。

en: How many times a month do you do that?
cn: 你一个月做几次这种事？

en: In Japan a new school year starts in April.
cn: 日本的新学年从四月开始。

en: Tessa shared her experience in a chapel assembly this April.
cn: 今年四月，苔丝在教会集会上分享了她的经验。

en: You may want to take a few steps back.
cn: 你可能需要后退几步。
