cn: 有没有人说过你长得像某个人？

en: I don't have enough time to do that before I go home.
cn: 我回家之前没有足够的时间做那件事。

en: I didn't realize that Tom was planning to leave Mary.
cn: 我不知道汤姆打算离开玛丽。

en: The goat's milk that Mark sells is very popular among the locals.
cn: 马克卖的羊奶在当地人中很受欢迎。

en: That restaurant is in front of the train station.
cn: 那个饭馆在火车站前面。

en: Most people can't actually recognize the back of their hand.
cn: 大多数人其实认不出自己的手背。

en: Some of these people look really similar to each other.
cn: 这些人里面有些长得很像。

en: Wow, I can't believe they actually met the deadline for once.
cn: 哇，真不敢相信他们这次居然真的赶上截止日期了。

en: The trigonometric functions satisfy a wide array of notable algebraic identities.
cn: 三角函数满足各种代数恒等式。

en: Of course, to die in Italy is more interesting.
cn: 当然，死在义大利会更有意思。

en: I'm not saying a goddamn thing until I get to talk to my lawyer.
cn: 在见到我的律师之前，我他妈的什么都不会说。

en: I could tell you, but then I'd have to kill you.
cn: 我可以告诉你，但那样我就得杀了你。

en: It's normal to experience workplace crushes, but remember to stay professional.
cn: 在职场中对某人产生好感是很正常的，但记得要保持专业形象。

en: The camp counselors are supposed to provide guidance and mentorship to the students.
cn: 营辅员应负责为学生提供指引和辅导。

en: Their combined weight was too much and caused the truck to break down.
cn: 总重量过大，导致卡车抛锚。

en: The students are all crowding around something. What is that?
cn: 学生们都挤在那里。那里有什么？

en: Some of these people look a lot like each other.
cn: 这些人当中有些长得很像。

en: Who else has questions? Yes, how about you there in the white shirt?
cn: 还有谁有问题？就你吧，穿白色上衣的那位。

en: This is way more complicated than it has any right to be.
cn: 这件事完全没必要这么复杂。

en: Do you know how to get to us here?
cn: 你知道怎样到我们这儿吗？

en: I am simply doing what I am supposed to.
cn: 我只是在做我该做的

en: The truth is that I was the one who killed your dog.
cn: 其实我才是杀你的狗的那一个。

en: Tom almost forgot to take an umbrella with him.
cn: 汤姆忘带雨伞了。

en: French is the only foreign language I've ever formally studied.
cn: 我只系统地学习过法语。

en: Do you believe that there are demons in this world?
cn: 你相不相信，这世界上有魔鬼 ?

en: It's hard to explain, but there's something a little off about him.
cn: 说不太清楚，但他这个人就是有哪里怪怪的。

en: Mothers know their sons are coming back in caskets.
cn: 母亲们心里清楚，儿子回来时只剩一口棺材。

en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.
cn: 我父母说，YouTube 和串流平台让电影的魔力大打折扣。

en: I have to get off at the next stop.
cn: 我下一站下车。

en: The color of this clothing is neither red nor orange.
cn: 这衣服颜色既不是红色，也不是橙色。

en: I've been studying Toki Pona for a long time.
cn: 我学习道本语很久了。

en: What's the premise of the TV show "The Bachelor"?
cn: 《单身汉》这个电视节目的基本设定是什么？

en: Wait, don't go any further. Something feels off here.
cn: 等等，别再往前走了。这里感觉有点不对劲。

en: Dogs have been domesticated for at least 40,000 years.
cn: 狗的驯化史至少有四万年。

en: I paid 2,000 yen for the parcel to be sent by air.
cn: 我花了两千日圆把包裹空运寄出去。

en: The bus had already left when we got to the bus stop.
cn: 我们到公车站的时候，公车已经开走了。

en: The black SUV ahead of me is swerving like a drunk driver.
cn: 前面那台黑色休旅车开得像个酒驾的一样，一直在蛇行。

en: Tom won't be able to drive for a while.
cn: 汤姆暂时无法开车。

en: Fadil was a man with a million dollar smile.
cn: 法迪尔是个拥有迷人笑容的男人。

en: Tom said he had to go to the dentist's on October 20th.
cn: 汤姆说他必须在十月二十日去看牙医。

en: Edmundo saw an SUV come into the parking lot.
cn: 埃德蒙多看到一辆 SUV 开进停车场。

en: Tom says he's planning to go to Australia with Mary.
cn: 汤姆说他计划和玛丽一起去澳洲。

en: I'm not signing anything until I speak with my agent.
cn: 在跟我的经纪人谈过之前，我不会签任何东西。

en: Next month is their 50th anniversary, and they're planning on renewing their vows.
cn: 下个月是他们的五十周年纪念，他们打算重新宣誓。

en: The Sioux had signed a treaty with the government in 1868.
cn: 苏族于 1868 年与政府签订了一项条约。

en: Last week, I mailed him some souvenirs from the U.S.
cn: 上周我寄了一些美国纪念品给他。

en: I can tell from the way you act that you're using again.
cn: 从你的举止看得出来，你又在用了。

en: The city should subsidize small businesses in industries with large overhead costs.
cn: 市府应补贴经常性开支庞大的产业中的小型企业。

en: I have family here that I'll be sad to leave behind.
cn: 我在这里有家人，离开时会很舍不得他们。

en: The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.
cn: 海底的岩石缝里藏着一只章鱼。

en: The takoyaki served at this restaurant is a delight.
cn: 这家餐厅的章鱼烧非常好吃。

en: Aww, are we feeling a little tired? Let's get you into bed.
cn: 哎呀，是不是有点累了呀？来，让我带你去睡觉。

en: Tom flipped the coin in the air and then caught it.
cn: 汤姆把硬币抛向空中，然后接住了。

en: While in England, I often referred to the guidebook for details of my journey.
cn: 我在英国的时候，经常翻阅旅游指南，查询旅途中的相关细节。

en: Why didn't you consult me before taking this decision?
cn: 你做这个决定之前，为什么不先问过我？

en: I don't think he has anything to do with the matter.
cn: 我认为他跟这件事没有任何关系。

en: Tom hooked his arm under John's shoulder and flipped him over.
cn: 汤姆把手臂勾进约翰的腋下，把他翻了过去。

en: I can't believe that Tom did all this by himself.
cn: 我真不敢相信这些全都是汤姆自己一个人做的。

en: I saw Tom pushing a stroller down the sidewalk.
cn: 我看到汤姆推着婴儿车走在人行道上。

en: Mary did not get along well with the other girls.
cn: 玛丽和其他女生处得不太好。

en: He had words with his friend and then struck him.
cn: 他和朋友起了口角，然后动手打了他。

en: Tom keeps spewing out high-end terms, but I know it's all fluff.
cn: 汤姆一直在吐高端术语，但我知道都是虚的。

en: Robert was a really good friend of one of Sandra's ex-boyfriends.
cn: 罗伯特是珊朵拉某个前男友的好朋友。

en: He took my umbrella without so much as asking.
cn: 他连问都没问就拿了我的雨伞。

en: The building isn't yet up to code because it still needs a wheelchair ramp.
cn: 这栋建筑尚未符合法规，因为还缺少轮椅坡道。

en: Can you tell me how long Tom has had this guitar?
cn: 你能告诉我汤姆拥有这把吉他多久了吗？

en: The man with the gun threatened to kill Tom's dog.
cn: 持枪男子扬言要杀死汤姆的狗。

en: Tom and Mary are both still in Australia, aren't they?
cn: 汤姆和玛丽都还在澳洲，对吧？

en: You're the smartest and most beautiful woman that I've ever seen.
cn: 你是我见过最聪明、最漂亮的女人。

en: I dug a huge pit with my shovel in just one day.
cn: 我只用一天就用铲子挖了一个大坑。

en: Mary is a very promising student, whereas Tom promises much but achieves little.
cn: 玛丽是个很有前途的学生，而汤姆则是光说不练。

en: Avoid sudden movements around the rabbit, they can startle them.
cn: 避免在兔子旁边突然做出动作，以免吓到牠们。

en: A week later, John asked Jessica out on a date.
cn: 一周后，约翰约洁西卡出去约会。

en: The company went bankrupt. We laid off all of the employees.
cn: 公司倒闭了。我们遣散了所有员工。

en: Tom and Mary say they don't believe in ghosts.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽说他们不相信鬼的存在。

en: I very much doubt that what we saw was a ghost.
cn: 我非常怀疑我们看到的是鬼。

en: It's important to me that you receive an education.
cn: 你能受到教育，对我来说很重要。

en: In the Netherlands they want to ban the Qur'an.
cn: 荷兰有人想禁掉《古兰经》。

en: He poured her a drink and handed it to her.
cn: 他给她倒了一杯饮料，然后递给她。

en: I think Tom expects us to wait for him.
cn: 我觉得汤姆希望我们等他。

en: Find the radius of the incircle of the triangle.
cn: 求三角形内切圆的半径。

en: I know Tom doesn't want to do that until after lunch.
cn: 我知道汤姆不想在午餐前做那件事。

en: The money I have in the bank earns very low interest.
cn: 我存在银行的钱利息非常低。

en: How did you know that Tom wasn't really from Boston?
cn: 你怎么知道汤姆其实不是波士顿人？

en: Ziri was a vampire who was on the run from vampire hunters.
cn: 齐里是一只正在逃避猎人追杀的吸血鬼。

en: She has a crush on the boy next door.
cn: 她看上了隔壁的那个男孩。

en: I'm not saying anything until I speak with my lawyer.
cn: 在我与律师谈过之前，我什么都不会说。

en: I've got absolutely nothing to do with it, it's all Tom!
cn: 这跟我完全没关系，全都是汤姆的事！

en: Tom said to Mary that it was just a one-night stand.
cn: 汤姆告诉玛丽，那只是一夜情。

en: The police found foreign DNA at the scene of the crime.
cn: 警方在犯罪现场发现了陌生人的 DNA。

en: On a scale from 1 to 10, how have you been feeling?
cn: 从一到十分，你最近感觉如何？

en: Our country designed the first electronic computer in 1941.
cn: 我们的国家1941年设计了第一台电子计算机。

en: Euclid was the author of the first book on mathematics.
cn: 欧几里得是第一本数学著作的作者。

en: You can talk to him in plain English and he still won't get it.
cn: 你就算用最简单的话跟他说，他还是听不懂。

en: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.
cn: 在泳池游完泳后要拉伸肌肉。

en: Transylvania was part of Hungary for a thousand years.
cn: 特兰西瓦尼亚曾是匈牙利的一部分，长达一千年。

en: Can a person be Christian without going to church?
cn: 一个人不去教堂也能算是基督徒吗？

en: It's really hard to find a job during the summer break as a student.
cn: 学生放暑假时找工作真的很难。

en: As it oxidizes, the color turns blue and finally becomes a brilliant reddish-purple hue.
cn: 随氧化变成蓝色，最终呈现出鲜艳的红紫色。

en: Ziri showed Rima how to properly prune her palm trees.
cn: 齐里向里玛示范如何正确修剪棕榈树。

en: We will deliver up to the airport of the island.
cn: 我们将移交至岛上的机场。

en: Don't eat all the figs. Leave some for your sister.
cn: 别把无花果全吃完，留一些给你姊姊。

en: I'll return her to you tomorrow, safe and sound.
cn: 我明天会把她完好无缺地还给你。

en: I'm not sure that Tom will understand my German.
cn: 我不确定汤姆是否听得懂我讲的德语。

en: Tom thought the amulet would protect him from harm.
cn: 汤姆以为护身符能保护他免受伤害。

en: There are people who you already miss when you've only just left them.
cn: 有些人，你才刚离开，就已经开始想念了。

en: It was already late, so I went back home.
cn: 己经晚了，所以我回了家。

en: Have you got used to eating Japanese food yet?
cn: 你们习惯吃日本的食物了吗？

en: Tom and Mary look younger than they really are.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽看上去要比他们的实际年龄要更年轻。

en: I think Tom is going to do the same thing he did yesterday.
cn: 我想汤姆还要去做昨天做的事。

en: The language of truth must be, with no doubt, simple and without artifice.
cn: 真理的语言必定是朴实无华、毫无矫饰的。

en: You have so many experiences, so could you tell me how old you are?
cn: 你有这幺多的生活阅历，敢问你年方几何？

en: Mary said she didn't think Tom needed to do that anymore.
cn: 玛丽说她认为汤姆再也不用去做那种事了。

en: Tom sat on his bed and opened his laptop.
cn: 汤姆坐在床上，打开了笔记本电脑。

en: From now on, I will not eat meat anymore.
cn: 从现在起，我再也不吃肉了。

en: Sami and Layla want to go to the mall.
cn: 萨米和莱拉想要去商场。

en: She thinks that happiness and health should be the benchmarks for success.
cn: 她认为幸福与健康才是衡量成功的标准。

en: I hope Tom doesn't have any trouble finding our house.
cn: 我希望汤姆在找我们的房子时不会遇到什幺困难。

en: He suggested travelling together for safety, since the area is so dangerous.
cn: 鉴于这片区域的危险，出于安全考虑，他建议我们一起走。

en: I don't think that we'll be able to prove it.
cn: 我不认为我们能证明它。

en: His home is furnished in a very cozy way.
cn: 他家的布局非常温馨。

en: Tom and Mary said they wanted to leave early today.
cn: 汤姆和玛丽说他们今天想要早点走。

en: You have to do it even if you don't want to.
cn: 你必须要做，即使你不想做也没办法。

en: I assume that you wouldn't want to do that.
cn: 我想你不会那幺做的吧。

en: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
cn: 这里是普通中学的化学实验室。

en: The disproportionate power of the Western world has started to decline.
cn: 西方世界曾经无可撼动的力量已经开始走下坡路了。

en: She said that she would visit Jack with her sisters.
cn: 她说她会和她的姐妹们一起去看望杰克。

en: When I was three years old, my name was changed from Tom to John.
cn: 我三岁的时候把名字从汤姆改成了约翰。

en: I think you haven't watched the video till the end.
cn: 我感觉你还没把视频看完。

en: That part of the house didn't use to be there.
cn: 房子的那个部分以前不在那个位置。

en: Tom said that he didn't have any money left.
cn: 汤姆说他一点钱都没有剩下了。

en: Tom said that Mary isn't allowed to do that.
cn: 汤姆说玛丽不可以做那种事。

en: I suspect that Tom will never agree to do that.
cn: 我怀疑汤姆永远不会同意那样做。

en: I went to Hawaii on vacation for a couple of weeks.
cn: 我去夏威夷休假了两周。

en: I believe Tom and Mary can take care of themselves.
cn: 我相信汤姆和玛丽能够照顾好自己。

en: Tom told Mary that he didn't think John was friendly.
cn: 汤姆告诉玛丽，他认为约翰并不友善。

en: Together, you represent the harmony between tradition and progress.
cn: 你们共同代表着传统与进步之间的和谐。

en: What makes you so sure Tom and Mary want to stay?
cn: 你凭什么这么确定汤姆和玛丽想留下来？

en: John isn't the kind of man who would betray you.
cn: 约翰不是那种会背叛你的人。

en: Transformation is birth and death at the same time.
cn: 改变同时蕴含着新生与毁灭。

en: When the mind is pure, joy follows like a shadow that never leaves.
cn: 心灵纯净时，喜悦便如影随形。

en: I shouldn't have drunk so much beer last night.
cn: 我昨晚不应该喝那幺多酒的。

en: Tom said that he wanted to ask me a personal question.
cn: 汤姆说他想问我一个个人问题。

en: Mary won't be able to move the piano by herself.
cn: 玛丽无法独自移动那架钢琴。

en: The tailor is going to redo the hem of my pants.
cn: 裁缝师要帮我重新修裤脚。

en: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
cn: 侧边栏显示在网站标志下方的页面边缘。

en: Without pollination, we wouldn't be able to eat fruits and vegetables.
cn: 没有授粉，我们就吃不到水果和蔬菜。

en: I don't have the patience to go clothes shopping with my wife.
cn: 我没有任何耐心和我妻子一起去买衣服。

en: I bet I can sit here longer without saying a thing than you can.
cn: 我猜我能老实地坐在这更久，不发一句牢骚，而不像你。

en: You knew all this time, but you did nothing.
cn: 你一直都知道，却什幺都没做。

en: Tom didn't have a chance to speak to Mary.
cn: 汤姆没有和玛丽对话的机会。

en: I won't tell Tom and Mary what they need to do.
cn: 我不会告诉汤姆和玛丽他们需要做什幺。

en: I knew it would be hot in the auditorium.
cn: 我就知道礼堂里会很热。

en: Ziri still has much to learn in this world we live in.
cn: 这世上还有很多东西是吉理不明白的。

en: You could go to rest on the sea while I'm on a business trip.
cn: 在我出差时你可以去享受沙滩。

en: I'm translating the messages of the bot from English to Hungarian.
cn: 我正在把这个机器人的消息从英语翻译成匈牙利语。

en: So you're planning to follow this course as well!
cn: 所以你也打算选这门课程啊！

en: Not to be rude, but didn't you say that last year?
cn: 恕我直言，你去年不也这幺说过？

en: Tom thought Cookie would be a good name for his dog.
cn: 汤姆认为“小饼干”这个名字很适合他的狗。

en: I don't know if that will be enough money for me.
cn: 我不知道那些钱够不够。

en: Is it that you can't or that you don't want to?
cn: 是你不能还是你不想。

en: I like it when you talk dirty to me!
cn: 我不讨厌听你说些下流的话。

en: Tom is the best French teacher I've ever had.
cn: 汤姆是我见过最好的法语老师。

en: Can I make a credit card call on this public phone?
cn: 这台公共电话可以刷信用卡吗 ？

en: I invited some friends for dinner. I hope you don't mind.
cn: 我请了几位朋友来吃饭，希望您不会介意。

en: I'm too tired to go out for a run.
cn: 我太累了，没办法出门跑步了。

en: The idea is not in itself a bad one.
cn: 这个想法本身还可以。

en: I want to know how I can lose weight.
cn: 我想知道我能怎样减肥。

en: Generally speaking, nobles were only very slightly affected by taxes.
cn: 总体来说，贵族受到税收的影响微乎其微。

en: I told the story that my mom used to tell me to my daughter.
cn: 我把我妈妈曾经跟我讲过的故事讲给了我的女儿。

en: His only wish was to see his son one last time.
cn: 他唯一的愿望，就是再见他的儿子最后一面。

en: Aren't you the only one who has a key to this door?
cn: 不是只有你有这扇门的钥匙吗？

en: He would be paid a small amount of money.
cn: 他会拿到一小笔钱。

en: There is not much I can do to help, I am afraid.
cn: 恐怕我帮不上什幺忙。

en: I will have been to New York twice this time.
cn: 这次是我第二次去纽约了。

en: I thought Tom would be in Boston by now.
cn: 我还以为汤姆现在已经到波斯顿了。

en: Why would anyone want to eat something that smelled like that?
cn: 谁会想吃那种味道的东西？

en: Tom just kept saying he didn't know what to do.
cn: 汤姆一直说他不知道该怎么办。

en: I wonder if Mary really thought she had to do that.
cn: 我不知道玛丽是否真的认为她必须那样做。

en: Tom and Mary studied French after dinner while their mother washed dishes.
cn: 晚饭后，汤姆和玛丽在学法语，他们的妈妈在刷碗。

en: Your teeth are all yellow. You should clean them better.
cn: 你的牙都黄了，赶紧去刷牙。

en: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.
cn: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。

en: Tom has had three wives. They were all Canadians.
cn: 汤姆有三任妻子。她们全是加拿大人。

en: Do you want to do something about it now?
cn: 你现在想对此做点什幺吗？

en: Dad, I am pregnant. Here is the list of the suspects...
cn: 爸爸，我怀孕了。这是我男朋友们的名单……

en: Sami looked at himself as somebody smarter than anybody else.
cn: 萨米自认为他比他身边的其他人都聪明。

en: I did my homework after I took a nap.
cn: 我眯了一会之后把作业写了。

en: It's hard to believe that it has been clear and sunny until now.
cn: 天气到现在竟然依旧很好。

en: My lunch was an apple and pears and pomegranate.
cn: 我午餐吃了苹果、梨子和石榴。

en: You might get fired if you do that the way Tom told you to.
cn: 你要是照着汤姆告诉你的办法做，你有可能会被开除的。

en: Today, I watched a play written by a friend of mine.
cn: 今天我看了一场演出，剧本是我的一个朋友写的。

en: If you did that, they'd kick you out of the bar.
cn: 你那幺干会被人踢出酒吧的。

en: For many individuals, the pentatonic scale is associated with Chinese music.
cn: 在很多人的印象中，五声音阶往往与中国音乐挂钩。

en: Is the wire live? I can tell just by touching it.
cn: 电线有没有电？我一摸就知道。

en: Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
cn: 你的理解有点望文生义了。

en: Ghosts and gods are the obsessions of the human world.
cn: 鬼神是人世间的执念。

en: It would take some time for me to translate this book.
cn: 翻译这本书要花一些时间。

en: You tried to persuade Tom to do that, didn't you?
cn: 你之前试着劝过汤姆去做那件事，对吧？

en: There's no need to worry about accuracy this time; just eyeball it.
cn: 现在精确度已经不重要了，你目测一下就好。

en: Can I have two hamburgers and a coke, please?
cn: 可以给我来两个汉堡和一杯可乐吗？谢谢。

en: Tom shot his own dog, thinking it was a wolf.
cn: 汤姆把他的狗给毙了，他还误以为那是只狼。

en: The laptop provides cutting-edge technology at an affordable price.
cn: 这款笔记型电脑价格亲民，技术领先。

en: He couldn't do anything to stop her from converting to Islam.
cn: 他无法阻止她改信伊斯兰教。

en: Tom died of rabies after having been bitten by a bat.
cn: 汤姆被蝙蝠咬伤后，死于狂犬病感染。

en: Is there anything else I can help Tom with?
cn: 我还能帮汤姆做些别的什幺吗？

en: The bar-tailed godwit migrates from Alaska to New Zealand.
cn: 斑尾塍鹬从阿拉斯加迁徙至纽西兰。

en: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.
cn: 庞大而精妙的体系往往建立在几个简单的规则之上。

en: Irritable men are always the last to know about things.
cn: 脾气不好的人总是最晚获知任何讯息。

en: Money won't make you merry, but it eases your misery.
cn: 钞能力不等于幸福，但可以暂时解决很多麻烦。

en: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
cn: 联邦、州及地方官员立即承诺将其重建。

en: To pass, you need to score over 60 points.
cn: 你要考60分以上才能及格。

en: My friend explained the way to learn foreign languages in detail.
cn: 朋友向我详细说明了外语的学习方法。

en: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.
cn: 我相信良好的教育能改变人的社会地位。

en: I've been helping my friend with his project recently.
cn: 我最近在朋友的项目里帮忙。

en: My president stared at me as if he was angry.
cn: 经理像是生气了一样盯着我。

en: You can see the city view clearly from the office window.
cn: 透过办公室的窗户可以清晰地看见城市的风景。

en: The cause of this fire was a microwave oven.
cn: 这场火灾的起因是一个微波炉。

en: Germany is expecting about 1.5 million asylum seekers this year.
cn: 德国今年预计要接收150万难民。

en: Tom didn't have any money, so he couldn't go with me.
cn: 汤姆没有钱了，所以他不能和我一起去。

en: Tom never told me what I was supposed to do.
cn: 汤姆从来没有告诉我应该怎幺做。

en: Before turning, put on your blinkers to warn other drivers.
cn: 转弯时请打转向灯来提醒其他司机。

en: Tom's bout with diarrhea was foreordained due to Mary's refusal to clean any cookware.
cn: 玛丽拒绝洗炊具，汤姆注定会闹肚子。

en: God knows how many Valentine's Days capitalists have invented.
cn: 天知道资本家创造了多少个情人节。

en: If he told me the truth, I would have forgiven him.
cn: 如果他跟我说实话，我就原谅他。

en: The only weapons I have in my home are water pistols.
cn: 我家里能算得上武器的就只有几把水枪了。

en: Tom took care of my kids when I was in the hospital.
cn: 汤姆在我住院时帮我照顾了孩子。

en: This scandal will likely ruin your chances of being elected.
cn: 这则丑闻很有可能会断送您的选举。

en: I slipped and fell on the crosswalk, just when the light turned red.
cn: 红绿灯变红的时候，我刚好在斑马线上滑倒了。

en: I'll expect you tomorrow unless you let me know otherwise.
cn: 你不改口的话，我明天就来等你了。

en: A book not worth reading is not worth buying in the first place.
cn: 一本不值得读的书，一开始就不应该买。

en: Have you finished your homework? Have you memorized the dictation content?
cn: 这次作业做完了吗？默写背了吗？

en: I bought meat buns at the convenience store and ate them.
cn: 我在便利店买了肉包吃了。

en: It is the worst when no one dares to object.
cn: 没有反对的声音才最可怕。

en: Do you really think we have a chance to win?
cn: 你真觉得我们有机会赢吗？

en: I'm not sure how much they are expecting me to donate.
cn: 我不太确定他希望我捐多少。

en: Do you know if there's a steam room anywhere around here?
cn: 你知道这附近哪里有汗蒸房吗？

en: I don't give a toss that you are tired.
cn: 我才不管你累不累呢。

en: We haven't been to Boston in a long time.
cn: 我们好久没去波士顿了。

en: William is so organized. He's always on top of things.
cn: 威廉做事很有条理，他总是能把一切都打点好。

en: Damn, VS Code crashed and I haven’t saved the file yet.
cn: 操，VS Code崩溃了，我还没保存文件。

en: Turn off the light before you go to bed.
cn: 上床之前关灯。

en: The crown is adorned with dozens of divinely lustrous gemstones.
cn: 王冠上镶嵌着数十颗光彩夺目的宝石。

en: He helped an old lady get up from her seat.
cn: 他将一位老太太从位子上扶起来。

en: Tom has a lot more books than you do.
cn: 汤姆的书比你多。

en: If you need more room on the screen, you can toggle the sidebar off.
cn: 如需更多萤幕空间，可以关闭侧边栏。

en: She felt as if she was being lifted up.
cn: 她觉得自己好像被举起来了。

en: The piano is a chord instrument, while the flute is a monophonic instrument.
cn: 钢琴是和弦乐器，笛子是单音乐器。

en: My room is small, but it's big enough for me.
cn: 我的房间很小，但对我来说已经够大了。

en: I not only gave him some advice, I also gave him a bicycle.
cn: 除了一些建议之外，我还给了他一台自行车。

en: It's ringing. Tom, please go and open the door.
cn: 门铃响了。汤姆，去帮我开一下门。

en: Tom only earns half as much money as Mary does.
cn: 汤姆赚的钱只有玛丽的一半。

en: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.
cn: 他要是成了，我跟你姓。

en: A country has its laws, and a home has its house rules.
cn: 国有国法，家有家规。

en: The man answers to the description in the newspaper.
cn: 那个男人和报纸上描述的一模一样。

en: The report was prepared in haste and had several misspellings.
cn: 报告是匆匆准备好的，所以含有个把错别字。

en: He can't even tell a treble clef from a bass clef.
cn: 他连高音谱号和低音谱号都分不清。

en: What's the difference between an emu and an ostrich?
cn: 鸸鹋和鸵鸟有什么区别？

en: Women are made of water and men are made of earth.
cn: 女儿是水作的，男人是泥作的。

en: In the furry fandom, many are artists of some sort.
cn: 在福瑞圈子里，不少人都会进行一些创作。

en: Tom was the first one to turn in his homework.
cn: 汤姆是第一个交作业的。

en: She studied the bat's anatomy for her biology project.
cn: 她为了完成生物学作业，研究了蝙蝠的解剖构造。

en: The Ordovician-Silurian Extinction Event wiped out nearly 85% of marine species.
cn: 奥陶纪—志留纪灭绝事件消灭了近 85% 的海洋物种。

en: Why would anybody think that was a good idea?
cn: 怎幺会有人认为那是个好主意？

en: Tom said he wanted me to spend the summer in Boston with him.
cn: 汤姆说他想让我陪他在波士顿过一个夏天。

en: If you drop it, I'll take it out of your wage.
cn: 如果你把它弄坏了，我会从你的工资里扣。

en: I swam very well when I was a child.
cn: 我小时候很会游泳。
